title: Systems Analyst, Supply Chain (Starlink)
jd_text: <div class="content-intro"><p>SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of&nbsp;enabling human life on Mars.</p></div><p><strong>SYSTEMS ANALYST, SUPPLY CHAIN (STARLINK)</strong></p> <p>SpaceX is developing a low latency, broadband internet system to meet the needs of consumers across the globe. Enabled by a constellation of low Earth orbit satellites, Starlink will provide fast, reliable internet to populations with little or no connectivity, including those in rural communities and places where existing services are too expensive or unreliable. As a Systems Analyst within the Starlink program you will analyze, develop, and implement tactical and strategic business processes for the supply chain group to create high impact, efficient, economical solutions. Ideal team members are highly autonomous individuals that excel in flexible environments and bring clarity and informed decision-making to our leadership teams that drive the organization.</p> <p><strong>RESPONSIBILITIES:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Identify and analyze key performance indicators related to supply chain, especially inventory levels, lead times, supply coverage, demand fluctuations, and capacity utilization (includes developing planning models and decision-making tools)</li> <li>Create dashboards, models, and other reporting tools to enable strategic visibility across supply chain, production, cross functional teams, and leadership</li> <li>Identify inefficient workflows and develop scripts to automate tactical steps</li> <li>Track, report, and proactively manage production efficiency improvements (e.g. supply chain initiatives and process optimizations)</li> <li>Provide strategic insights and recommendations based on supply chain analysis to optimize both supplier and internal processes</li> <li>Demonstrate innovation, technical excellence, attention to detail, self-direction, and courage</li> <li>Drive for results and customer satisfaction by collaborating with teams, leading projects and continuously spearheading improvements in supply chain</li> <li>Work with stakeholders to analyze the impact of proposed business decisions (including actual performance) on SpaceX’s business health&nbsp;</li> <li>Work with broader application software team to support ERP tools development &amp; supplier-facing portal enhancements</li> </ul> <p><strong>BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Bachelor’s degree</li> <li>1+ years of experience with SQL and business intelligence tools (e.g. Tableau, Power BI, Grafana) or programming softwares</li> <li>1+ years of experience in analytics, operations, management/strategy consulting, planning, or product management</li> </ul> <p><strong>PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Excellent analytical skills (e.g. SQL, Tableau, PowerBI, Microsoft Office suite and similar data manipulation tools)</li> <li>Experience in python and scripting</li> <li>Degree in data science, computer science, industrial and systems engineering, operations or supply chain management</li> <li>Demonstrated success driving tangible impact/influencing within a broader organization, particularly in production or project management contexts</li> <li>Demonstrated experience managing simultaneous projects with tight deadlines and navigating ambiguous problem statements</li> <li>Proficient in understanding end user requirements, the ability to translate requirements into design requirements, and identifying system enhancement opportunities</li> <li>Ability to work both autonomously and as a team in a highly demanding, ambiguous, and fast paced environment</li> <li>Understanding of business concepts relating to supply chain management (procurement, sourcing, material movement/logistics, supplier quality, etc.)</li> </ul> <p><strong>ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Must be able to work extended hours and/or weekends as needed to meet major milestones</li> <li>Up to 25% travel to suppliers and/or other SpaceX locations</li> <li>This position requires being on site - remote work not considered</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong>ITAR REQUIREMENTS:</strong></p> <ul> <li>To conform to U.S. Government export regulations, applicant must be a (i) U.S. citizen or national, (ii) U.S. lawful, title: Enterprise Select Implementation Consultant (Central or East)
Supply Chain Planning Manager (Starship)
jd_text: <div class="content-intro"><p>SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of&nbsp;enabling human life on Mars.</p></div><p><strong>SUPPLY CHAIN PLANNING MANAGER (STARSHIP)</strong></p> <p>The SpaceX supply chain department is a critical player in enabling Starship’s mission. To capitalize on SpaceX’s technological and market changing successes, our team will be part of managing an agile yet robust supply chain that will enable a competitive advantage for the company. The functions within the department include procurement, planning and fulfillment, supplier development and quality, logistics and inventory. SpaceX supply chain will play a key role in enabling SpaceX to meet the ambitious growth targets and greatly contribute to making us a multi-planetary species.</p> <p><strong>RESPONSIBILITIES:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Own the end-to-end planning lifecycle for Starship sub-assemblies or finished goods, from accurate bill of material requirements, appropriate supply coverage, and timely configuration management to satisfy the engine production plan.</li> <li>Work very closely with engineering, production, and procurement counterparts to understand internal rate goals, design change landscape, and supplier production plans to set up a robust supply chain plan capable of scaling with multiple configurations and production rates.</li> <li>Utilize good risk management intuition to balance cost, reliability, and production rate based on knowledge of program goals and context in a highly dynamic environment – and make effective risk calls knowing when to prioritize one over the other.</li> <li>Manage the supply schedule for raw material and finished goods in order to optimize days on hand and inventory turns, minimize obsolescence, and enable the production line to output at full rate while being mindful about excess inventory.</li> <li>Communicate forecasts to internal and external stakeholders that accurately reflect minimum requirements while hedging against potential upside or change in business direction.</li> <li>Identify and mitigate potential risks in the multi-tier global supply chain by coordinating with the appropriate stakeholders (procurement, logistics, engineering, etc.) to propose creative solutions and drive to closure.</li> <li>Balance a spectrum of both new product introduction (NPI) with rapid iteration and design changes as well as stable production with good risk intuition to balance challenges in both.</li> <li>Partner with engineering and production teams to effectively plan for and incorporate design or process changes seamlessly into the production line without impacting ability for production to maintain build rate.</li> <li>Support insourcing efforts where applicable to guarantee constant supply from internal and external sources to enable overall production targets.</li> <li>Assess and monitor supply base capacity and constraints at primary and sub-tiers suppliers to inform program scenario planning and mitigate potential challenges when ramping a product line.</li> <li>Maintain part and planning master data as needed to accurately reflect lead-times, manufacturing allocations, yields and attrition, offsets, order policy, and other parameters.</li> <li>Guide and mentor peers and team members to strengthen organizational resiliency and bolster the talent pipeline.</li> <li>Define and incorporate organization-level processes and improvements that enable the business to scale and efficiently utilize its human capital, leveraging learnings from world-class manufacturers and other high-volume industries.</li> <li>Develop applications, reporting, and dashboards to measure team KPIs and support the program as it scales to meet Starship vehicle manifest.</li> <li>Utilize good risk management intuition to balance cost, reliability, and production rate based on knowledge of program goals and context in a highly dynamic environment – and make effective risk calls to prioritize one over the other.</li> </ul> <p><strong>BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Advanced degree and 3+ years of experience working in one or more of the following; or bachelor’s degree and 5+ years of experience working in one or more of the following: <ul> <li>Engineering</li> <li>Purchasing</li> <li>Contract negotiation</li> <li>Material or production planning</li> <li>Operations or supply chain management</li> <li>Material cost control</li> <li>Master production scheduling</li> </ul> </li> </ul> <p><strong>PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Experience in a high-volume industry, such as automotive or consumer electronics.</li> <li>Success working on cross-functional new product introduction projects, managing multiple products and schedules.</li> <li>Technical knowledge in mechanical commodities (CNC machining, plastic injection molding, die-casting, stampings) or metallic raw materials.</li> <li>Familiarity with ERP systems and purchasing/planning functions.</li> <li>Intermediate skills in SQL, Tableau, PowerBI, and other data analytics.</li> <li>Advanced skills in MS Excel &amp; Project, able to create pivot tables or macros, and analyze data.</li> <li>Experience navigating multitier Bill of Materials and work orders.</li> <li>Exceptional written, verbal and presentation communication skills with experience presenting to senior leadership.</li> <li>Detail-oriented, self-motivated and able to respond quickly to a fast-moving and ever-changing environment.</li> <li>Conducts all activities with the highest of integrity.</li> </ul> <p><strong>ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Must be able to travel - up to 50% work week travel may be required, including international travel.</li> <li>Must be able to work extended hours and/or weekends as needed to meet major milestones.</li> <li>This position is based in Starbase, TX and requires being onsite - remote work not considered.</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong>ITAR REQUIREMENTS:</strong></p> <ul> <li>To conform to U.S. Government export regulations, applicant must be a (i) U.S. citizen or national, (ii) U.S. lawful, permanent resident (aka green card holder), (iii) Refugee under 8 U.S.C. § 1157, or (iv) Asylee under 8 U.S.C. § 1158, or be eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State. Learn more about the ITAR <a href="https://www.pmddtc.state.gov/?id=ddtc_kb_article_page&amp;sys_id=24d528fddbfc930044f9ff621f961987">here</a>. &nbsp;</li> </ul> <p>SpaceX is an Equal Opportunity Employer; employment with SpaceX is governed on the basis of merit, competence and qualifications and will not be influenced in any manner by race, color, religion, gender, national origin/ethnicity, veteran status, disability status, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, mental or physical disability or any other legally protected status.</p> <p>Applicants wishing to view a copy of SpaceX’s Affirmative Action Plan for veterans and individuals with disabilities, or applicants requiring reasonable accommodation to the application/interview process should reach out to&nbsp;<a href="mailto:EEOCompliance@spacex.com">EEOCompliance@spacex.com</a><em>.&nbsp;</em></p></div>

title: Manager, Supply Chain - Datacenter Compute Infrastructure (Starlink)
jd_text: <div class="content-intro"><p>SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of&nbsp;enabling human life on Mars.</p></div><div><strong data-olk-copy-source="MailCompose">MANAGER, SUPPLY CHAIN - DATACENTER COMPUTE INFRASTRUCTURE (STARLINK)</strong></div> <div>&nbsp;</div> <div>We are seeking a leader to build and manage the team responsible for sourcing and supply chain strategy for datacenter compute infrastructure. This role oversees GPU/accelerators, CPUs, storage, ODM/CM relationships, as well as server and rack components to support SpaceXAI’s large-scale AI training clusters and compute facilities. You will define overall commodity strategies, build team capabilities, align roadmaps with engineering and vendors, secure supply, and optimize for cost, quality, speed, and resilience. The ideal candidate is an experienced people leader with deep expertise in compute hardware sourcing and a track record of delivering results in hyperscale AI infrastructure.</div> <div>&nbsp;</div> <div><strong>RESPONSIBILITIES:</strong></div> <ul> <li>Build, lead, and mentor a high-performing sourcing team focused on GPU/accelerators, CPUs, storage, ODM/CM, servers, and racks</li> <li>Define commodity strategies and multi-year roadmaps in partnership with engineering, architecture, and platform teams</li> <li>Oversee end-to-end sourcing, supplier qualification, multi-sourcing, and performance management to meet aggressive build schedules</li> <li>Orchestrate demand across SpaceXAI companies and align internal roadmaps with key vendors to secure preferential allocation and capacity</li> <li>Negotiate major agreements focused on pricing, volume, technology access, and reliable delivery, using creative approaches as needed</li> <li>Manage ODM/CM relationships and drive improvements in server and rack designs, cost, and delivery</li> <li>Monitor supply chain risks and implement mitigation plans for critical compute components</li> <li>Drive cost reduction through should-cost modeling, value engineering, and long-term agreements while maintaining quality and reliability standards</li> <li>Track team and category KPIs; provide regular updates and recommendations to senior leadership</li> <li>Foster strong cross-functional collaboration and promote effective supply chain practices across the organization</li> </ul> <div><strong>BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:</strong></div> <ul> <li>Bachelor’s degree and 8+ years of experience working in one or more of the following; or 12+ years of experience working in one or more of the following in leiu of a degree:</li> <ul> <li>Business</li> <li>Supply Chain</li> <li>Engineering</li> </ul> <li>6+ years of experience in global supply chain, procurement, or commodity management with a focus on compute hardware (GPUs, CPUs, storage, and/or servers)</li> <li>3+ years of experience in people management</li> <li>3+ years of experience building, leading, and managing sourcing teams</li> </ul> <div><strong>PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:</strong></div> <ul> <li>Technical understanding of datacenter compute architectures, GPUs/accelerators, CPUs, storage systems, ODM/CM models, servers, and racks</li> <li>Experience in fast-paced hyperscale or AI infrastructure environments</li> <li>Background working with major compute suppliers, ODMs, and contract manufacturers</li> <li>Strong leadership, negotiation, analytical, and cross-functional skills</li> <li>Proven ability to secure supply and manage costs in constrained, high-demand markets</li> <li>Passion for SpaceXAI’s mission</li> </ul> <div><strong>ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS:</strong></div> <ul> <li>Willingness to travel domestically and internationally as needed to support supplier relationships and critical projects</li> <li>Ability to thrive in a dynamic environment with rapidly evolving priorities and world-class execution speed</li> <li>This position is based in Austin, TX or Palo Alto, CA, and requires being onsite</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong>ITAR REQUIREMENTS:</strong></p> <ul> <li>To conform to U.S. Government export regulations, applicant must be a (i) U.S. citizen or national, (ii) U.S. lawful, permanent resident (aka green card holder), (iii) Refugee under 8 U.S.C. § 1157, or (iv) Asylee under 8 U.S.C. § 1158, or be eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State. Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of&nbsp;enabling human life on Mars.</p></div><p><strong>SR. We are looking for an experienced Sr. Business Analyst, known internally as Sr. Customer Integrity &amp; Threat Detection Analyst to detect, disrupt, and investigate potential misuse of the service—including proactively combating and deterring illicit operators. This person must strike the careful balance of safeguarding customer information and privacy while applying enforcement measures and executing with an even-handed approach, avoiding overreach and disproportionate collateral impacts.&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>RESPONSIBILITIES:</strong>&nbsp;</p> <ul> <li>Proactively&nbsp;identify&nbsp;and assess platform integrity and abuse risks</li> <li>Develop&nbsp;technical detection and&nbsp;mitigation strategies</li> <li>React to investigate potential issues such as&nbsp;scams, fraud, and illicit goods/activities</li> <li>Partner with cross-functional teams&nbsp;and&nbsp;deepen our relationships with them</li> <li>Conduct periodic reviews to support legal and compliance obligations</li> <li>Execute with consideration for customer privacy, targeting activities of indisputable harm and avoiding overreach</li> </ul> <p><strong>BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:</strong>&nbsp;</p> <ul> <li>Bachelor's degree&nbsp;and&nbsp;4+ years of professional experience in global affairs, intelligence, or investigations;&nbsp;OR 6+ years&nbsp;of professional experience in global affairs, intelligence, or investigations in lieu of a degree</li> <li>4+ years of experience with data querying languages (e.g., SQL), scripting languages (e.g., Python),&nbsp;geospatial tools (e.g., ArcGIS),&nbsp;and/or statistical software (e.g., R)</li> <li>4+ years of experience investigating, mitigating, or dealing with illicit operators (e.g., fraud, abuse,&nbsp;cybersecurity,&nbsp;or&nbsp;other&nbsp;illicit activities)</li> </ul> <p><strong>PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:</strong>&nbsp;</p> <ul> <li>Strong analytical research and communication skills, including excellent written and oral communication skills</li> <li>International provide regular updates and recommendations to senior leadership</li> <li>Foster strong cross-functional collaboration and promote effective supply chain practices across the organization</li> </ul> <div><strong>BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:</strong></div> <ul> <li>Bachelor’s degree and 10+ years of experience working in one or more of the following; Starlink Business Operations is lean and dynamic, operating with a fluid structure that favors high agency. We expect high performers to expand their scope across the program’s most critical bottlenecks.</p> <p><strong>RESPONSIBILITIES:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Own Starlink Supply Chain Resiliency and architect the end-to-end strtegy to secure global and domestic supply chain corridors and production continuity under extreme regional disruption and natural disaster scenarios</li> <li>Rally the entire program around supply chain resilience as a primary KPI alongside growth, cash, and performance</li> <li>Decouple from high-sensitivity regions by quantifying the rest-of-world frontier to secure technical and cost parity across emerging and domestic markets</li> <li>Engineer the executive contingency playbook to safeguard operations during supply and geopolitical emergencies</li> <li>Build first-principles models to identify critical-path choke points and quantify time-to-survive (TTS) and time-to-recover (TTR) metrics for every major assembly</li> <li>Partner with hardware and manufacturing engineering to support aggressive design-out strategies that eliminate single-source dependencies and expand the global vendor landscape</li> </ul> <p><strong>BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Bachelor's degree in engineering, mathematics, computer science, data science, physics, or other quantitative field</li> <li>4+ years of experience in engineering, manufacturing, product management, operations, FP&amp;A, consulting, banking, or entrepreneurship</li> <li>4+ years of experience in Excel or programming</li> </ul> <p><strong>PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Evidence of exceptional ability, especially within an ambiguous environment</li> <li>Quantitative dual degree in engineering field and economics or business field and/or equivalent professional experience</li> <li>Demonstrated success driving tangible impact/influencing within a broader organization</li> <li>Extreme sense of urgency and ownership; CHAIN</strong></p> <p>As a Commercial Counsel on the SpaceX Legal Team, you will enable SpaceX’s procurement of critical goods and services by providing legal review and solutions-based counseling to Supply Chain, Purchasing, Facilities and other cross-functional partners on complex legal and business issues in the United States and internationally.</p> <p><strong>RESPONSIBILITIES:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Draft, negotiate, and review a range of commercial contracts, including purchase orders/agreements, service agreements, license agreements, long-term supply agreements, non-disclosure agreements , and other agreements related to the acquisition of goods and services</li> <li>Identify and mitigate legal risk by implementing appropriate processes, trainings, and controls for the supported SpaceX teams</li> <li>Provide legal analyses of applicable laws, regulations, and industry practices, particularly related to the procurement of goods and services</li> <li>Work closely with Supply Chain, Purchasing, and Facilities Teams to provide legal counseling throughout all stages of the procurement lifecycle, including RFPs, RFQs, purchase agreements, license agreements and dispute resolution</li> <li>Manage SpaceX’s form Purchase Order and Standard Terms and Conditions</li> <li>Support continuous improvements of forms, policies, and processes to streamline and simplify procurements, including using AI and other technologies to improve efficiency and efficacy</li> <li>Work cross functionally with business teams across the company to analyze legal risks, devise creative solutions, and develop strong, trusted advisor relationships</li> </ul> <p><strong>BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:</strong></p> <ul> <li>JD or foreign equivalent from an accredited law school</li> <li>5+ years of legal experience</li> </ul> <p><strong>PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Experience at a well-regarded law firm</li> <li>Experience as an in-house lawyer, ideally within the tech and/or manufacturing sectors and with direct contact with Supply Chain, Purchasing, and Facilities Teams</li> <li>Experience providing legal advice related to commercial procurement transactions, including international transactions, and ideally with Fortune 1000 companies</li> <li>Experience managing legal issues for a high-growth multinational company</li> <li>Experience building and maintaining relationships with clients in various geographies and comfortable advising all levels of management</li> <li>Ability to communicate effectively with business stakeholders</li> <li>Knowledge of applicable regulatory issues</li> <li>Comfortable with and responsive to rapid developments and changes in direction as well as working with technologies and products and in practice areas without significant precedence</li> <li>The ideal candidate is diligent and proactive and has demonstrated excellent legal and business judgment, technical acumen, communication skills, and strategic thinking, along with the ability to work independently and cross-functionally</li> </ul> <p><strong>ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Must be admitted to the bar, in good standing, in at least one U.S. State</li> <li>This position is based in Bastrop, TX—though other SpaceX offices will be considered—and requires being onsite at a SpaceX office; remote work will not be considered</li> <li>Must be able to work extended hours and weekends, as needed</li> </ul> <p><strong>COMPENSATION AND BENEFITS:</strong><br><br>Pay Range:<br>Level 3: $200,000.00 - $255,000.00</p> <p>Your actual level and base salary will be determined on a case-by-case basis and may vary based on the following considerations: job-related knowledge and skills, education, and experience.</p> <p>Base salary is just one part of your total rewards package at SpaceX. You may also be eligible for long-term incentives, in the form of company stock or long-term cash awards, as well as potential discretionary bonuses and the ability to purchase additional stock at a discount through an Employee Stock Purchase Plan. title: Global Logistics Specialist, Carrier Management (Starlink)
jd_text: <div class="content-intro"><p>SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of&nbsp;enabling human life on Mars.</p></div><p><strong>GLOBAL LOGISTICS SPECIALIST, CARRIER MANAGEMENT (STARLINK)</strong></p> <p>As Starlink’s Global Logistics Specialist, Carrier Management, you will run day-to-day carrier execution and exception management for domestic and international freight. You will keep inbound, outbound, and reverse shipments moving across air, ocean, and ground, hold carriers to service and cost targets, and give the business a clear picture of status and risk before a delay hits production or a customer.</p> <p>Your focus is transportation operations, carrier relationships, and transport risk. You will manage assigned lanes and carriers, recover disruptions, support routing and rate decisions, and coordinate with suppliers, carriers, internal teams, and trade/compliance partners so freight arrives on time and in spec.</p> <p><strong>RESPONSIBILITIES:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Oversee carrier management, including daily operations, shipment flows, service quality evaluation, and performance monitoring</li> <li>Monitor carrier performance and implement corrective actions when necessary to ensure service quality and compliance</li> <li>Tracks, traces, and updates status for inbound and outbound materials, and consumer products and acts as the point of contact for logistics-related issues for Starlink logistics</li> <li>Mitigate transport-related risks by identifying potential issues and implementing appropriate risk management strategies</li> <li>Manage exceptions and disruptions in transportation operations, proactively finding solutions to minimize impact on supply chain operations</li> <li>Collaborate with internal stakeholders to ensure alignment and coordination across different functions, such as procurement, sales, and customer service</li> <li>Develop and maintain strong relationships with carriers to ensure reliable and cost-effective transportation services</li> <li>Collaborate with carriers to negotiate rates, service levels, and support with the development of contract terms and service requirements</li> <li>Stay up-to-date with industry trends and regulations, implementing best practices in carrier management and transport risk mitigation</li> <li>Analyze transport data and metrics to identify areas for improvement and cost reduction</li> <li>Communicate effectively with internal and external stakeholders to provide updates on transportation operations and address any issues or concerns</li> <li>Reports daily status to business stakeholders and weekly logistics statuses as required</li> <li>Ensure business practices not only guarantee the movement of products in a quality manner, but also meet those needs outlined in regulatory documentation, internal requirements, and customer flow-downs</li> </ul> <p><strong>BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:</strong></p> <ul> <li>High school diploma or equivalency certificate</li> <li>3+ years of global logistics operations, with a focus on both domestic and international supply chains</li> </ul> <p><strong>&nbsp;</strong><strong>PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Bachelor’s degree in supply chain, business, engineering, or a science discipline</li> <li>Proven experience in global logistics operations, with a strong focus on carrier management and transport risk mitigation</li> <li>Proven role in the development of complex global logistics models employing intermodal networks and knowledge of global supply chain and logistics markets and networks</li> <li>Import and export experience with compliance with ITAR and C-TPAT regulations</li> <li>Import/Export regulatory functions experience, including HTS, Schedule B knowledge, Incoterms, ISF filing process, DSP-5, DSP-73, ATA Carnet</li> <li>Experience in managing projects, products, and carriers, drayage companies, freight forwarders and customs house brokerage firms’ networks and ability to navigate through these processes and organizations</li> <li>Proficiency in logistics management software and tools</li> <li>Experience with SQL, Excel and other data analytics tools and strong analytical and data modeling ability</li> <li>Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to make data-driven decisions</li> <li>Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to build and maintain relationships with carriers and stakeholders</li> </ul> title: IT Support Technician (Logistics)
jd_text: <div class="content-intro"><p>SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of&nbsp;enabling human life on Mars.</p></div><p><strong>IT SUPPORT TECHNICIAN (LOGISTICS)</strong></p> <p>SpaceX is looking for an experienced IT support technician with strong knowledge and experience in world class IT service delivery. Candidates must have experience working in organizations capable of meeting the demanding needs of “high caliber engineers” and supporting critical operations such as launch and mission operations and 24x7 manufacturing operations. This team delivers the complete life cycle of IT services for the staff at SpaceX, from onboarding and setup, to upgrade, installation, troubleshooting, repair and replacement of hardware and software solutions, asset recovery, and protection. This team also has architectural responsibilities in the areas of end-user computer infrastructure, printing, and conference room technologies.&nbsp;</p> <p>The person in this position must have strong overall IT technical skills, while also having excellent customer service/interaction skills and superior organizational skills. The ideal candidate will be flexible and flourish in a fast paced and challenging environment. They should be a self-starter and have excellent motivation, leadership, and ingenuity to excel at this position.&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>RESPONSIBILITIES:</strong>&nbsp;</p> <ul> <li>Manage on site inventory and the total lifecycle of IT assets.&nbsp;</li> <li>Procure, configure and deploy computer hardware and mobile cellular devices. &nbsp;</li> <li>Configure and troubleshoot desktop, label and large multifunction printers. &nbsp;</li> <li>Configure non-traditional network attached devices (production, metrology and test machines) and interface with SpaceX infrastructure. &nbsp;</li> <li>Provide 1st and 2nd, and 3rd tier support to SpaceX employees.</li> <li>Troubleshoot software and hardware issues, in person and remotely. &nbsp;</li> <li>Develop new workflows and solutions, working directly with IT engineering groups and other internal/external resources to resolve complex issues.</li> <li>Network support and troubleshooting. From device connectivity to VLAN configuration.&nbsp;</li> <li>Write instructional documentation and convey highly technical ideas in terms that non-technical people can understand.</li> </ul> <p><strong>BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:</strong>&nbsp;</p> <ul> <li>High school diploma or equivalency certificate.</li> <li>1+ years of professional experience building, deploying and troubleshooting computer systems, hardware, printers, software, and IP networks within an enterprise environment.</li> <li>Experience supporting Microsoft technologies.&nbsp;</li> </ul> <p><strong>PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:</strong>&nbsp;</p> <ul> <li>Experience supporting Mac iOS and Linux environments.</li> <li>Technical certifications (i.e. A+, Network+, MCSE).&nbsp;</li> <li>Working knowledge of audio-visual equipment.</li> <li>Comfortable working with mission critical and sensitive systems, with a sense of urgency appropriate to the responsibilities.</li> <li>Able to work independently while maintaining patience with the constant interruptions.</li> <li>Due to the high visibility of this position, excellent written, verbal and phone communications skills.&nbsp;</li> </ul> <p><strong>ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS:</strong>&nbsp;</p> <ul> <li>Must be physically fit enough to regularly lift up to 25 lbs. for duties (i.e. delivering computers, unpacking and rack-mounting equipment).&nbsp;</li> <li>Must have valid driver's license.</li> <li>Must be willing to work all shifts, overtime, and/or weekends as needed.</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong>ITAR REQUIREMENTS:</strong></p> <ul> <li>To conform to U.S. Government export regulations, applicant must be a (i) U.S. citizen or national, (ii) U.S. lawful, permanent resident (aka green card holder), (iii) Refugee under 8 U.S.C. § 1157, or (iv) Asylee under 8 U.S.C. § 1158, or be eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State. title: Manager, Logistics (Inbound & CapEx)
jd_text: <div class="content-intro"><p>SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of&nbsp;enabling human life on Mars.</p></div><p><strong>MANAGER, LOGISTICS (INBOUND &amp; CAPEX)</strong></p> <p>As the Manager of Logistics, you will own the strategy, execution, and continuous improvement of inbound logistics, fulfillment networks, and global transportation operations. You will drive carrier performance, develop and refine KPI methodologies, lead sourcing strategy and carrier partnerships, and expand logistics and transport networks that support freight, e-commerce, and industrial projects. This role has end-to-end accountability for network health, cost optimization, and operational excellence across domestic and international movements.</p> <p><strong>RESPONSIBILITIES:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Develop, execute, and continuously evolve enterprise-wide logistics strategies, programs, and initiatives that optimize inbound logistics, fulfillment networks, and end-to-end transportation performance, directly enabling the achievement of aggressive volume, cost, and profitability targets while supporting rapid business growth.</li> <li>Establish and manage robust carrier performance management frameworks, including the design and maintenance of comprehensive KPIs, scorecards, and real-time reporting tools; leverage data analytics to identify trends, drive measurable operational improvements, and ensure the overall health and resilience of the global logistics network.</li> <li>Lead strategic sourcing initiatives and cultivate high-performing carrier partnerships through end-to-end management of RFPs, contract negotiations, rate and tariff optimization, and ongoing performance governance with third-party logistics providers and transportation partners.</li> <li>Drive the global expansion and optimization of logistics and transportation networks to support freight, e-commerce, and complex industrial project requirements, proactively identifying and onboarding new lanes, transportation modes, and service providers as business needs evolve.</li> <li>Analyze, model, and redesign inbound and outbound transportation, distribution methods, and network architecture to deliver cost-effective, scalable, and operationally efficient solutions that reduce lead times and improve service levels.</li> <li>Define, implement, and evolve a comprehensive set of Key Logistics Performance Indicators (KPIs) and executive-level dashboards that provide real-time visibility into network health, carrier performance, fulfillment operations, and overall supply chain effectiveness.</li> <li>Identify, prioritize, and lead cross-functional cost-reduction and process-optimization initiatives across internal and external logistics spend, including packaging design, routing optimization, mode selection, and end-to-end process improvements.</li> <li>Partner closely with Supply Chain, Production, and Engineering teams to align logistics strategies with broader business objectives and ensure seamless support for new product introductions, production ramps, and project launches.</li> <li>Collaborate with Global Compliance, Customs, Tax, Finance, and Supply Chain stakeholders to ensure full adherence to all regulatory, customs, brokerage, duty, Incoterms, and trade compliance requirements while proactively identifying opportunities to reduce landed costs and streamline processes.</li> <li>Develop, document, and institutionalize best practices for internal logistics operations, product flow optimization, packaging specifications, and material handling systems to drive consistency, safety, and efficiency across the organization.</li> <li>Prepare, manage, and own the annual logistics budget for all inbound and outbound transportation spend, including forecasting, variance analysis, and strategic recommendations to optimize resource allocation.</li> <li>Serve as the primary escalation point for complex logistics issues, leading root-cause analysis, implementing corrective and preventive actions, and driving accountability with both carriers and internal stakeholders to minimize disruption and improve long-term performance.</li> </ul> <p><strong>BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Bachelor’s degree in supply chain, logistics, business, engineering, or a related field.</li> <li>5+ years of demonstrated experience developing and improving KPI frameworks and carrier performance management programs.</li> <li>5+ years of experience leading sourcing strategy, carrier negotiations, and partnership management.</li> <li>5+ years of proven people management experience, including leading, developing, and supporting logistics teams.</li> </ul> <p><strong>PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:</strong></p> <ul> <li>7+ years of experience managing complex international and domestic inbound and outbound logistics networks, fulfillment networks, or global transportation operations.</li> <li>Proven track record of scaling logistics operations and network capacity by 10x or more.</li> <li>Experience leveraging network size and shipment volume to optimize spend and improve competitive advantage.</li> <li>Proven track record expanding logistics networks to support freight, e-commerce, and industrial/manufacturing projects.</li> <li>Strong background in 3PL/4PL management, freight forwarding and ocean/air/domestic, with proven ability to manage and leverage relationships to scale operations, accelerate solution delivery, and drive strong network performance.</li> <li>Experience with ITAR, C-TPAT, HTS/Schedule B, Incoterms, and international compliance.</li> <li>Proficiency with MRP/ERP systems, logistics platforms, and data analytics tools.</li> <li>Excellent analytical, communication, and cross-functional leadership skills.</li> <li>Experience supporting high-growth or high-mix manufacturing environments.<br>Experience developing and supporting complex global logistics networks and supply chains.</li> <li>Experience with procurement and development of solutions for freight, warehousing, e-commerce, and special project services.</li> <li>Experience managing logistics compliance and regulatory requirements.</li> <li>Experience preparing and managing logistics budgets and driving cost reduction initiatives.</li> <li>Strong analytical skills with experience using data to measure network health, carrier performance, and operational efficiency.</li> <li>Experience working cross-functionally with Supply Chain, Procurement, Finance, Tax and Operations teams.</li> </ul> <p><strong><span title: Manager, Supply Chain (Starship)
jd_text: <div class="content-intro"><p>SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of&nbsp;enabling human life on Mars.</p></div><p><strong>MANAGER, SUPPLY CHAIN (STARSHIP)</strong></p> <p>The SpaceX supply chain organization is critical to Starship's mission. To capitalize on SpaceX’s technological and market-changing successes, our team will help manage an agile yet robust supply chain that enables the company's competitive advantage. The department includes procurement, planning and fulfillment, supplier development and quality, logistics, and inventory. SpaceX's supply chain will play a key role in enabling it to meet ambitious growth targets and help make us a multi-planetary species.</p> <p>The Manager of Supply Chain at SpaceX is responsible for defining and implementing policies and strategies for near- and mid-term sourcing results. The incumbent will make strategic decisions that impact the department and have broad influence across SpaceX organizations. Success in this role will require strong communication skills, sourcing intuition and best practices, and commodity management experience to systematically grow and mature SpaceX suppliers into strategic partners.</p> <p><strong>RESPONSIBILITIES</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Team Leadership:</strong></li> <ul> <li>Manage the Starship team of Supply Chain Sourcing Managers and Specialists. Lead, direct, and review the teams' work, spending substantial time on people management responsibilities. Responsible for defining the structure of the teams and providing mentorship and strategic development planning for first- and second-level direct reports</li> <li>Manage the team by providing clear direction that aligns with the strategy and priorities of the company</li> <li>Hire, develop, and retain top talent to meet current and future business needs</li> <li>Demonstrate innovation, technical excellence, attention to detail, self-direction, &amp; courage</li> <li>Develop and enhance transactional processes to gain organizational efficiency</li> <li>Manage KPIs, including inventory and spend to match program targets</li> <li>Ensure accurate system signals, including accuracy of demand signals (so that they match program rate), BOMs, upstream and downstream lead times, etc.</li> </ul> <li><strong>Supplier Development:</strong></li> <ul> <li>Manage vendor relationships and grow the supply base as needed in alignment with the broader team sourcing strategy</li> <li>Assess supplier capabilities, technologies, and their ability to execute component/assembly manufacturing requirements successfully. Manage validation exercises to demonstrate initial feasibility through full-scale production of transferred work</li> <li>Manage supplier improvement programs. Drive improvements utilizing Lean methodologies, supplier scorecards, and supplier audits, ensuring supplier compliance while driving systematic problem-solving and process improvement plans to deliver value</li> <li>Provide program leadership necessary to ensure that product quality, delivery, and cost achieve business and customer expectations</li> <li>Interface with Starship teams to prioritize supplier development needs by commodity to improve cost competitiveness or supply constraints</li> <li>Drive supplier selection through robust qualification processes</li> <li>Deliver results as measured by key metrics such as part yield, cost, defect rate, etc.&nbsp;</li> </ul> <li><strong>Self-Management &amp; Relationship Management:</strong></li> <ul> <li>Be assertive, optimistic, resilient, and welcoming of change</li> <li>Engages interest and participation of others and has a collaborative approach to working together</li> <li>Contribute to the team proactively</li> <li>Be self-aware and able to work on own initiative</li> <li>Show moral courage, openness and honesty in all dealings</li> <li>Develops and maintain strong relationships with internal and external stakeholders to ensure optimal performance</li> <li>Communicate efficiently across internal and external stakeholders</li> <li>Take a diplomatic approach to relationships</li> </ul> </ul> <p><strong>BASIC QUALIFICATIONS</strong></p> <ul> <li>Advanced degree and 4+ years of experience working in one or more of the following; or bachelor’s degree and 6+ years of experience working in one or more of the following; or 10+ years of experience working in one or more of the following:</li> <ul> <li>Engineering</li> <li>Purchasing</li> <li>Contract negotiation</li> <li>Material or production planning</li> <li>Operations or supply chain management</li> <li>Material cost control</li> <li>Master production scheduling</li> </ul> <li>2+ years of experience in personnel management with formal direct reports</li> </ul> <p><strong>PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCES</strong></p> <ul> <li>Familiarity or experience working with aerospace components</li> <li>Strong ability to read drawings and blueprints, with an understanding of manufacturing complexity</li> <li>Experience with technical procurement, manufacturing, or designing production components</li> <li>APICS certification</li> <li>Lean Six Sigma certification</li> <li>Ability to prove a strong track record of leadership and team building</li> <li>Remarkable problem-solving skills with a bias for speed and positive impact</li> <li>Ability to learn quickly and prioritize appropriately to meet customer and company needs</li> <li>Exceptional analytical and organizational skills</li> <li>Excellent customer service skills, produce exceptional work at all times, highly self-motivated</li> <li>Effective written, verbal, and presentation communication skills</li> <li>Strong technical knowledge and skills in current technologies and applications (e.g., MS Office Suite, SQL, Power BI, etc.)</li> <li>Detail-oriented and able to respond quickly to a fast-moving and ever-changing environment</li> <li>Holds themselves to the highest ethical standards and conducts all activities with the highest integrity</li> </ul> <p><strong>ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS</strong></p> <ul> <li>Must be able to pass an Air Force background check for Cape Canaveral</li> <li>Must be able to travel - up to 50% of the work week; travel may be required, including international travel</li> <li>Must be able to work extended hours and/or weekends as needed to meet major milestones</li> <li>This position is based in Starbase, TX, and requires being onsite; remote work is not considered</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong>ITAR REQUIREMENTS:</strong></p> <ul> <li>To conform to U.S. Government export regulations, applicant must be a (i) U.S. citizen or national, (ii) U.S. lawful, permanent resident (aka green card holder), (iii) Refugee under 8 U.S.C. § 1157, or (iv) Asylee under 8 U.S.C. § 1158, or be eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State. Learn more about the ITAR <a href="https://www.pmddtc.state.gov/?id=ddtc_kb_article_page&amp;sys_id=24d528fddbfc930044f9ff621f961987">here</a>. &nbsp;</li> </ul> <p>SpaceX is an Equal Opportunity Employer; employment with SpaceX is governed on the basis of merit, competence and qualifications and will not be influenced in any manner by race, color, religion, gender, national origin/ethnicity, veteran status, disability status, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, mental or physical disability or any other legally protected status.</p> <p>Applicants wishing to view a copy of SpaceX’s Affirmative Action Plan for veterans and individuals with disabilities, or applicants requiring reasonable accommodation to the application/interview process should reach out to&nbsp;<a href="mailto:EEOCompliance@spacex.com">EEOCompliance@spacex.com</a><em>.&nbsp;</em></p></div>

title: Manufacturing Engineer, Supply Chain (Starship)
jd_text: <div class="content-intro"><p>SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of&nbsp;enabling human life on Mars.</p></div><p><span data-teams="true"><strong>MANUFACTURING ENGINEER, SUPPLY CHAIN (STARSHIP)</strong></span></p> <p>SpaceX demands a new type of supply chain. We require our suppliers to provide premium quality with rapidly evolving designs at increasingly ambitious volumes. We are actively looking for candidates who possess comprehensive knowledge of manufacturing and quality tools and have unrelenting motivation to enable suppliers for success. This position will support our Starship program and requires a combination of proven leadership and technical capabilities.</p> <p>This is a highly technical position that requires practical experience in manufacturing engineering and new product development through to stabilized production for an array of fabrication processes (components and assemblies) used in rockets and rocket engines.&nbsp;The ideal candidate will have a broad and thorough understanding of propulsion/fluid system component fabrication including extrusions, draw forming, welded and seamless tubing, cutting, and assembly, along with associated processes. This candidate should have the desire and capability to take on new challenges in unfamiliar areas to help enable our mission to Mars.</p> <p><strong>RESPONSIBILITIES:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Serve as the technical point of contact for assigned parts and assemblies of the rocket, solving emergent challenges at suppliers, and mitigating risk to the manifest by addressing high-impact manufacturing and quality challenges</li> <li>Own the new product introduction of new assemblies on the rocket, including determining the ideal manufacturing method, identifying suppliers, and developing a reliable process for ramping to rate. This individual is expected to be the extreme owner for the process at suppliers for new parts, drawing changes, or when re-sourcing existing parts to a new supplier</li> <li>Conduct design for manufacturing (DFM) reviews to ensure parts are manufacturable at early stages, preferably prior to sourcing</li> <li>Work with procurement to find exceptional suppliers and vet them appropriately for quality and ability to meet our aggressive takt times</li> <li>Create and develop specifications as needed to flow down quality and manufacturing requirements to the supply base</li> <li>Scope out new forming, cutting, and inspection technologies and suppliers that may be employed to improve rate/quality/efficiency</li> <li>Review issues on assigned parts and solve to the root cause, implementing changes at the supplier, at SpaceX or both, as appropriate, drive further actions to closure, and re-source to new suppliers where appropriate</li> <li>Create and disposition issue tickets where needed, working with engineering counterparts to implement, but not limited to, required re-work, repair or use as-is disposition</li> <li>Become thoroughly familiar with your assigned parts and the processes that make up the overall assembly and become the primary point of contact for supply chain related defects on your parts</li> <li>Demonstrate innovation, technical excellence, attention to detail, self-direction and courage to push the technical envelope which is conventionally held in the industry.</li> <li>Lead containment activities on assigned parts, working with cross-functional counterparts to agree on scope, path forward and ultimate resolution</li> </ul> <p><strong>BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Bachelor’s degree in an engineering discipline&nbsp;</li> <li>1+ years of experience with manufacturing and/or inspection of mechanical products in a production environment</li> </ul> <p><strong>PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Master’s degree in engineering or business</li> <li>Fundamental understanding of propulsion/fluid systems and the respective component manufacturing processes including: raw materials, draw forming, extrusions, seamless and welded tubing, pipe manufacturing, bending, welding, proof/pressure testing, and other forming &amp; assembly processes.</li> <li>Fundamental understanding of sheet metal forming, cutting, and assembly processes, particularly in stretch forming (longitudinal and transverse), stamping (progressing and transfer), spin forming, roll forming, roll bending, press brake forming, hydroforming and tube forming/bending of primarily, but not limited to, stainless and carbon steels.</li> <li>Experience with machining and ancillary operations such as milling, turning, and tube cutting of materials</li> <li>Experience with engineering drawings, modeling, GD&amp;T, etc.</li> <li>General familiarity with welding (TIG, MIG and orbital tube welding) of stainless and carbon steels is a plus</li> <li>Knowledge of supplier quality processes (production part approval process, advanced product quality planning, first article inspection reports, etc.)</li> <li>Knowledge of statistical techniques and methods, e.g., design of experiments, Lean, Six Sigma, etc.</li> <li>Experience with quality systems (ISO 9000/TS/AS9100/NADCAP) and MRP/ERP systems</li> <li>Disciplined approach to problem solving - 8D</li> <li>Proficient in MS Office and Excel applications and report writing</li> <li>Experience with sharing information and influencing others across organizational lines, internally and externally</li> <li>Experience with PPAP and related elements (PFD, PFMEA, control plan, process capability, etc.)</li> <li>Experience leading containments of discrepant product</li> <li>Experience in manufacturing with different grades of stainless steel</li> </ul> <p><strong>ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Ability to work extended hours, some nights and/or weekends when needed</li> <li>Ability to travel: up to 40-50% work week travel</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong>ITAR REQUIREMENTS:</strong></p> <ul> <li>To conform to U.S. Government export regulations, applicant must be a (i) U.S. citizen or national, (ii) U.S. lawful, permanent resident (aka green card holder), (iii) Refugee under 8 U.S.C. § 1157, or (iv) Asylee under 8 U.S.C. § 1158, or be eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State. Learn more about the ITAR <a href="https://www.pmddtc.state.gov/?id=ddtc_kb_article_page&amp;sys_id=24d528fddbfc930044f9ff621f961987">here</a>. &nbsp;</li> </ul> <p>SpaceX is an Equal Opportunity Employer; employment with SpaceX is governed on the basis of merit, competence and qualifications and will not be influenced in any manner by race, color, religion, gender, national origin/ethnicity, veteran status, disability status, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, mental or physical disability or any other legally protected status.</p> <p>Applicants wishing to view a copy of SpaceX’s Affirmative Action Plan for veterans and individuals with disabilities, or applicants requiring reasonable accommodation to the application/interview process should reach out to&nbsp;<a href="mailto:EEOCompliance@spacex.com">EEOCompliance@spacex.com</a><em>.&nbsp;</em></p></div>

title: Sr. Supply Chain Planner, xAI (Starlink)
jd_text: <div class="content-intro"><p>SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of&nbsp;enabling human life on Mars.</p></div><p><strong>SR. SUPPLY CHAIN PLANNER, XAI (STARLINK)</strong></p> <p>As a member of the Starlink Supply Chain Planning team you will support an elite group of engineers and supply chain professional to establish and maintain the signals that drive the business and enable production of the Starlink satellite constellation. Our team moves quickly and you must too. SpaceX has the unique ability and desire to influence and shape suppliers to be better with us as we challenge our supply chain on cost, quality, and speed of execution. This role’s scope will help develop the factory of the future.</p> <p><strong>RESPONSIBILITIES:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Maintain accuracy and audit bill of materials in MRP systems in preparation for production at rate</li> <li>Establish/Manage inventory level targets, review line of balances, align demand supply signals and allocations, maintain product master data, and develop expertise in in-house systems and reports</li> <li>Mitigate risk and ensure continuity of supply by constructing and executing a well-thought-out supply plan that fulfills the needs of the product on time and with quality</li> <li>Be an expert in MRP, triage the signals/understand the matrix, then apply your knowledge to educate the teams we support in the proper use of MRP and its benefit to the business</li> <li>Coordinate with engineering, production, and quality organizations to determine change cut in and reduce obsolescence of material and eliminate/reduce quality issues</li> <li>Partner with internal stakeholders on implementing advanced supply chain strategies for risk mitigations like long-term purchases and strategic safety stock</li> <li>Proactively manage inventory, and prevent stock outs while optimizing the utilization of SpaceX working capital</li> <li>Develop and maintain good relationships with manufacturing, engineering, and supply chain teams to enable the mission</li> <li>Ensure compliance with all company policies and procedures and government regulations</li> <li>Proactively update SpaceX management and engineering teams on all critical supply issues</li> <li>Analyze supply chain data and report metrics around the health of MRP and the businesses execution against it</li> </ul> <p><strong>BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Bachelor’s degree and 2+ years of experience working in one or more of the following; or 3+ years of experience working in one or more of the following:</li> <ul> <li>Engineering</li> <li>Purchasing</li> <li>Contract negotiation</li> <li>Material or production planning</li> <li>Operations or supply chain management</li> <li>Material cost control</li> <li>Master production scheduling</li> </ul> </ul> <p><strong>PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Technical knowledge in a commodity – for example, machining, sheet metal fabrication, tube bending and assembly, weldment assembly, soft goods etc.</li> <li>Proven success working on cross-functional new product introduction projects, completing cost models, and negotiating</li> <li>Familiarity with ERP systems and purchasing/planning functions</li> <li>SQL Experience</li> <li>PowerBI experience</li> <li>Advanced skills in MS Excel and Project, able to create pivot tables or macros, and analyze data</li> title: Sr. Technical Project Lead (Silicon Engineering)
jd_text: <div class="content-intro"><p>SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of&nbsp;enabling human life on Mars.</p></div><p class="ms-outlook-mobile-reference-message"><strong>SR. TECHNICAL PROJECT LEAD (SILICON ENGINEERING)</strong></p> <p>At SpaceX we’re leveraging our experience in building rockets and spacecraft to deploy Starlink, the world’s most advanced broadband internet system. Starlink is the world’s largest satellite constellation and is providing fast, reliable internet to millions of users worldwide. We design, build, test, and operate all parts of the system – thousands of satellites, consumer receivers that allow users to connect within minutes of unboxing, and the software that brings it all together. We’ve only begun to scratch the surface of Starlink’s potential global impact and are looking for best-in-class engineers to help maximize Starlink’s utility for communities and businesses around the globe.&nbsp;</p> <p>We are seeking a motivated, proactive, and intellectually curious engineer who will work alongside world-class cross-disciplinary teams (systems, firmware, architecture, design, validation, product engineering, ASIC implementation). In this role, you will be developing cutting-edge next-generation ASICs for deployment in space and ground infrastructures around the globe. SpaceX's supply chain will play a key role in enabling SpaceX to meet these ambitious growth targets and greatly contribute to making humans a multi-planetary species.</p> <p><strong>RESPONSIBILITIES:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Establish and lead a new, lean natural gas trading team responsible for originating, structuring, and executing physical and financial natural gas transactions to support SpaceX’s growing power and fuel needs.</li> <li>Develop and execute directional, spread, physical, and financial trading strategies for natural gas to reduce supply risk, ensure on-time delivery, and align with company strategy.</li> <li>Identify pricing inefficiencies, market distortions, and opportunities across tenors, hubs, pipelines, storage, and products; generate and manage profit and loss statement (P&amp;L).</li> <li>Manage trading positions in response to fundamental, technical, weather-driven, fuel/emissions, regulatory, and operational signals.</li> <li>Maintain strong discipline in position development, risk management, and trade execution.</li> <li>Act as a market intelligence provider on natural gas categories, pipelines, storage, power purchase agreements, cryogenic commodities, and related markets.</li> <li>Benchmark, track, and analyze performance metrics, P&amp;L, sourcing/trading trends, and results against budget/targets on a regular basis to demonstrate continuous improvement and progress against strategic objectives.</li> <li>Recruit, mentor, and scale a small high-performing team of traders and analysts; set clear performance standards and foster a culture of ownership, speed and accountability. Manage the trading floor transactions to ensure operational requirements and financial goals are met.</li> <li>Develop and maintain key internal stakeholder relationships (engineering, finance, legal) and external relationships with counterparties, brokers, suppliers, and market participants to evaluate sourcing/trading models, optimize value, support deal flow, and ensure continuity of supply.</li> <li>Conduct comprehensive market, supplier, and counterparty analysis to formulate strategic plans that identify new sources, optimize cost models, and proactively ensure supply continuity for upcoming production, launch, and new product introduction campaigns.</li> <li>Execute requests for information (RFIs), requests for proposal (RFPs), bid events, and negotiations; administer multimillion-dollar contracts and independently negotiate terminology, pricing, technical/scope requirements, terms involving responsibility, liability, indemnification, intellectual property, export compliance, and risk allocation.</li> <li>Build a team responsible for scheduling, planning and model enhancement, supply/demand analysis (factoring regional and global dynamics), and broader desk/strategy development. Mentor junior team members as appropriate.</li> <li>Ensure all trading and sourcing activities are conducted within appropriate authorities, risk guidelines/controls, compliance/regulatory frameworks (including applicable CFTC/FERC or equivalent), and company policies. Maintain highest ethical standards and integrity.</li> </ul> <p><strong>BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Bachelor’s degree and 4+ years of experience working in:</li> <ul> <li>Natural gas or energy commodity trading</li> <li>Material cost control / energy markets analysis</li> <li>Engineering or finance related to energy commodities</li> </ul> </ul> <p><strong>PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Strong knowledge of US (and/or global) natural gas markets, including experience with pipeline/storage optimization, physical and financial trading, hubs, and related infrastructure.</li> <li>Understanding of utilities, power purchase agreements, pipelines, cryogenic commodities, gas system equipment, LNG, or oil &amp; gas sector.</li> <li>Demonstrable track record of trading P&amp;L generation, commercial impact, or significant cost savings/supply optimization in natural gas or related energy markets.</li> <li>Established relationships with market counterparties, brokers, suppliers in the oil/gas/power sector, and experience with deal development/structured opportunities.</li> <li>Strong analytical and problem-solving skills; proficiency analyzing large datasets with advanced Excel, SQL, PowerBI, and preferably Python or similar tools.</li> <li>Firm understanding of risk management, position management, and regulatory frameworks applicable to natural gas markets.</li> <li>Experience sourcing/trading from a global supply base using various contractual models; strong budget tracking and cost analytical skills.</li> <li>Experience with trade capture systems (e.g., Endur or similar) is a plus.</li> </ul> <p><strong>ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Must be able to travel – up to 50% work week travel may be required, including international travel.</li> <li>Must be able to work extended hours and/or weekends as needed to meet major milestones; flexibility and availability to support trading/operational activities (including potential 24/7 market coverage as required).</li> <li>This position is based in Starbase, TX and requires being on-site – remote work not considered.</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong>ITAR REQUIREMENTS:</strong></p> <ul> <li>To conform to U.S. Government export regulations, applicant must be a (i) U.S. citizen or national, (ii) U.S. lawful, permanent resident (aka green card holder), (iii) Refugee under 8 U.S.C. § 1157, or (iv) Asylee under 8 U.S.C. § 1158, or be eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State. jd_text: <div class="content-intro"><p>SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of&nbsp;enabling human life on Mars.</p></div><p><strong>APPLICATION SOFTWARE ENGINEER, MANUFACTURING SYSTEMS </strong></p> <p>The application software team is the central nervous system of SpaceX – we create mission critical applications that are used throughout SpaceX to accelerate launch vehicle production and flight as well as systems that allow Starlink to grow into a worldwide fast, reliable Internet service. We are looking for engineers who treat fellow teammates with fairness, respect, and support.</p> <p>Our team is currently creating and evolving systems to enable rapid build and reuse of Starship as well as designing the next generation manufacturing software that will be used in high throughput factories for Starlink. Other applications range from platforms that support concurrent streams of data from many always-on assets to manage the world’s largest satellite constellation to public facing systems where customers can join our Starlink network globally. We work closely with engineers throughout the company to create and update our systems with respect to crewed launches, Starship flights, changes to the Starlink network and much more.</p> <p>Aerospace experience is not required to be successful here - rather we look for smart, motivated, respectful, collaborative engineers who love solving problems and want to make an impact on a super inspiring mission. You will have full ownership of challenging problems, working with a team of enthusiastic engineers with diverse perspectives to design and produce solutions that enable SpaceX to move towards our goals at a rapid pace. The success of the missions at SpaceX depends on the software that you and your team produce.</p> <p><strong>RESPONSIBILITIES:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Develop highly reliable software solutions that are used across SpaceX</li> <li>Create new applications that improve how SpaceX operates</li> <li>Build prototypes to prove out key design concepts and quantify technical constraints</li> <li>Own all aspects of software engineering and product development</li> <li>Deep dive into your users’ problems to find and create efficient solutions</li> <li>Bring your voice to the table in team collaborations on architecture, design, and code reviews</li> </ul> <p><strong>BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, math, or scientific discipline; OR 2+ years of professional experience building software in lieu of a degree</li> <li>Experience in full stack development</li> </ul> <p><strong>PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:</strong></p> <ul> <li>1+ years of experience building single page web applications</li> <li>Programming experience in Python, C#.NET, Go, Scala, Java, or similar object-oriented language</li> <li>Experience with version control, continuous integration, and continuous delivery concepts</li> <li>Expertise in designing software systems</li> <li>Deep understanding of testing, continuous integration, build, deployment &amp; monitoring</li> <li>Expertise in profiling and improving application performance</li> <li>Experience with build systems (Make, Bazel/Pants/Buck, Gradle) and package management tools (pip, npm)</li> <li>Experience with UNIX-like operating systems and tools like Terraform, Ansible, Puppet for managing them</li> <li>Experience working with in-stream data processing&nbsp;using Apache Kafka, RabbitMQ, ActiveMQ, or similar technologies</li> <li>Production experience with Docker and Kubernetes</li> <li>Front-end experience in Angular, React, or similar JavaScript framework</li> <li>Database experience with PostgreSQL, SQL Server, or similar database technologies</li> </ul> <p><strong>ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Must be willing to work extended hours and weekends as needed</li> <li>This role requires you to be onsite. Remote and/or hybrid work will not be considered</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong>ITAR REQUIREMENTS:</strong></p> <ul> <li>To conform to U.S. Government export regulations, applicant must be a (i) U.S. citizen or national, (ii) U.S. lawful, permanent resident (aka green card holder), (iii) Refugee under 8 U.S.C. § 1157, or (iv) Asylee under 8 U.S.C. § 1158, or be eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State. title: Avionics Systems Engineer (Starship)
jd_text: <div class="content-intro"><p>SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of&nbsp;enabling human life on Mars.</p></div><p><strong>AVIONICS SYSTEMS ENGINEER (STARSHIP)</strong></p> <p>As a Starship Avionics Systems &amp; Operations Engineer, you will have the unique opportunity to be part of a cross-functional team that bridges the gap between vehicle analysis, design, production and vehicle operations.</p> <p>The Starship Avionics Team is responsible for cradle to grave ownership of Starship vehicle avionics as the vehicle is built, tested, launched, recovered and re-launched. This includes development of new capabilities, electrical design of vehicle architecture, repair of electrical components, and troubleshooting of avionics subsystems including power distribution, vehicle network, onboard sensors, actuators, compute, RF, and video.</p> <p><strong>RESPONSIBILITIES:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Represent the Starship avionics system throughout all stages of integration, from production and test all the way through GO for launch&nbsp;</li> <li>Triage, troubleshoot, root cause, and repair electrical hardware issues on an aggressive production schedule. Drive future improvements to minimize prevent reoccurrence</li> <li>Support vehicle pad and flight operations as avionics operator responsible for evaluating vehicle health, resolving issues real time, and recommending path forward</li> <li>Contribute to new avionics vehicle architectures that minimize mass, cost, and labor through collaboration with adjacent teams and supporting analysis</li> </ul> <p><strong>BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Bachelor’s degree in an engineering field, science, or math</li> <li>1+ years of experience with electrical component design, system level integration of electronic components or system level testing</li> <li>1+ years of experience using software tools such as Matlab, C++ or Python</li> </ul> <p><strong>PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Competence with electrical test equipment (multimeters, oscilloscopes, power supplies, etc.)</li> <li>Creative problem solving that can bring multiple disciplines together with the ability to assess risk and make design/development decisions without all available data</li> <li>Experience troubleshooting sensors, actuators, and electrical components</li> <li>Experience with 3D CAD software</li> <li>Software fluency, enabling automation of test or analysis tasks</li> <li>Self-motivated with strong multi-tasking, organizational and communication skills</li> <li>Ability to work in a fast paced, autonomously driven, and demanding atmosphere</li> <li>Operations experience in flight test, piloting aircraft, or controlling other high consequence systems in real time</li> </ul> <p><strong>ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Extended hours and weekend work frequently required to support critical project and mission milestones</li>
