title: Sr. Embedded Software Engineer, OS/Platform (Starlink)
jd_text: <div class="content-intro"><p>SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of&nbsp;enabling human life on Mars.</p></div><div> <div> <p><strong>SR. EMBEDDED SOFTWARE ENGINEER, OS/PLATFORM (STARLINK)</strong></p> <p>At SpaceX, we’re leveraging our experience in building rockets and spacecraft to deploy Starlink, the world’s most advanced broadband internet system. Starlink is the world’s largest satellite constellation and is providing fast, reliable internet to millions of users worldwide. We design, build, test, and operate all parts of the system – thousands of satellites, consumer receivers that allow users to connect within minutes of unboxing, and the software that brings it all together. We’ve only begun to scratch the surface of Starlink’s potential global impact and are looking for best-in-class engineers to help maximize Starlink’s utility for communities and businesses around the globe.</p> <p>As a Sr. Embedded Software Engineer on the Starlink program, you will be solving challenges underpinning every aspect of the program’s growth. The areas you could have an impact on could include, but are not limited to:</p> <ul> <li>Bringing up next generation space grade silicon, including in house designed system on chip and peripherals.</li> <li>Develop software from the early stage boot loaders to business logic with an emphasis on deterministic, secure, and performant platform for all of SpaceX Linux based spacecraft and grounds-based components.</li> <li>Infrastructure and tools to enable rapid development and testing of new features for all OS/platform features.</li> </ul> <p>Our software engineers are responsible for the complete lifecycle of the software they create, including development, testing, and support.</p> <p><strong>RESPONSIBILITIES:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Maintain and update in house branches of OSS software such as Linux, Buildroot, and u-boot</li> <li>Support secureboot and runtime security of all Linux based satellite components</li> <li>Maintain the spacecraft Ethernet network and connectivity</li> <li>Develop, deploy and test spacecraft software update process</li> <li>Support in-house System on Chip and peripheral through the life-cycle of the part</li> <li>Support OS/Platform specific test infrastructure</li> <li>Development and support device drivers for third party and in-house components</li> <li>Be the first software team to receive new satellite components</li> <li>Interface with Silicon, Electrical, and Application Software Engineers to bring hardware from prototype stage to on on-orbit operations</li> </ul> <p><strong>BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Bachelor’s degree in computer science, engineering, math, or a STEM discipline and 5+ years of professional experience in software engineering; OR 7+ years of professional experience in software development in lieu of a degree</li> <li>Development experience in C, C++, python and/or rust</li> </ul> <p><strong>PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Linux Kernel Up streamed patches preferred</li> <li>Knowledge of networking and Linux networking stack&nbsp;</li> <li>Good knowledge of computer architecture and modern secure boot flows&nbsp;</li> <li>Experience with ARM embedded system</li> <li>Deep understanding of testing, continuous integration, build, deployment &amp; continuous monitoring</li> <li>Creative approach to problem solving, exceptional analytical skills and engineering fundamentals</li> <li>Strong skills in debugging, performance optimization, and unit testing</li> <li>Excellent communication skills both written and verbal</li> <li>Ability to work effectively in a dynamic environment with changing needs and requirements</li> </ul> <p><strong>ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Must be willing to work extended hours and weekends as needed</li> </ul> </div> </div><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong>ITAR REQUIREMENTS:</strong></p> <ul> <li>To conform to U.S. Government export regulations, applicant must be a (i) U.S. citizen or national, (ii) U.S. lawful, permanent resident (aka green card holder), (iii) Refugee under 8 U.S.C. § 1157, or (iv) Asylee under 8 U.S.C. § 1158, or be eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State. title: Sr. Fluids Systems Engineer, Solar Cell Factory (Starlink)
jd_text: <div class="content-intro"><p>SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of&nbsp;enabling human life on Mars.</p></div><p><strong>SR. FLUIDS SYSTEMS ENGINEER, SOLAR CELL FACTORY (STARLINK)</strong></p> <p>The Solar Cell team is revolutionizing power generation for space applications through advanced solar cell manufacturing. We're scaling production of high-efficiency solar cells to support sustainable energy solutions for Starlink constellations, launch vehicles, and beyond. As a Sr. Solar Cell Factory Fluids Engineer, you will design, build, and optimize fluid systems for the delivery of critical gases and chemicals in solar cell fabrication. This role requires a detail-oriented engineer passionate about safe handling of hazardous materials in a high-volume manufacturing environment, ensuring reliable supply to processes like vacuum deposition and etching while minimizing risks and maximizing efficiency in our cutting-edge solar cell factory.</p> <p><strong>RESPONSIBILITIES:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Design, build, and activate fluids systems for the distribution of key gases (e.g. specialty and bulk gases), chemicals (e.g., hydrofluoric acid, solvents) and exhaust systems used in solar cell processes, including tanks, pumps, heat exchangers, gas panels, valves, scrubbers, and abatement systems</li> <li>Cradle-to-grave project ownership including requirement definition, design, justification of key decisions, equipment procurement, build coordination, commissioning and project management throughout</li> <li>Design modular systems capable of being manufactured at scale for future solar production facilities</li> <li>Apply fluids/mechanical engineering skills such as P&amp;ID development, equipment sizing, detailed fluid and thermal analysis, system-level CONOP development, structural analysis, materials and component selection.</li> <li>Perform safety/hazard assessments (ex. FMEAs, HAZOPs) to ensure appropriate hazardous system design, including emergency shutdown CONOPs, redundancy, and general compliance with hazardous material safety standards</li> <li>Design, build, and deploy data acquisition and control systems for fluid facilities control and monitoring</li> <li>Collaborate with process engineers to integrate fluid systems with manufacturing equipment and optimize delivery rates, purity levels, and recovery/recycling of process fluids to support high-yield production</li> <li>Support installation, commissioning, and troubleshooting of fluid systems, working closely with facilities operations, EHS, automation, and procurement teams to resolve issues and implement improvements</li> <li>Ensure regulatory compliance with OSHA, EPA, ASME, NFPA, and SEMI standards for chemical and gas handling in semiconductor-like environments</li> <li>Track system performance metrics (e.g., flow rates, contamination levels, downtime) and contribute to continuous improvement initiatives, such as lean manufacturing and sustainability efforts for fluid reuse</li> </ul> <p><strong>BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Bachelor’s degree in mechanical engineering, chemical engineering, aerospace engineering, or other engineering discipline</li> <li>5+ years of professional fluids systems design experience&nbsp;</li> </ul> <p><strong>PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Advanced degree in engineering or related field</li> <li>2+ years of experience in fluid systems design, particularly with gases or hazardous chemicals in manufacturing or semiconductor industries</li> <li>2+ years of experience in photovoltaic, semiconductor, or thin-film deposition manufacturing</li> <li>Knowledge of safety protocols for handling pyrophoric materials (e.g., silane) and toxic gases/chemicals (e.g., phosphine, HF)</li> <li>Knowledge of ASME B31.3, SEMI S2/S8 standards and experience with cleanroom HVAC integration for fluid systems</li> <li>Familiarity with cleanroom fluid systems, gas cabinets, scrubbers, and wastewater neutralization for solar cell fabrication</li> <li>Familiarity with air separation units (ASUs) for gaseous nitrogen production.</li> <li>Certification in process safety (e.g., CSP, Six Sigma Green Belt) or hazardous materials handling</li> <li>Proficiency in fluid dynamics software (e.g., ANSYS Fluent, Pipe-Flo) and CAD tools (e.g., AutoCAD, SolidWorks) for system modeling and diagramming</li> <li>Experience with process safety management, including risk title: Sr. IC Packaging Test Engineer, Silicon Technology (Starlink)
jd_text: <div class="content-intro"><p>SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of&nbsp;enabling human life on Mars.</p></div><p><strong>Sr. IC PACKAGING TEST ENGINEER, SILICON TECHNOLOGY (STARLINK)</strong></p> <p>Starlink believes in providing fast, reliable internet to those that need it most. We design, build, and launch the world's largest and most advanced satellite constellation that is capable of delivering high-speed internet to even the most remote locations. We also design, build, and ship the hardware that sits in the homes of our customers all around the world. And while our hardware and network are incredibly advanced, we keep the end-user experience impressively simple - our customers have internet within 10 minutes of unboxing.</p> <p>In true SpaceX fashion, Starlink is taking the next step in vertical integration by bringing integrated circuit packaging and assembly in-house for development and manufacturing. We are looking for talented hands-on and dynamic test engineers with expertise in semiconductor packaging and wafer test. You will work closely with test equipment manufacturers and in-house chip &amp; system designers to develop and release production test solutions. title: Sr. Manager, Starlink Enterprise Accounts (Civilian Government Programs)
jd_text: <div class="content-intro"><p>SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of&nbsp;enabling human life on Mars.</p></div><p><strong>SR. MANAGER, STARLINK ENTERPRISE ACCOUNTS (CIVILIAN GOVERNMENT PROGRAMS)</strong></p> <p>Starlink, our revolutionary satellite constellation, is delivering low-latency broadband internet around the world. As a leader on the Starlink Enterprise Accounts team, you will develop and manage a team that is responsible for delighting Starlink Federal Civilian government customers at scale. You and the team will be responsible for managing enterprise contracts to rapidly drive realization of revenue, doing it scalably, and working closely with counterparts on Starlink cross-functionally. A key challenge will be driving a culture that both maximizes customer happiness, citizen onboarding and minimizes the input required by the team.</p> <p>The Enterprise Customer Success team serves as the point of contact for customers from contract signature, through successful activation, ensuring all contract terms are fulfilled while and identifying new opportunities to generate business with enterprise customers. Prior to contract signature, the team will have a key role in ensuring that the commitments we make are ones we can successfully execute to.</p> <p>In the past year, the Starlink team has signed contracts with Civilian government customers who deliver programs at a pace and for use cases previously not possible. The team has designed the product to be self-service, and we need to similarly evolve our team and systems to enable large organizations to deliver and scale Starlink in a programmatic way, minimizing humans-in-the-loop.</p> <p>Our ideal candidate is a self-starter that has a passion for making customers deliriously happy, building excellent teams, and managing complex cross-functional projects.</p> <p><strong>RESPONSIBILITIES:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Build, deliver, and rapidly implement strategy and growth plans for delivering Starlink to Civilian government programs</li> <li>Grow and build the enterprise account management function within Starlink</li> <ul> <li>Hire and lead an exceptional team</li> <li>Identify and build necessary tools and capabilities to manage accounts in jd_text: <div class="content-intro"><p>SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. SILICON PACKAGING PROCESS ENGINEER, SILICON TECHNOLOGY (STARLINK)</strong></p> <p>SpaceX is leveraging its experience in building rockets and spacecraft to deploy Starlink, the world’s most advanced broadband internet system. Starlink is the world’s largest satellite constellation and is providing fast, reliable internet to 4M+ users worldwide. We design, build, test, and operate all parts of the system – thousands of satellites, consumer receivers that allow users to connect within minutes of unboxing, and the software that brings it all together. We’ve only begun to scratch the surface of Starlink’s potential global impact. As we continue to upgrade and expand the constellation, we’re looking for best-in-class engineers to join the team.</p> <p>In true SpaceX fashion, Starlink is taking the next step in vertical integration by bringing integrated circuit packaging and assembly in-house for development and manufacturing. We are looking for hands-on and dynamic engineers with expertise in semiconductor packaging design, process development, equipment, and test. You will assume full ownership of packaging products and process modules and take them from concept to mass production as we strive to make Starlink more affordable to those who need it most.</p> <p><strong>RESPONSIBILITIES:&nbsp;&nbsp;</strong></p> <ul> <li>Own packaging assembly processes from concept to mass production including equipment and material selection for wafer-level and chip-level systems</li> <li>Develop new technologies and establish baselines for assembly and packaging including wafer grinding, wafer dicing, lithography, lamination, plating, etching, SMT, flip packaging lines</li> <li>Own packaging prototypes, product development and release to production</li> <li>Select equipment and material to meet quality, reliability, cost, yield, and production targets</li> <li>Interface with equipment and material suppliers including continuous improvement plans, cost reduction, and productivity improvements</li> <li>Cross-functional interface with IC design, materials, thermal, systems, and production teams</li> <li>Implement advanced packaging solutions into SpaceX next generation products</li> </ul> <p><strong>BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:&nbsp;</strong></p> <ul> <li>Bachelor’s degree in electrical engineering, mechanical engineering, chemical engineering, materials science, physics, or other applied engineering jd_text: <div class="content-intro"><p>SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. SITE RELIABILITY ENGINEER, PLATFORM INFRASTRUCTURE&nbsp;</strong></p> <p>The application software team is the central nervous system of SpaceX. Manufacturing is how SpaceX turns designs into hardware. The compute, storage, and networking that run our factories must be as reliable as the products we build. This team owns infrastructure supporting Starship, Starlink, Starshield, and Terafab. This position will have a direct impact on factory uptime, throughput, and production scale across programs.</p> <p>The ideal candidate has strong software engineering fundamentals and a passion for infrastructure: reliability, stability, proactive maintenance, and scalability. You understand the system before you change it, solve hard problems, communicate clearly with stakeholders and teammates, and take ownership of work that manufacturing depends on.</p> <p>Aerospace experience is not required. We value smart, motivated, collaborative engineers who treat teammates with fairness, respect, and support, and who want to take full ownership of challenging problems to help make humanity multi-planetary.</p> <p><strong>RESPONSIBILITIES:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Deploy, upgrade, operate, maintain, and scale compute, storage, and networking for manufacturing systems across Starship, Starlink, Starshield, and Terafab</li> <li>Manage infrastructure as code and use observability to provide a complete picture of platform health</li> <li>Design for reliability, stability, and scale; find and remove bottlenecks with measurement and engineering</li> <li>Practice proactive maintenance: capacity planning, lifecycle management, and reducing toil before it becomes an incident</li> <li>Partner with software engineers, manufacturing stakeholders, and site teams to build operable, maintainable systems</li> <li>Improve the full lifecycle—from design through deployment, operation, and continuous refinement</li> <li>Practice sustainable incident response and blameless postmortems</li> <li>Provide high-quality support to manufacturing and engineering users</li> <li>Communicate clearly with stakeholders and teammates</li> <li>Participate in on-call and travel to sites as needed for deployments, incidents, and cross-site reliability</li> </ul> <p><strong>BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Bachelor’s degree in computer science, information systems, or an engineering discipline; TECHNICAL RECRUITER</strong></p> <p><strong>RESPONSIBILITIES:</strong></p> <p>As a SpaceX recruiter, you will run a full desk with a variety of duties and responsibilities focused on the sourcing, simply go it alone, you are expected to show initiative, take responsibility, and run with tasks to completion.&nbsp;</p> <p>Your day-to-day routine will change often as hiring priorities shift, but there is a basic set of activities you can expect to run with daily, including, but not limited to:</p> <ul> <li>Meet with your client groups to discuss headcount, new requisitions, hiring strategy, and/or interview feedback – you truly act as a partner to your clients and not merely as an order taker</li> <li>Screen candidates who apply to requisitions – as the SpaceX name brand grows, our job postings continue to fill up with stellar candidates</li> <li>Source candidates – often the best candidates are the ones not actively looking</li> <li>Discuss candidates you have screened with your client groups and recommend top candidates for interviews</li> <li>Give tours to candidates before their onsite interview – this is a chance to showcase all the exciting things going on at SpaceX</li> <li>Attend interviews alongside your client groups to act as another set of eyes and ears in evaluating candidates</li> <li>Once candidates are approved for hire, you will begin the HR onboarding process including initiating background checks, completing reference checks, negotiating offer packages including extending offer letters, and issuing new hire paperwork – you’ll have plenty of support from the HR, benefits, and compensation departments to make this process as seamless as possible</li> </ul> <p>Some days you will have multiple candidates coming onsite for interviews and you will spend that time giving tours and coordinating the candidate experience.&nbsp;Other days, you will need to fill your candidate pipeline and will spend the majority of the day screening/sourcing candidates.&nbsp;No day is the same here and the pace moves fast, but ultimately your job is to effectively attract, organize, and manage the flow of the country’s most talented individuals to help advance the mission to Mars!</p> <p><strong>BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Bachelor’s degree and 5+ years of professional experience as a recruiter; or associate degree and 6+ years of of technical recruiting experience</li> <li>Experience recruiting electrical, mechanical, manufacturing and/or aerospace engineers</li> <li>Experience with high volume recruiting</li> <li>Experience with full life cycle recruiting (screening candidates, facilitating interviews and extending offers)</li> <li>Ability to distinguish between the top 50% and the top 5% of talent within their member</li> </ul> <p><strong>ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Available to work extended hours and weekends as needed</li> <li>This position is based in Starbase, Texas and requires being onsite 100% - remote or hybrid schedule not available</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong>ITAR REQUIREMENTS:</strong></p> <ul> <li>To conform to U.S. Government export title: Sr. Yield Engineer, RF Final Test Integration (Starlink/Akoustis)
jd_text: <div class="content-intro"><p>SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of&nbsp;enabling human life on Mars.</p></div><p><strong>SR.YIELD ENGINEER, RF FINAL TEST INTEGRATION (STARLINK/AKOUSTIS)</strong></p> <p>Akoustis is now operating as a wholly owned subsidiary of SpaceX, providing industry leading RF filters using patented XBAW technology to help drive the mission of making human life multi-planetary and connecting the world through Starlink.&nbsp;We design, build, launch, and operate the world's largest constellation of satellites, enabling us to operate a global internet network unbounded by traditional ground infrastructure limitations. The root of SpaceX’s success so far lies in our mission to keep all engineering and production in-house, which enables a tight feedback loop, nimble decision-making, and speedy deliverables. With millions of daily users worldwide already online, Starlink is truly a game-changer and levels the playing field for those who were previously unconnected.</p> <p>We are seeking a driven and detail-oriented Yield Engineer to join our RF device manufacturing team. This role focuses on correlating RF final test results with front-end wafer-level performance to identify and eliminate root causes of yield loss. You will be responsible for developing and implementing RF test solutions, managing test workflows, and driving process improvements across wafer probe and final test operations. The ideal candidate brings experience in RF test development, yield analysis, and statistical process control, with a passion for solving complex yield issues in a fast-paced, high-mix production.</p> <p><strong>RESPONSIBILITIES:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Develop and implement RF test cases and calibration procedures for BAW filter devices operating in the 2 GHz to &gt;10 GHz range</li> <li>Establish strong linkages between wafer probe data and final RF test performance, driving root cause analysis of yield detractors</li> <li>Use statistical tools such as SPC and DOE to monitor, control, and improve yield across the manufacturing flow</li> <li>Develop and maintain Cost of Ownership (CoO) and risk models to evaluate probe test strategies and ensure effective test coverage</li> <li>Sustain and optimize workflow and throughput in a high-mix RF test work center, driving continuous improvements in cycle time and cost</li> <li>Collaborate with design teams to provide feedback on DFM (Design for Manufacturability) and yield optimization opportunities</li> <li>Lead and mentor test operators, ensuring proper execution of test plans and maintenance of clean, organized workflows</li> <li>Support installation and qualification of new test tools, including both capability enhancements and capacity expansions</li> <li>Work closely with operation team and tool vendors to resolve equipment and process-related issues</li> <li>Create and maintain Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), engineering instructions, and test documentation</li> </ul> <p><strong>BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Bachelor’s degree in electrical engineering, physics, materials science, or other STEM discipline</li> <li>5+ years of experience in RF testing, yield title: Technical Recruiter (McGregor)
jd_text: <div class="content-intro"><p>SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of&nbsp;enabling human life on Mars.</p></div><p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>TECHNICAL RECRUITER</strong></p> <p><strong>RESPONSIBILITIES:</strong></p> <p>As a SpaceX recruiter, you will run a full desk with a variety of duties and responsibilities focused on the sourcing, screening, interviewing, and onboarding of top talent candidates to fill mission-critical positions (pun intended). In many cases, you are candidates’ first encounter with SpaceX, and it is your job to represent the company with professionalism, pride, and enthusiasm. We work in teams and focus on collaboration yet require a high degree of autonomy. So, while you are not expected to simply go it alone, you are expected to show initiative, take responsibility, and run with tasks to completion.&nbsp;</p> <p>Your day-to-day routine will change often as hiring priorities shift, but there is a basic set of activities you can expect to run with daily, including, but not limited to:</p> <ul> <li>Meet with your client groups to discuss headcount, new requisitions, hiring strategy, and/or interview feedback – you truly act as a partner to your clients and not merely as an order taker</li> <li>Screen candidates who apply to requisitions – as the SpaceX name brand grows, our job postings continue to fill up with stellar candidates</li> <li>Source candidates – often the best candidates are the ones not actively looking</li> <li>Discuss candidates you have screened with your client groups and recommend top candidates for interviews</li> <li>Give tours to candidates before their onsite</li> <li>Attend interviews alongside your client groups to act as another set of eyes and ears in evaluating candidates</li> <li>Once candidates are approved for hire, you will begin the offer process including initiating background checks, negotiating offer packages and extending offer letters</li> </ul> <p>Some days you will have multiple candidates coming onsite for interviews and you will spend that time giving tours and coordinating the candidate experience.&nbsp;Other days, you will need to fill your candidate pipeline and will spend the majority of the day screening/sourcing candidates.&nbsp;No day is the same here and the pace moves fast, but ultimately your job is to effectively attract, organize, and manage the flow of the country’s most talented individuals.</p> <p><strong>BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Bachelor’s degree and 1+ years of recruiting experience; or associate degree and 2+ years of experience; or 3+ years of professional experience as a recruiter in lieu of a degree</li> </ul> <p><strong>PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:</strong></p> <ul> <li>2+ years of technical recruiting experience</li> <li>2+ years of SGA recruiting experience</li> <li>Experience with in-house recruiting</li> <li>Experience with high volume recruiting</li> <li>Experience recruiting electrical, mechanical and aerospace engineers</li> <li>Experience recruiting skilled labor</li> <li>Strong tenure with demonstrated success in recruiting roles</li> <li>Full life cycle recruiting experience, from sourcing to closing</li> <li>Comfort with reviewing, evaluating and reporting on recruiting data</li> <li>Ability to distinguish between the top 50% and the top 5% of talent within their respective fields</li> <li>Demonstrated expertise in non-standard recruiting methods: cold calling candidates and companies, organizing and executing ad hoc networking events, identifying industry experts and finding unique methods to engage with them, creating unique targeted sourcing campaigns, etc.</li> <li>Comfortable interfacing directly with hiring managers including director and VP level technical leaders</li> <li>Ability to build strong relationships with both hiring managers and candidates</li> <li>Ability to accurately present but not oversell candidates to client groups; influence decisions by acting as the subject matter expert on talent but avoid dictating client decisions</li> <li>Ability to multi-task and operate with little direction while still being an active team member</li> </ul> <p><strong>ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Available to work extended hours and weekends as needed</li> <li>This position requires being onsite full-time – hybrid and remote work will not be considered</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong>ITAR REQUIREMENTS:</strong></p> <ul> <li>To conform to U.S. Government export regulations, applicant must be a (i) U.S. citizen or national, (ii) U.S. lawful, permanent resident (aka green card holder), (iii) Refugee under 8 U.S.C. § 1157, or (iv) Asylee under 8 U.S.C. § 1158, or be eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State. From thousands of gallons per minute of cryogens to tens of pounds per second of high-pressure gas, we develop clever solutions to meet the needs of a demanding test program both today and in the future. We have open positions ranging from entry-level to very experienced engineers to add value to the SpaceX mission.</p> <p><strong>RESPONSIBILITIES:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Analyze, design, and build title: Yield Engineer, RF Final Test Integration (Starlink/Akoustis)
jd_text: <div class="content-intro"><p>SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of&nbsp;enabling human life on Mars.</p></div><p><strong>YIELD ENGINEER, RF FINAL TEST INTEGRATION (STARLINK/AKOUSTIS)</strong></p> <p>Akoustis is now operating as a wholly owned subsidiary of SpaceX, providing industry leading RF filters using patented XBAW technology to help drive the mission of making human life multi-planetary and connecting the world through Starlink.&nbsp;We design, build, launch, and operate the world's largest constellation of satellites, enabling us to operate a global internet network unbounded by traditional ground infrastructure limitations. The root of SpaceX’s success so far lies in our mission to keep all engineering and production in-house, which enables a tight feedback loop, nimble decision-making, and speedy deliverables. With millions of daily users worldwide already online, Starlink is truly a game-changer and levels the playing field for those who were previously unconnected.</p> <p>We are seeking a driven and detail-oriented Yield Engineer to join our RF device manufacturing team. This role focuses on correlating RF final test results with front-end wafer-level performance to identify and eliminate root causes of yield loss. You will be responsible for developing and implementing RF test solutions, managing test workflows, and driving process improvements across wafer probe and final test operations. The ideal candidate brings experience in RF test development, yield analysis, and statistical process control, with a passion for solving complex yield issues in a fast-paced, high-mix production.</p> <p><strong>RESPONSIBILITIES:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Develop and implement RF test cases and calibration procedures for BAW filter devices operating in the 2 GHz to &gt;10 GHz range</li> <li>Establish strong linkages between wafer probe data and final RF test performance, driving root cause analysis of yield detractors</li> <li>Use statistical tools such as SPC and DOE to monitor, control, and improve yield across the manufacturing flow</li> <li>Develop and maintain Cost of Ownership (CoO) and risk models to evaluate probe test strategies and ensure effective test coverage</li> <li>Sustain and optimize workflow and throughput in a high-mix RF test work center, driving continuous improvements in cycle time and cost</li> <li>Collaborate with design teams to provide feedback on DFM (Design for Manufacturability) and yield optimization opportunities</li> <li>Lead and mentor test operators, ensuring proper execution of test plans and maintenance of clean, organized workflows</li> <li>Support installation and qualification of new test tools, including both capability enhancements and capacity expansions</li> <li>Work closely with operation team and tool vendors to resolve equipment and process-related issues</li> <li>Create and maintain Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), engineering instructions, and test documentation</li> </ul> <p><strong>BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Bachelor’s degree in electrical engineering, physics, materials science, or other STEM discipline</li> <li>1+ years of experience in RF testing, yield engineering, or semiconductor manufacturing(internship or professional)</li> </ul> <p><strong>PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS:</strong></p> <ul> <li>2+ years of experience in RF test development or semiconductor yield engineering</li> <li>Working knowledge of RF measurement principles, including S-parameters, insertion loss, return loss, and calibration</li> <li>Familiarity with RF BAW filter technology and associated test challenges</li> <li>Experience using automated probe stations, VNAs, and RF measurement tools</li> <li>Strong analytical skills with demonstrated ability to perform data analysis, root cause analysis, and yield correlation</li> <li>Proficiency in Statistical Process Control (SPC), DOE, and related quality improvement methodologies</li> <li>Familiarity with scripting and automation (e.g., Python, LabVIEW, MATLAB) for test or data analysis is a plus</li> <li>Ability to work independently and cross-functionally in a high-mix, fast-paced production environment</li> <li>Excellent verbal and written communication skills for collaboration across engineering, operations, and design teams</li> </ul> <p><strong>ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Must be willing to work extended hours and weekends as needed to meet critical milestones</li> <li>Ability to travel up to 10% domestically and internationally for supplier and manufacturing support</li> <li>Ability to perform light physical tasks (lifting up to 25 lbs, handling packaging samples)</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong>ITAR REQUIREMENTS:</strong></p> <ul> <li>To conform to U.S. Government export regulations, applicant must be a (i) U.S. citizen or national, (ii) U.S. lawful, permanent resident (aka green card holder), (iii) Refugee under 8 U.S.C. § 1157, or (iv) Asylee under 8 U.S.C. § 1158, or be eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State. Learn more about the ITAR <a href="https://www.pmddtc.state.gov/?id=ddtc_kb_article_page&amp;sys_id=24d528fddbfc930044f9ff621f961987">here</a>. &nbsp;</li> </ul> <p>SpaceX is an Equal Opportunity Employer; employment with SpaceX is governed on the basis of merit, competence and qualifications and will not be influenced in any manner by race, color, religion, gender, national origin/ethnicity, veteran status, disability status, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, mental or physical disability or any other legally protected status.</p> <p>Applicants wishing to view a copy of SpaceX’s Affirmative Action Plan for veterans and individuals with disabilities, or applicants requiring reasonable accommodation to the application/interview process should reach out to&nbsp;<a href="mailto:EEOCompliance@spacex.com">EEOCompliance@spacex.com</a><em>.&nbsp;</em></p></div>

title: Lead Materials Coordinator, Test Sites
jd_text: <div class="content-intro"><p>Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.</p></div><h3><strong>ABOUT THE JOB</strong></h3> <p>As a Lead Materials Coordinator, you will join our Deployment Operations team supporting one of Anduril's Test Sites. Test Sites are where our products meet the real world: dynamic, resource-constrained environments where rapid iteration, range operations, and customer demonstrations all happen. You will run with smaller teams and broader scope than production warehouses, which means the work is hands-on and the impact is immediate. The ideal candidate is an adaptable, proactive problem-solver who manages inventory and material operations under strict quality standards</p> <h4><strong>WHAT YOU'LL DO</strong></h4> <ul> <li>Process shipping, receiving, and inventory management at the Fort Stockton, TX test site</li> <li>Coordinate and prepare inbound, outbound, and round-trip shipments moving between the test site, Anduril production facilities, and customer locations, including packaging, crating, labeling, and shipping documentation</li> <li>Create and track shipment tickets in Jira, and coordinate delivery and pickup windows with carriers, drivers, and site security</li> <li>Distribute received material to the correct team, lab, or individual on site, and track empty cases and non-inventory items back to their point of origin</li> <li>Maintain inventory by identifying, labeling, and organizing materials and supplies, including bin locations and storage areas, and maintaining physical and digital records</li> <li>Monitor inventory levels to identify anticipated material shortages and restock points, and raise them to site and Deployment Operations leadership</li> <li>Pull, kit, pack, crate, label, and stage materials for test events, builds, and outbound shipments, ensuring product is properly secured and documented</li> <li>Execute receiving, issuing, transfer order, and cycle-count transactions in Oracle and Odoo, including project striping and de-striping, and troubleshoot transfer order validation errors so material can move on schedule</li> <li>Reconcile inventory records between systems when the physical count, Odoo, and Oracle disagree, escalating to Deployment Operations when a discrepancy cannot be resolved on site</li> <li>Operate forklifts, pallet jacks, and other machinery to move items, or signal machine operators to move materials onto and off trucks and loading docks</li> <li>Transport material between the test site and nearby Anduril or partner locations as needed</li> <li>Expedite flow of material, parts, and assemblies within the site and between Anduril locations in accordance with test and operational schedules</li> </ul> <h4><strong>REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS</strong></h4> <ul> <li>10+ years as a materials coordinator, warehouse associate, or equivalent role</li> <li>2+ years of experience leading a team, training and mentoring employees for development</li> <li>Knowledge of standard inventory management practices</li> <li>Familiarity with Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) systems and/or other warehouse management and inventory control tooling</li> <li>Ability to work proficiently and stay organized across multiple connected systems (ERP, Jira, Slack)</li> <li>Ability to lift and move material, operate material handling equipment, and work on your feet in an active test environment</li> <li>Ability to work onsite at the Test Site five days per week with occasional after-hours or weekend surge support as test and operational schedules dictate</li> <li>Ability to travel to Anduril Headquarters in Costa Mesa, CA and other Anduril sites on occasion, no more than 20% travel</li> <li>Valid driver’s license</li> <li>Eligible to obtain and maintain an active U.S. Secret or Top Secret security clearance</li> </ul> <h4><strong>PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS</strong></h4> <ul> <li>3+ years of forklift experience and license</li> <li>Experience supporting field operations, test ranges, or remote / austere sites</li> <li>Experience working in the defense/aerospace industry</li> <li>Proficient with spreadsheets for inventory reconciliation, reporting, and ad-hoc analysis</li> <li>Familiarity with inventory management through lot, serial, or batch tracking</li> <li>Experience packaging and handling hazardous shipments</li> <li>Able to operate independently and prioritize tasks effectively in fast-paced environments</li> <li>Comfortable working directly with engineers and technicians in an active test environment</li> <li>Excellent customer service skills</li> <li>Eligibility to obtain and maintain a U.S. clearance</li> </ul><div class="content-pay-transparency"><div class="pay-input"><div Actual salary offer may vary based on (but not limited to) work experience, education and/or training, critical skills, and/or business considerations. This third-party service provider does not act as a consumer reporting agency. Use of this provider helps to ensure compliance with applicable laws and protect technology, intellectual property, and organizational security.</span></p></div>

title: Senior Supplier Industrialization Engineer, Electromagnetic Warfare
jd_text: <div class="content-intro"><p>Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.</p></div><h3>ABOUT THE JOB</h3> <p>The Senior Supplier Industrialization Engineer, Electrical is a high-profile, cross functional position that plays an integral role in enabling development and production flow of Anduril’s critical supply base. You will work in close coordination with internal engineering, quality, supply chain and manufacturing departments as well as directly with suppliers to execute effective, creative and smart supply chain strategies to achieve production goals.&nbsp;<br><br>We're looking for a talented Senior Supplier Industrialization Engineer to expedite the qualification and implementation of product designs with our suppliers, optimizing these designs for quality, efficiency, and cost-effectiveness from early development through the entire product lifecycle.</p> <h4>WHAT YOU'LL DO</h4> <ul> <li>Own and manage the electrical commodities/subcategories (cables, harness, capacitors, connectors, PCB/PCBA, chips, etc.) to execute supplier production (NPI to full production) strategies across Anduril’s business lines</li> <li>Be a force multiplier for the Supply Chain team and overall commodity strategy, demonstrating a strong sense of ownership, proactivity, technical excellence, creativity, self-direction, and courage</li> <li>Vet Suppliers' production capabilities, factory lay out, facilities, workforce for supplier inclusion in Approved Supplier List</li> <li>Support Supply Chain Product Sourcing Engineers (PSE), Supply Chain Global Strategic Sourcing Management (GSS) and Supplier Quality Engineers (SQE) in ensuring Suppliers' understanding and adherence to the criteria for part quality set by SQE</li> <li>Own bringing up new production tooling &amp; lines, development at Supplier as needed, at Supplier sites to ensure materials, processes &amp; tools are capable of meeting product performance, quality (criteria set by SQE) and demand requirements</li> <li>Own capacity expansion readiness and production ramp-up at Supplier</li> <li>Establish and drive process performance and controls (SPC) reviews at Supplier</li> <li>Identify and drive product and process improvements, factory layout optimization at Supplier sites to lower part cost, reduce supply risk, eliminate potential defects, and improve cycle time ​over the product lifecycle</li> <li>Support SQE with root cause task force at Anduril by working in tandem with the Supply Chain team, Suppliers​, and be responsible for closing the loop of root cause corrective/preventative actions at Supplier</li> </ul> <h4>REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS</h4> <ul> <li>Bachelor’s degree in supply chain, engineering, or related technical field</li> <li>6+ years of experience in supplier quality and industrialization within a manufacturing environment</li> <li>Experience with specific category technical expertise, as applicable, electronics manufacturing, SMT processing, GD&amp;T</li> <li>Ability to travel at least 50% of the time</li> </ul> <h4>PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS</h4> <ul> <li>Bachelor’s degree in electrical engineering, or related technical field</li> <li>Previous experience in defense, aerospace, automotive, high tech, or another related industry</li> <li>Strong understanding of quality systems, standards, and certifications</li> <li>Familiarity with developing high-tech products in a high-mix, low-volume environment</li> <li>Exposure to working in a fast-pace, start-up title: ASIC/SOC DFT Engineer (Silicon Engineering)
jd_text: <div class="content-intro"><p>SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of&nbsp;enabling human life on Mars.</p></div><div> <p><strong>ASIC/SOC DFT ENGINEER (SILICON ENGINEERING)</strong></p> <div> <p>At SpaceX we’re leveraging our experience in building rockets and spacecraft to deploy Starlink, the world’s most advanced broadband internet system. Starlink is the world’s largest satellite constellation and is providing fast, reliable internet to millions of users worldwide. We design, build, test, and operate all parts of the system – thousands of satellites, consumer receivers that allow users to connect within minutes of unboxing, and the software that brings it all together. We’ve only begun to scratch the surface of Starlink’s potential global impact and are looking for best-in-class engineers to help maximize Starlink’s utility for communities and businesses around the globe.&nbsp;</p> </div> <div> <p>We are seeking a motivated, proactive, and intellectually curious engineer who will work alongside world-class cross-disciplinary teams (systems, firmware, architecture, design, validation, product engineering, ASIC implementation). In this role, you will be developing cutting-edge next-generation ASICs for deployment in space and ground infrastructures around the globe. These chips are enabling connectivity in places it has previously not been available, affordable or reliable. Your efforts will help deliver cutting-edge solutions that will expand the performance and capabilities of the Starlink network.&nbsp; &nbsp;</p> </div> <p><strong>RESPONSIBILITIES:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Responsible for evaluating design readiness for scan insertion through RTL and physical design Scan Design Rule Check (DRC) tools</li> <li>Integration and verification of Design for Test (DFT) fabrics and IP within Subsystems</li> <li>Running and evaluating scan insertion through synthesis tools and refining scan insertion recipe for maximum coverage</li> <li>Run ATPG(Automatic Test Pattern Generation) analysis to ensure quality scan chain construction and meeting basic coverage goals</li> <li>Run and debug non-timing and SDF annotated gate level simulations</li> <li>Creating ATPG content for use in post-silicon testing and validating that content through gate level simulation</li> <li>Collaborate with circuit physical design team, ATPG team and manufacturing team to facilitate high quality scan coverage in silicon</li> </ul> <p><strong>BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Bachelor’s degree in electrical engineering, computer engineering or computer science</li> <li>1+ years of professional experience working with ASICs</li> <li>Experience in scan insertion or DFT setup</li> </ul> <p><strong>PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Understanding of ASIC design flow, methodologies, physical design, and verification</li> <li>Experience with high reliability design and implementations</li> <li>Good scripting skills (csh/bash, Perl, Python etc.)</li> <li>Familiar with implementation or integration of design blocks using Verilog/SystemVerilog</li> <li>Familiar with UPF (unified power format), formal verification, and DRC rule checking experience</li> <li>Ability to work in a dynamic environment with changing needs and requirements</li> <li>Team-player, can-do attitude, and ability to work well in a group environment while still contributing on an individual basis</li> <li>Enjoys being challenged and learning new skills</li> </ul> </div> <p><strong>ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Must be willing to work extended hours and weekends as needed</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong>ITAR REQUIREMENTS:</strong></p> <ul> <li>To conform to U.S. Government export regulations, applicant must be a (i) U.S. citizen or national, (ii) U.S. lawful, permanent resident (aka green card holder), (iii) Refugee under 8 U.S.C. § 1157, or (iv) Asylee under 8 U.S.C. § 1158, or be eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State. Learn more about the ITAR <a href="https://www.pmddtc.state.gov/?id=ddtc_kb_article_page&amp;sys_id=24d528fddbfc930044f9ff621f961987">here</a>. &nbsp;</li> </ul> <p>SpaceX is an Equal Opportunity Employer; employment with SpaceX is governed on the basis of merit, competence and qualifications and will not be influenced in any manner by race, color, religion, gender, national origin/ethnicity, veteran status, disability status, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, mental or physical disability or any other legally protected status.</p> <p>Applicants wishing to view a copy of SpaceX’s Affirmative Action Plan for veterans and individuals with disabilities, or applicants requiring reasonable accommodation to the application/interview process should reach out to&nbsp;<a href="mailto:EEOCompliance@spacex.com">EEOCompliance@spacex.com</a><em>.&nbsp;</em></p></div>

title: CMM Source Inspector
jd_text: <div class="content-intro"><p>SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of&nbsp;enabling human life on Mars.</p></div><p><strong>CMM SOURCE INSPECTOR</strong></p> <p><strong>RESPONSIBILITIES:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Travel up to 75% other regions domestically, to perform visual and dimensional inspections on manufactured parts, assemblies, and/or sub-assemblies at supplier sites</li> <li>Select and utilize standard gauges to ensure quality</li> <li>Inspect feature tolerances by selecting the tool with the required accuracy</li> <li>Perform complex inspections on purchased mechanical parts, components, assemblies and materials</li> <li>Perform documentation review and verification of certifications, specifications, and conformance to design and specification requirements</li> <li>Inspect flight hardware at the supplier according to engineering drawings, purchase order(s), industry standards, and SpaceX specifications</li> <li>Ensure that all parts meet SpaceX specifications and standards or that any non-conformance is documented at the supplier</li> <li>Support the development of inspection plans at suppliers</li> <li>Support supplier corrective action process, including verifying corrective action implementation</li> <li>Provide support to both internal and external stakeholders on SpaceX requirements and inspection processes</li> <li>Collaborate with teams, lead projects, and drive continuous improvement of processes both internally and at our suppliers</li> <li>Program and set up Articulating Arm (ex. Romer), CMMs to achieve the desired inspections</li> </ul> <p><strong>BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:</strong></p> <ul> <li>High school diploma or equivalency certificate</li> <li>3+ years of precision mechanical inspection experience</li> <li>3+ years of CMM programming, CMM operations, or Faro Arm experience</li> </ul> <p><strong>PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Aerospace precision inspection experience</li> <li>Practical experience working within quality management systems (AS9100 and ISO 9001)</li> <li>CMM Programming with PC-DMIS software</li> <li>Romer Arm experience with Verisurf software</li> <li>Basic understanding of electronics inspection and propulsion valve operation</li> <li>Solid computer skills in Microsoft Word, Outlook and Excel</li> <li>Statistical process control experience</li> <li>Ability to read and interpret engineering drawings and specification using ASME Y14.5. GD&amp;T and skillful use of metrology tools and gauge</li> <li>Self-motivated, proactive, and capable of managing priorities and tasks as delegated</li> </ul> <p><strong>ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Ability to lift 25 lbs. unassisted</li> <li>Lifting, standing, climbing, bending, grasping, sitting, pulling, pushing, stooping, stretching, and carrying are generally required to perform the functions of this position</li> <li>Must be able to travel - up to 75% work week travel may be required</li> <li>Position may involve overtime, long hours and weekend work as needed with occasional overnight work may be required when traveling to suppliers</li> <li>The candidate for this role must reside in Texas</li> <li>Frequent travel to suppliers within the United States required; valid driver’s license mandatory</li> </ul> <p><strong>COMPENSATION AND BENEFITS: &nbsp; &nbsp;</strong><br><br>Pay range: &nbsp; &nbsp;<br>Source Inspector/Level 1: $30.00 - $38.00/hour &nbsp; &nbsp;<br>Source Inspector/Level 2: $34.00 - $43.00/hour &nbsp; &nbsp;<br>Source Inspector/Level 3: $38.00 - $48.00/hour</p> <p>Your actual level and base salary will be determined on a case-by-case basis and may vary based on the following considerations: job-related knowledge and skills, education, and experience.</p> <p>Base salary is just one part of your total rewards package at SpaceX. You may also be eligible for long-term incentives, in the form of company stock, stock options, or long-term cash awards, as well as potential discretionary bonuses and the ability to purchase additional stock at a discount through an Employee Stock Purchase Plan. You will also receive access to comprehensive medical, vision, and dental coverage, access to a 401(k) retirement plan, short and long-term disability insurance, life insurance, paid parental leave, and various other discounts and perks. You may also accrue 3 weeks of paid vacation and will be eligible for 10 or more paid holidays per year.</p><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong>ITAR REQUIREMENTS:</strong></p> <ul> <li>To conform to U.S. Government export regulations, applicant must be a (i) U.S. citizen or national, (ii) U.S. lawful, permanent resident (aka green card holder), (iii) Refugee under 8 U.S.C. § 1157, or (iv) Asylee under 8 U.S.C. § 1158, or be eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State. Learn more about the ITAR <a href="https://www.pmddtc.state.gov/?id=ddtc_kb_article_page&amp;sys_id=24d528fddbfc930044f9ff621f961987">here</a>. &nbsp;</li> </ul> <p>SpaceX is an Equal Opportunity Employer; employment with SpaceX is governed on the basis of merit, competence and qualifications and will not be influenced in any manner by race, color, religion, gender, national origin/ethnicity, veteran status, disability status, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, mental or physical disability or any other legally protected status.</p> <p>Applicants wishing to view a copy of SpaceX’s Affirmative Action Plan for veterans and individuals with disabilities, or applicants requiring reasonable accommodation to the application/interview process should reach out to&nbsp;<a href="mailto:EEOCompliance@spacex.com">EEOCompliance@spacex.com</a><em>.&nbsp;</em></p></div>

title: Global Supply Manager, Datacenter Cooling Equipment (Starlink)
jd_text: <div class="content-intro"><p>SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of&nbsp;enabling human life on Mars.</p></div><p><strong>GLOBAL SUPPLY MANAGER, DATACENTER COOLING EQUIPMENT (STARLINK)</strong></p> <p>We are seeking a world-class Global Supply Manager to own end-to-end sourcing strategy, supplier management, and delivery of datacenter cooling equipment and supporting systems for SpaceX's hyperscale AI clusters. This role covers mechanical cooling infrastructure (dry coolers, chillers, pumps, CDUs), auxiliary piping, valves, controls/instrumentation, and chemicals/consumables. You will partner deeply with responsible engineers and thermal systems teams to define commodity strategy, build multi-year roadmaps, establish approved vendor lists, and secure supply at the extreme velocity and scale SpaceX demands. You will negotiate transformative agreements, deploy predictive supply chain tools, drive supplier co-innovation, and turn cooling infrastructure procurement into a strategic force multiplier that ensures maximum uptime, energy efficiency, and rapid deployment for SpaceX's power-dense training clusters. The ideal candidate brings deep expertise in datacenter or industrial cooling systems, thrives in high-velocity environments, and excels at managing both capital equipment and recurring consumables.</p> <p><strong>RESPONSIBILITIES:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Partner deeply with responsible engineers, thermal architects, and facility teams to co-define commodity strategy, multi-year technology roadmaps, and approved vendor lists for mechanical cooling systems (dry coolers, chillers, pumps, CDUs), auxiliary piping/valves, controls/instrumentation, and chemicals/consumables, anticipating SpaceX's cooling demand and density requirements 12–24 months ahead</li> <li>Own global sourcing end-to-end for cooling equipment, systems, and consumables, including aggressive supplier qualification, dual/multi-sourcing strategies, and performance management to deliver &gt;98% on-time delivery and lead-time compression while supporting SpaceX's record-breaking cluster build cadence</li> <li>Negotiate transformative commercial agreements that include not only pricing and volume but also co-development commitments, dedicated manufacturing capacity, lead-time reductions, NRE funding models, priority allocation during shortages, and flexible supply programs for chemicals/consumables</li> <li>Deploy predictive analytics, AI-driven demand forecasting, and real-time supply chain visibility tools to anticipate and mitigate risks (long-lead equipment delays, component shortages, fluid chemistry changes, or geopolitical factors) before they impact cooling system deployment or cluster operations</li> <li>Drive continuous cost leadership through should-cost modeling, value engineering of cooling assemblies and piping designs, specification optimization, and long-term pricing agreements for both capital equipment and recurring consumables while maintaining or exceeding the highest reliability, efficiency, and redundancy standards required for SpaceX training clusters</li> <li>Lead supplier innovation programs — challenge and collaborate with vendors on custom high-efficiency designs, modular cooling packages, advanced controls integration, low-GWP refrigerants, optimized piping/valve configurations, and next-generation CDU/pump technologies that accelerate SpaceX's hardware roadmap and reduce total cost of ownership</li> <li>Build and maintain a world-class hybrid supply base through strategic relationships with OEMs, component suppliers, and chemical providers, regular executive business reviews, joint development projects, and performance scorecards that position SpaceX as the preferred high-velocity partner for advanced datacenter cooling solutions</li> <li>Standardize and automate procurement, NPI, inventory optimization (including just-in-time and consignment models for consumables), and installation support processes tailored to SpaceX's build velocity; establish clear KPIs for cost, quality, speed, system efficiency, and resilience reviewed weekly with leadership</li> <li>Champion sustainability and supply chain ethics initiatives, including responsible sourcing of critical materials, supplier carbon footprint reduction targets, low-global-warming-potential cooling technologies, water usage optimization, and circular economy practices for cooling equipment and consumables</li> <li>Stay at the forefront of industry trends in datacenter liquid and air cooling, high-density thermal management, controls systems, and fluid chemistry; translate these into actionable strategies that keep SpaceX jd_text: <div class="content-intro"><p>SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Starlink is the world’s largest satellite constellation and is providing fast, reliable internet to millions of users worldwide. We design, build, test, and operate all parts of the system – thousands of satellites, consumer receivers that allow users to connect within minutes of unboxing, and the software that brings it all together. We’ve only begun to scratch the surface of Starlink’s potential global impact and are looking for best-in-class engineers to help maximize Starlink’s utility for communities and businesses around the globe.&nbsp;</p> <p>We are seeking a motivated, proactive, and intellectually curious engineer who will work alongside world-class cross-disciplinary teams (systems, firmware, architecture, design, validation, product engineering, ASIC implementation). In this role, you will be developing cutting-edge next-generation ASICs for deployment in space and ground infrastructures around the globe. These chips are enabling connectivity in places it has previously not been available, affordable or reliable. Your efforts will help deliver cutting-edge solutions that will expand the performance and capabilities of the Starlink network.</p> </div> <p><strong>RESPONSIBILITIES: </strong></p> <ul> <li>Perform partition synthesis and physical implementation steps (e.g. synthesis, floorplanning, power/ground grid generation, place and route, timing, noise, physical verification, electromigration, voltage drop, logic equivalency and other signoff checks)</li> <li>Develop/improve physical design methodologies and automation scripts for various implementation steps</li> <li>Closely collaborate with the ASIC design team to drive architectural feasibility studies, develop timing, power and area design targets, and explore RTL/design tradeoffs</li> <li>Resolve design/timing/congestion and flow issues, and voltage drop</li> </ul> <p><strong>BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Bachelor’s degree in electrical engineering, computer engineering or computer science</li> <li>1+ years of professional experience working on RTL2GDSII physical design and/or physical design flow development</li> </ul> <p><strong>PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Experience with CMOS digital design principles, basic standard cells their functionality, standard cell libraries</li> <li>Understanding of CMOS power dissipation in deep submicron processes leakage/dynamic</li> title: Sr. Chemical Texturing Equipment Engineer, Solar Cells (Starlink)
jd_text: <div class="content-intro"><p>SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of&nbsp;enabling human life on Mars.</p></div><p><strong><span data-contrast="auto">SR. CHEMICAL TEXTURING EQUIPMENT ENGINEER, SOLAR CELLS (STARLINK)</span></strong></p> <p><span data-contrast="auto">Starlink&nbsp;believes in providing fast, reliable internet to those that need it most. We design, build, and launch the world's largest and most advanced satellite constellation that&nbsp;is capable of delivering&nbsp;high-speed internet to even the most remote locations.</span><span data-ccp-props="{&quot;201341983&quot;:0,&quot;335559739&quot;:200,&quot;335559740&quot;:276}">&nbsp;</span></p> <p><span data-contrast="auto">As a Sr. Chemical Texturing Equipment Engineer you will own the chemical processing equipment (wet chemical texturing tools, wet chemical preclean tools) used to manufacture silicon heterojunction solar cells at massive scale. You will work closely with our existing Texturing Process Engineering team to ensure world-class equipment performance, reliability, and uptime. While the process team focuses on surface morphology, light trapping, and cell efficiency, you will be the hardware owner responsible for tool availability, stability, and scaling to support our ambitious goals.</span><span data-ccp-props="{&quot;201341983&quot;:0,&quot;335559739&quot;:200,&quot;335559740&quot;:276}">&nbsp;</span></p> <p><span data-contrast="auto">Your work will form the backbone of the&nbsp;Starlink&nbsp;network (photons of sunlight in is directly proportional to photons of data out to customers!) and help provide internet to tens of millions of customers all around the world. We design, build, test, and operate all parts of the system – thousands of satellites, consumer receivers that allow users to connect within minutes of unboxing, and the software that brings it all together. You will design, implement, and verify small router antennas, phased arrays, and reflector antenna systems. title: Aerodynamics Engineer (Starship)
jd_text: <div class="content-intro"><p>SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of&nbsp;enabling human life on Mars.</p></div><p><strong>AERODYNAMICS ENGINEER (STARSHIP)</strong></p> <p>The Starship Aerodynamics team is responsible for predicting the aerodynamics and aerothermal environments booster and ship experience during all phases of their missions. Aerodynamics engineers use engineering models, simulations and wind-tunnel testing in order to provide the most accurate predictions ahead of flight validation. The team works closely with the GNC (guidance, navigation, and control) team to enable them to safely land and recover both Starship stages once their mission is accomplished. Moreover the team supports engineers responsible for vehicle structures during their design efforts.
