coverage gaps and implement solutions.</li> <li>Configure and troubleshoot network access control (NAC) and other security features.</li> <li>Perform job walks with customers, vendors, and contractors to gather network requirements and create implementation plans.</li> <li>Build and maintain IDF rooms across campus in accordance with network standards.</li> <li>Monitor network health using in-house and third-party tools.</li> <li>Create and update network documentation.</li> <li>Manage network hardware inventory.</li> </ul> <p><strong>BASIC QUALIFICATIONS</strong>:</p> <ul> <li>High school diploma or equivalency certificate.</li> <li>3+ years of professional network administration experience.</li> </ul> <p><strong>PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Understanding of the OSI model and network standards.</li> <li>Cisco Catalyst, Juniper, and Arista data center-class switches.</li> <li>Cisco wireless LAN controllers or other wireless technologies.</li> <li>Wave Division Multiplexing and fiber optics.</li> <li>DNS, DHCP, SNMP, IP helpers, ARP, CDP, LLDP.</li> <li>Switch port security features.</li> <li>Network monitoring tools.</li> <li>Documentation and This employee will be a member of the IT Network Engineering team, which is responsible for maintaining a stable, reliable, and diverse network. This network supports the design, manufacturing, and launching of rockets, spacecraft, satellites, and human spaceflight. This position will design and support industrial and OT networks for production, test, site operations, and live data center build environments. The ideal candidate will be a great communicator, able to document work in a ticketing system, excel at multi-tasking, resolve issues to prevent failures, and enjoy a fast-paced high-tech environment.</p> <p><strong>RESPONSIBILITIES:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Design and implement highly available networks, balancing routing and redundancy for production, test, and site requirements.</li> <li>Design and validate resilient, scalable multi-site OT network topologies for critical facilities.</li> <li>Evaluate, procure, and deploy network hardware: switches, firewalls, multiplexing, and SD-WAN appliances.</li> <li>Develop and contribute to network automation tooling, including configuration analysis and scalable deployment.</li> <li>Plan and coordinate network outage windows with stakeholders for software updates, hardware refreshes, and maintenance.</li> <li>Troubleshoot and resolve network issues. title: IT Network Infrastructure Engineer, Launch
jd_text: <div class="content-intro"><p>SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of&nbsp;enabling human life on Mars.</p></div><p><strong>IT NETWORK INFRASTRUCTURE ENGINEER, LAUNCH</strong></p> <p>As a Network Infrastructure Engineer at SpaceX, you will work in a complex environment designing and supporting a variety of IT systems critical for Starship launch pads. This position will require you to design, install, and maintain the physical cabling, network hardware, on-premises compute, electrical enclosures, and data center environments that together make up our mission critical control networks. You will work directly with the launch automations &amp; controls teams to provide reliable and robust connectivity to their critical control systems. The fiber and copper data network cabling that you will design must survive extreme launch environments to carry operational voice, video, vehicle/payload commanding, ground support equipment telemetry, and the rest of the data needed to launch Starship in high-cadence, airport-like operations to enable life beyond Earth.</p> <p><strong>RESPONSIBILITIES:</strong>&nbsp;</p> <ul> <li>Be an extreme owner of network infrastructure including product selection, procurement, configuration, install, and troubleshooting</li> <li>Monitor network&nbsp;health, troubleshooting, and determining root cause of system issues as they arise</li> <li>Perform job walks with customers,&nbsp;vendors,&nbsp;and contractors to gather requirements and create project implementation plans&nbsp;</li> <li>Closely&nbsp;collaborate&nbsp;with stakeholders and engineers across programs to create highly operable, scalable, and&nbsp;maintainable&nbsp;products&nbsp;</li> <li>Continuously create and innovate to build solutions for unique layer1 challenges&nbsp;</li> <li>Participate in the day-to-day operation of IT systems, ensuring seamless functionality and reliability during critical launch windows</li> </ul> <p><strong>BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:</strong>&nbsp;</p> <ul> <li>Bachelor’s degree in electrical engineering, aerospace engineering, or other STEM discipline and 5+ years of experience designing, implementing, testing, and maintaining system-level communication architectures, OR 7+ years of experience designing, implementing, testing, and maintaining system-level communication architectures in lieu of a degree</li> </ul> <p><strong>PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:</strong>&nbsp;</p> <ul> <li>Ability to prioritize multiple concurrent competing projects effectively and incorporate significant design changes quickly</li> <li>Project management skills including schedule development, writing scopes of work, reading construction drawings, and creating specification documents</li> <li>Experience supervising crews of technicians/contractors to execute implementation of your designs</li> <li>Experience with configuration and operation of TCP/IP based communication equipment</li> <li>Knowledge of industry standards (BICSI, NEC, TIA/EIA), fiber optic cabling types (MM, SM) for interior and exterior usage, copper ethernet cabling types (CAT5, CAT6, CAT6A)</li> <li>Understanding of code requirements and fire protection specifications for cable pathways such as tray and conduit, especially in hazardous rated locations</li> <li>Motivation to oversee projects from early design through build and closeout</li> <li>Keen attention to detail and dedication to thorough documentation</li> <li>Proficient with CAD and/or electrical schematics software</li> <li>Confidence to present designs and clearly articulate project goals for review by internal and external stakeholders</li> </ul> <p><strong>ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS:</strong>&nbsp;</p> <ul> <li>Ability to work in tight quarters and at height</li> <li>Must be willing to work long hours and weekends when necessary to support launches and critical path project timelines. Flexibility is required</li> <li>Availability for occasional travel to other launch sites</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong>ITAR REQUIREMENTS:</strong></p> <ul> <li>To conform to U.S. Government export regulations, applicant must be a (i) U.S. citizen or national, (ii) U.S. lawful, permanent resident (aka green card holder), (iii) Refugee under 8 U.S.C. § 1157, or (iv) Asylee under 8 U.S.C. § 1158, or be eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State. Learn more about the ITAR <a href="https://www.pmddtc.state.gov/?id=ddtc_kb_article_page&amp;sys_id=24d528fddbfc930044f9ff621f961987">here</a>. &nbsp;</li> </ul> <p>SpaceX is an Equal Opportunity Employer; employment with SpaceX is governed on the basis of merit, competence and qualifications and will not be influenced in any manner by race, color, religion, gender, national origin/ethnicity, veteran status, disability status, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, mental or physical disability or any other legally protected status.</p> <p>Applicants wishing to view a copy of SpaceX’s Affirmative Action Plan for veterans and individuals with disabilities, or applicants requiring reasonable accommodation to the application/interview process should reach out to&nbsp;<a href="mailto:EEOCompliance@spacex.com">EEOCompliance@spacex.com</a><em>.&nbsp;</em></p></div>

title: IT Network Infrastructure Specialist
jd_text: <div class="content-intro"><p>SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of&nbsp;enabling human life on Mars.</p></div><p><strong>IT NETWORK INFRASTRUCTURE SPECIALIST</strong></p> <p>Our IT Network Infrastructure Specialists design layer 1 network infrastructure for supporting critical launch, landing and production facilities. The IT Network Infrastructure team installs and supports the infrastructure used for all types of telecommunications in support of our launch vehicles, spacecraft and production areas, including the layer 1 fiber and copper data network cabling infrastructure, operational voice (both wired and wireless systems), mission video, ground-side vehicle and payload interface RF systems, ground stations, telemetry and optical tracking systems, marine communications, readiness testing, and other systems involved in real-time communications and operations for Falcon, Dragon, Starship and other missions.&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>RESPONSIBILITIES:&nbsp;</strong>&nbsp;</p> <ul> <li>Plan, design and implement local and wide-area network solutions between multiple platforms and protocols</li> <li>Conduct fiber optic detailed network design for middle mile and last mile fiber-based networks</li> <li>Conduct project planning, cost analysis and vendor comparisons</li> <li>Assist in job walks and in determining needs for new installations and redesigns</li> <li>Work in conjunction with professional services and outsourcing functions as needed</li> <li>Collaborate with all staff members and stakeholders in the development and use of proper procedures in support of all layer 1 infrastructure </li> <li>Ensure all components and materials are clean and serviceable</li> <li>Obtain and maintain licenses, operator permits, or certifications as required</li> <li>Monitor and maintain a reasonable inventory of replacement hardware, general use materials, and tools</li> <li>Acquire proper inventory parts and equipment needed for repair or replacement of defective components</li> <li>Process, track and efficiently execute work orders and support tickets</li> <li>Assist in vendor scheduling, installation, and subcontracting activities on large and complex facility system infrastructure</li> <li>Maintain documentation of job status, job change revisions, material flow and other project and maintenance records</li> <li>Perform a variety of related duties in support of network operation</li> <li>Develop novel ways to streamline processes and increase the reliability of network functionality</li> <li>Support infrastructure in a multitude of environments with our land and sea based assets&nbsp;</li> </ul> <p><strong>BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:</strong>&nbsp;</p> <ul> <li>High school diploma or equivalency certificate</li> <li>3+ years of experience in OSP and/or ISP fiber detailed design</li> <li>Experience with wired and wireless voice intercom communication systems&nbsp;</li> </ul> <p><strong>PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:</strong>&nbsp;</p> <ul> <li>Bachelor's degree in an engineering, technical, or mechanical field</li> <li>Basic knowledge of TCP/IP networking protocols</li> <li>3+ years of experience in basic construction techniques and the use of power tools, hand tools, and calibrated tooling</li> <li>Experience in the space exploration industry, aviation, military or other high-reliability operating environment</li> <li>Basic experience in project management</li> <li>Ability to read and understand basic wiring schematics and construction blueprints</li> <li>Communication skills for relaying data (verbally and in-writing) between other employees and customers</li> <li>Ability to work effectively in a team environment</li> title: IT Network Infrastructure Technician
jd_text: <div class="content-intro"><p>SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of&nbsp;enabling human life on Mars.</p></div><p><strong>IT NETWORK INFRASTRUCTURE TECHNICIAN</strong></p> <p>SpaceX technicians work in a complex environment supporting a variety of critical production, launch, and landing activities. The IT network infrastructure team installs and supports the cable infrastructure used for all types of telecommunications in support of our production facilities, launch infrastructure and spacecraft support systems, including the layer 1 fiber and copper data network cabling, operational voice (both wired and wireless systems), video, ground-side vehicle and payload interface RF systems, ground stations, telemetry and optical tracking systems, marine communications, readiness testing, and other systems involved in real-time communications and operations for Falcon, Dragon, Starship and other missions.</p> <p><strong>RESPONSIBILITIES:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Install, terminate, test, troubleshoot, and document test results for fiber, network, audio, video, and RF cabling</li> <li>Install, test, and troubleshoot audio, video, and RF equipment</li> <li>Install cable pathway systems (cable trays, cable racks, J-hooks or D-rings)</li> <li>Install, terminate, test, label, and document horizontal, backbone and other cables</li> <li>Build out telecommunication and equipment rooms</li> <li>Install connectors, connector pins, terminals, and lugs</li> <li>Perform continuity checks, locate and correct wiring errors using measuring instruments</li> <li>Investigate, diagnose, correct, and document instrumentation or system malfunctions</li> <li>Perform complex technical assignments involving communications systems, instrumentation and data acquisition/processing systems</li> <li>Collaborate with team members to troubleshoot failures and issues derived from test data</li> <li>Read and interpret planning documents, schematics, wiring diagrams, specifications, drawings, manuals, blueprints, and engineering sketches</li> </ul> <p><strong>BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:</strong></p> <ul> <li>High school diploma or equivalency certificate</li> <li>2+ years of experience installing, testing, troubleshooting, and repairing: fiber optics, copper cabling (RF, Ethernet), network and telephony installation, and audio/video systems</li> </ul> <p><strong>PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:</strong></p> <ul> <li><span data-teams="true">3+ years of raceway installation (conduit, cable tray installation, PVC installation)</span></li> <li>Ability to install, terminate and test low voltage cables and fiber optical cables to include twisted pair, coaxial, stranded and solid conductor low voltage cables, single mode and multi-mode fiber optical cables</li> <li>Strong knowledge of industry standards (BICSI, NEC, TIA/EIA); different types of fiber (MM, SM) for interior and exterior usage; Cat5E, Cat6 and Cat6A data cabling; and cable pathways such as conduit, fire penetrations and cable trays</li> <li>Knowledge of the telecom network best practices and concepts including network security, network architecture design, technical standards and deliverables, troubleshooting tools (e.g., line analyzers, breakout boxes, and network traces), software and hardware installation and configuration, network hardware, and protocols (e.g., TCP/IP, DLC, and ASYNC)</li> <li>Working knowledge of audio, video, and wireless systems and corresponding physical means of delivery (i.e. analog, digital, AoIP, VoIP)</li> <li>Operational knowledge of oscilloscopes and multi-meters, soldering wires and connectors, various crimping tools, wire stripping techniques, Ohm’s law, continuity testing, pinning out a military type connector, routing and tie wrapping cables, drilling and tapping holes, and building junction boxes&nbsp;</li> <li>Experience with DC power supplies, DC-DC converters, heat shrink tubing, cable harnessing, lacing, and proper strain relief concepts</li> <li>Experience with IP and HD-SDI video cameras and infrastructure</li> <li>Comprehension of modern networking architecture and what is necessary for physical layer inter-connectivity</li> <li>Experience operating articulating boom lifts, fork lifts, scissor lifts, and other work site machinery</li> </ul> <p><strong>ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Ability to pass Air Force background checks for Cape Canaveral and Vandenberg</li> <li>Must have valid driver's license</li> <li>Ability to distinguish between different colors and possess manual dexterity to complete fine motor tasks</li> <li>Ability to work at elevated heights and/or tight spaces</li> <li>Physical effort including standing, lifting and carrying moderately heavy materials or equipment up to 25 lbs&nbsp;</li> <li>Regularly exposed to work in extreme outdoor environments – heat, cold, rain</li> <li>Work occasionally performed in an environment requiring exposure to fumes, odors, and noise</li> <li>Available to work overtime hours, nights and weekends when required by mission milestones</li> <li>Ability to travel (~10-25%) as required to other SpaceX locations</li> <li>Typical 50 hour work weeks with overtime as required; schedule varies depending on site operational needs; flexibility is required</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong>ITAR REQUIREMENTS:</strong></p> <ul> <li>To conform to U.S. Government export regulations, applicant must be a (i) U.S. citizen or title: IT Storage Engineer
jd_text: <div class="content-intro"><p>SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of&nbsp;enabling human life on Mars.</p></div><p></p> <p><strong>IT STORAGE ENGINEER</strong></p> <p>SpaceX is seeking an experienced storage engineer with deep expertise in enterprise storage platforms. This role is ideal for someone who thrives in performance-critical settings and is eager to build storage infrastructure supporting mission-critical workloads like simulation, telemetry, and test data processing.</p> <p>The ideal candidate will possess knowledge of both Pure and NetApp storage systems running iSCSI with hands-on keyboard as well as on hardware in an on-premises environment.</p> <p><strong>RESPONSIBILITIES:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Design, implement, and maintain storage infrastructure across multiple tiers: high-performance, capacity, archive, backup/recovery, and disaster recovery.</li> <li>Architect and operate high-throughput, low-latency storage and support exabyte scale file systems (e.g., VAST,) for simulation, telemetry, and high-concurrency workloads.</li> <li>Administer storage systems including NetApp, Pure FlashArray/FlashBlade, Vast, and HPE Alletra.</li> <li>Monitor and troubleshoot storage performance across the full stack: hardware, transport (RDMA), and protocol layers.</li> <li>Troubleshoot complex issues that require an understanding of the interaction of various protocols and operating systems.</li> <li>Manage storage access, data permissions, and access controls across different protocols and operating systems.</li> <li>Develop automation and tooling for monitoring, capacity utilization and planning, configuration management, and alerting.</li> <li>Define and enforce standards for storage deployment, performance tuning, and operational management.</li> <li>Collaborate with compute, networking, and application teams to align storage strategies with system architecture and workload requirements.</li> <li>Participate in scheduled maintenance, on-call rotation, and occasional physical installation of hardware.</li> </ul> <p><strong>BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Bachelor's degree in computer science, computer engineering, or other STEM discipline and 3+ years of professional IT storage engineering experience; OR 5+ years of IT storage engineering experience in lieu of a degree.</li> <li>Experience with enterprise storage platforms: NetApp, Pure Storage, Vast, HPE Alletra.</li> <li>Strong understanding of storage protocols: NFS, CIFS/SMB, iSCSI, and NVMe over TCP.</li> </ul> <p><strong>PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Experience with client and server hardware/software, monitoring tools, enterprise networking, and virtualization.</li> <li>Mid-level experience with DFS administration.</li> <li>High level of network knowledge.</li> <li>Experience automating infrastructure with Python, PowerShell, or Ansible.</li> <li>Strong written and verbal communication skills; able to explain complex designs in clear terms.</li> <li>Experience collaborating with virtualization teams as an infrastructure engineer.</li> </ul> <p><strong>ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Must be willing to work extended hours and weekends as needed.</li> </ul> <p></p><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong>ITAR REQUIREMENTS:</strong></p> <ul> <li>To conform to U.S. Government export regulations, applicant must be a (i) U.S. citizen or national, (ii) U.S. lawful, permanent resident (aka green card holder), (iii) Refugee under 8 U.S.C. § 1157, or (iv) Asylee under 8 U.S.C. § 1158, or be eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State. This network supports the design, manufacturing, and launching of rockets, spacecraft, satellites, and human spaceflight. The ideal candidate will be a great communicator, able to document work, excel at multi-tasking, and enjoy a fast-paced high-tech environment.</p> <p><strong>RESPONSIBILITIES:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Design access point placements for new wireless network deployments.</li> <li>Work with the network infrastructure team to ensure access points are deployed in the desired locations and to standard.</li> <li>Perform wireless surveys to identify coverage gaps and performance concerns, and implement remediation.</li> <li>Troubleshoot wireless issues across a large enterprise deployment.</li> <li>Schedule and perform software and hardware updates.</li> <li>Procure and manage wireless hardware inventory.</li> <li>Monitor wireless network health using in-house and third-party tools.</li> <li>Create and maintain documentation of wireless networks.</li> </ul> <p><strong>BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Bachelor's degree in electrical engineering, computer engineering, or other STEM discipline and 3+ years of professional network engineering experience; OR 5+ years of professional network engineering experience and high school diploma or equivalency certificate in lieu of a degree.</li> </ul> <p><strong>PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Understanding of wireless and RF technologies.</li> <li>Experience with CBRS deployments.</li> <li>Cisco wireless LAN controllers or other wireless technologies.</li> <li>Cisco DNA Center.</li> <li>Ekahau wireless products.</li> <li>Network monitoring tools.</li> <li>Network documentation.</li> <li>Linux/Windows system administration.</li> <li>Industry-standard certifications such as CCNA, CCNP, CCIE, or equivalent vendor certifications.</li> </ul> <p><strong>ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS:</strong></p> <ul> <li>This role requires you to be onsite. title: Journeyman Electrician (Starlink)
jd_text: <div class="content-intro"><p>SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of&nbsp;enabling human life on Mars.</p></div><p><strong>JOURNEYMAN ELECTRICIAN (STARLINK)&nbsp;</strong></p> <p>SpaceX is leveraging our experience building rockets and spacecraft to deploy Starlink, the world’s largest satellite constellation and most advanced broadband internet system. We provide reliable and fast internet to millions of users worldwide, including populations with little or no connectivity, rural communities, aircraft, watercraft, and places where existing services are unreliable, too expensive, or disconnected by natural disasters. We design, build, test, and operate all parts of the system, thousands of satellites and consumer antennae that allow users to connect within minutes of unboxing. electrician license&nbsp;</li> <li>Ability to identify and implement efficient paths of action to finish the assigned work</li> <li>Ability to test, calibrate, diagnose, and repair various title: Jr. Sous Chef - Temporary
jd_text: <div class="content-intro"><p>SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. SOUS CHEF - TEMPORARY</strong></p> <p>SpaceX is looking for passionate, experienced individuals to join our culinary team! title: Launch Operations Engineer (Starship)
jd_text: <div class="content-intro"><p>SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of&nbsp;enabling human life on Mars.</p></div><p><strong>LAUNCH OPERATIONS ENGINEER (STARSHIP)</strong></p> <p>At SpaceX, our commitment to reliability begins with design but is realized through exhaustive testing and a high future launch cadence at our Starbase, TX facility. In order to thoroughly vet hardware and ensure vehicle quality, the launch operations team pushes our hardware to its limits in as close to flight-like conditions as possible, and then sends it to orbit! Launch Operations Engineers are ultimately responsible for the entire operational process. They develop test requirements, develop launch plans, integrate the on-pad flight/test articles, perform on-console operation of the entire launch system, conduct tests, analyze data to confirm performance and inform the vehicle and ground design/production process, and are the primary flight controllers for launch events.</p> <p><strong>RESPONSIBILITIES:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Serve as on-console flight controllers during launch events&nbsp;</li> <li>Test integrated rocket hardware to determine suitability for flight&nbsp;</li> <li>Provide on-console engineering support for technicians during daily test/launch stand operations&nbsp;</li> <li>Write and review control logic/automation for test &amp; launch systems&nbsp;</li> <li>Perform real-time and post-op data review to evaluate the performance of launch/test article and stand systems (software, fluid, structural, thermal, electrical). This includes documenting operational results and recommending areas for upgrades and improvement&nbsp;</li> <li>Find innovative ways to create, review, and optimize test &amp; launch processes/procedures to increase launch system capability and rate&nbsp;</li> <li>Identify and characterize system pitfalls and potential hazards; then work to resolve these by collaborating with design, production, and ground system engineers on improvements for flight hardware and processes&nbsp;</li> <li>Serve as the final authority to ensure all operations are conducted in a safe manner&nbsp;</li> <li>Perform other related duties, as assigned, for the purpose of ensuring an efficient and effective work environment&nbsp;</li> </ul> <p><strong>BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Bachelor’s degree in mechanical engineering, chemical engineering, aerospace engineering, or other engineering discipline</li> <li>1+ years of hands-on build or design experience (internship, club, and competition team experience qualifies)</li> </ul> <p><strong>PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:</strong></p> <ul> <li>3+ years of hands-on experience with complex and/or low-margin mechanical, structural, fluid, and electronic systems</li> <li>Ability to thrive in ambiguous requirements and aggressive timelines</li> <li>High levels of personal autonomy and self-driven motivation&nbsp;</li> <li>Strong interpersonal skills and ability to work effectively in a team environment, accomplishing tasks with limited resources at a rapid pace</li> <li>Demonstrated history of working efficiently with hazardous systems (high pressure, high voltage, cryogenic, toxic, flammable, hypergolic, pyrophoric)&nbsp;</li> <li>High level of familiarity with complex system control and instrumentation&nbsp;</li> <li>Experience with analytical data review tools and numerical methods to solve real-world problems (Python, R, MATLAB, NI LabVIEW)&nbsp;</li> <li>Demonstrated experience in technical drawings, data reports, mechanical schematics, electrical schematics, and design specifications&nbsp;</li> </ul> <p><strong>ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Flight hardware is This technician will work with an elite team of other fabricators to rapidly build and weld the large assemblies that will contribute to Starship &amp; Super Heavy vehicle testing at our South Texas facility.</p> <p><strong>RESPONSIBILITIES:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Complete welding assignments and procedures for the construction and repair of all site structural stands on time, safely, and in a title: Lead Electrical Test Engineer (Starlink)
jd_text: <div class="content-intro"><p>SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of&nbsp;enabling human life on Mars.</p></div><p><strong>LEAD ELECTRICAL TEST ENGINEER (STARLINK)</strong></p> <p>SpaceX is leveraging its experience in building rockets and spacecraft to deploy Starlink, the world’s most advanced broadband internet system. Starlink is the world’s largest satellite constellation and is providing fast, reliable internet to millions of users worldwide. We design, build, test, and operate all parts of the system – thousands of satellites, consumer receivers, and the software that brings it all together.</p> <p>As a Lead Electrical Test Engineer you are the technical owner of high-volume PCB electrical test at the Starlink factory in Bastrop: in-circuit test, flying probe, programs, multi-unit fixtures and racks, test PCBAs, coverage, and first-article. You spend a substantial share of time on the testers and technically lead test engineers, technicians, and specialists. You report to the Electrical Test Engineering Manager, who owns the organization, staffing, and the yield and throughput numbers.</p> <p><strong>RESPONSIBILITIES</strong></p> <ul> <li>Own electrical test production program quality: in-circuit (Teradyne or equivalent) and flying-probe programs, fixtures, correlation, change control, and first-article for new products and panel revisions, including yield, false-fail / false-pass, and throughput.</li> <li>Design and own test fixtures and racks for multi-unit production test: mechanical structure, unit presentation, and electrical interface, designed for production rate and durability.</li> <li>Design and own test PCBAs: schematic, layout, bring-up, and fabrication/assembly of boards used in the test process.</li> <li>Debug yield, false-fail, and false-pass on the production floor; drive technical root cause with CAM and process engineering.</li> <li>Develop and maintain Design For Test (DFT) guidelines and work with design and CAM teams to implement them on new panels.</li> <li>Develop test strategies, perform test coverage analyses, and conduct formal test strategy reviews with peer teams.</li> <li>Write or maintain automation software to interact with testers, instrumentation, and production documentation systems.</li> <li>Technically lead test engineers, technicians, and specialists on programs, fixtures/racks, test PCBAs, and debug.</li> <li>Spend a substantial share of time on individual technical work (programs, fixtures/racks, test PCBAs, equipment).</li> <li>Travel to other SpaceX factories to transfer working production programs and fixtures as needed.</li> </ul> <p><strong>BASIC QUALIFICATIONS</strong></p> <ul> <li>Bachelor’s degree in electrical engineering, mechanical engineering, or other engineering discipline.</li> <li>3+ years of experience in high-volume electrical or manufacturing test (ICT, flying probe, functional, or equivalent production board test).</li> <li>2+ years of expereince mentoring engineers on a test process.</li> </ul> <p><strong>PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE</strong></p> <ul> <li>High-volume PCB or PCBA production test in a factory (yield, escapes, units per hour).</li> <li>Hands-on fixture and multi-unit rack design (mechanical and electrical) used in production.</li> <li>Designed and released test PCBAs (schematic and layout) and owned fabrication and assembly.</li> <li>Hands-on in-circuit test (ICT / Teradyne or equivalent) and/or flying probe: programs, fixtures, and debug.</li> <li>Experience analyzing circuits, developing functional or in-circuit test plans, and performing test coverage analysis.</li> <li>Experience with test equipment and measurement techniques (oscilloscope, multimeter, electronic load, source measurement unit, etc.).</li> <li>Understanding of electrical schematics and electronics manufacturing to analyze and improve test coverage.</li> <li>Understanding of metrology, sources of measurement error, and uncertainty analysis.</li> <li>Programming experience (Python, C/C++) for tester automation.</li> <li>Experience interacting with repositories using Git.</li> <li>Experience closing a yield, coverage, or throughput gap with data on a production test process.</li> </ul> <p><strong>ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS</strong></p> <ul> <li>Ability to work extended hours or weekends as needed for mission critical deadlines.</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong>ITAR REQUIREMENTS:</strong></p> <ul> <li>To conform to U.S. Government export regulations, applicant must be a (i) U.S. citizen or national, (ii) U.S. lawful, permanent resident (aka green card holder), (iii) Refugee under 8 U.S.C. § 1157, or (iv) Asylee under 8 U.S.C. § 1158, or be eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State. Learn more about the ITAR <a href="https://www.pmddtc.state.gov/?id=ddtc_kb_article_page&amp;sys_id=24d528fddbfc930044f9ff621f961987">here</a>. &nbsp;</li> </ul> <p>SpaceX is an Equal Opportunity Employer; employment with SpaceX is governed on the basis of merit, competence and qualifications and will not be influenced in any manner by race, color, religion, gender, national origin/ethnicity, veteran status, disability status, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, mental or physical disability or any other legally protected status.</p> <p>Applicants wishing to view a copy of SpaceX’s Affirmative Action Plan for veterans and individuals with disabilities, or applicants requiring reasonable accommodation to the application/interview process should reach out to&nbsp;<a href="mailto:EEOCompliance@spacex.com">EEOCompliance@spacex.com</a><em>.&nbsp;</em></p></div>

jd_text: <div class="content-intro"><p>SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of&nbsp;enabling human life on Mars.</p></div><p><strong>LEAD ENGINEER, DEVELOPMENT OPERATIONS (STARLINK) - BASTROP</strong></p> <p>SpaceX is leveraging its experience in building rockets and spacecraft to deploy Starlink, the world’s most advanced broadband internet system. Starlink is the world’s largest satellite constellation and is providing fast, reliable internet to millions of users worldwide. We design, build, test, and operate all parts of the system — thousands of satellites, consumer receivers that allow users to connect within minutes of unboxing, and the software that brings it all together.</p> <p>Development Operations in Bastrop is the shop that turns engineering intent into hardware: fixtures, tooling, CNC, weld, modular automation cells, and the mechanical catalog that factory and test programs pull from. We are looking for a Lead Engineer to own that engineering stack — design, DFM, and the engineers who run it — so programs hit schedule without a hero on every job.</p> <p>This role encompasses design, analysis, and manufacturing. You will spearhead large-scope projects from early design trades through fab and handoff. You will define processes, drive requirements, and set the design bar (GD&amp;T, NX, fixtures that the mill can actually cut). You partner with Development Supervisors who own technician people ops.</p> <p><strong>RESPONSIBILITIES:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Lead the Development Operations engineering team (Build Engineers and design/DFM ICs): hire, coach, set goals, and raise the bar on quality, throughput, and schedule</li> <li>Own design for manufacturability from concept through fab: original CAD, GD&amp;T, design reviews, and design changes that reduce cost, complexity, and cycle time</li> <li>Own fixtures, tooling, workholding, and mechanical catalog items (cells, conveyors, buffers, stands) from raw material through handoff to the customer program</li> <li>Act as technical decision maker for the shop engineering stack — what we make, how we make it, and when we push a design back to the RE</li> <li>Partner with Development Supervisors on intake, queue, and expedite</li> <li>Partner with CNC programmers, machinists, welders, ACE specialists, and inventory</li> <li>Drive NCR, root cause, and corrective action on non-conforming product (tooling, cells, fixtures, piece parts)</li> <li>Create and maintain build documentation: procedures, MBOMs, integration instructions, and planning that technicians and vendors can execute</li> <li>Interface with supply chain and vendors so piece parts and sub-assemblies hit rate</li> <li>Present look-ahead with a recommendation (options, capacity, risk)</li> <li>Support Development Test with fixtures and fab</li> </ul> <p><strong>BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Bachelor’s degree in mechanical engineering or other engineering discipline</li> <li>2+ year leading a product development, manufacturing engineering, or project team</li> <li>3+ years of hands-on design, analysis, build, and/or manufacturing of mechanical or electromechanical hardware</li> </ul> <p><strong>PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:</strong></p> <ul> <li>2+ years of experience with CAD (NX, SolidWorks, or equivalent)</li> <li>Demonstrated full-cycle The ideal candidate should be a self-starter and have excellent motivation, leadership, communication skills, and the ability to supervise multiple projects.</p> <p><strong>RESPONSIBILITIES: title: Lead Full Stack Engineer, Starship Manufacturing (Application Software)
jd_text: <div class="content-intro"><p>SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of&nbsp;enabling human life on Mars.</p></div><p><strong>LEAD FULL STACK ENGINEER, STARSHIP MANUFACTURING (APPLICATION SOFTWARE)</strong></p> <p>The application software team is the central nervous system of SpaceX – we create mission critical applications that are used throughout SpaceX to accelerate launch vehicle production and flight as well as systems that allow Starlink to grow into a worldwide fast, reliable Internet service.</p> <p>Our team is currently creating and evolving systems to enable rapid build and reuse of Starship as well as designing the next generation manufacturing software that will be used in high throughput factories for Starlink. Other applications range from platforms that support concurrent streams of data from many always-on assets to manage the world’s largest satellite constellation to public facing systems where customers can join our Starlink network globally. We work closely with engineers throughout the company to create and update our systems with respect to crewed launches, Starship flights, changes to the Starlink network and much more.</p> <p>Aerospace experience is not required to be successful here - rather we look for smart, motivated, collaborative engineers who love solving problems and want to make an impact on a super inspiring mission. You will have full ownership of challenging problems, working with a team of enthusiastic engineers to design and produce solutions that enable SpaceX to move towards our goals at a rapid pace. The success of the missions at SpaceX depends on the software that you and your team produce.</p> <p>As a Lead Software Engineer on the Application Software team, you will have the opportunity to lead a team of highly skilled engineers both from a technical and personnel development perspective.</p> <p><strong>RESPONSIBILITIES:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Directly manage a team of software engineers</li> <li>Own all aspects, including prioritization, implementation, and delivery, of a system roadmap</li> <li>Provide strong technical leadership with a focus on continuous improvement</li> <li>Manage and track multiple priorities while maintaining a focus towards common project goals</li> <li>Develop highly reliable and available software systems</li> <li>Maintain highest standards of excellence, never settle for the status quo</li> <li>Collaborate with other leaders in the department, and across the company, to ensure success for SpaceX</li> </ul> <p><strong>BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, math, or science discipline and 3+ years of software development experience; OR 6+ years of professional experience building software in lieu of a degree</li> <li>1+ years of experience with object-oriented programming</li> <li>1+ years of experience with leading software teams or projects</li> </ul> <p><strong>PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Programming experience in Python, C#, .NET, Go, Java, or similar object-oriented language</li> <li>Front-end experience in Angular, React, or similar JavaScript framework</li> <li>Experience with PostgreSQL, SQL Server, or similar database technologies</li> <li>4+ years of experience building single page web applications</li> <li>Expertise in designing software systems</li> <li>Expertise in testing and infrastructure</li> <li>Expertise in profiling and improving application performance</li> <li>Domain expertise in manufacturing systems</li> <li>Strong desire to mentor and grow employees</li> <li>Able to collaborate across group and department lines with a wide range of engineers and managers, including networking and working in a team development environment</li> <li>Excellent communication and teamwork skills</li> </ul> <p><strong>ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Must be able to work extended hours and weekends as needed</li> <li>Must be willing to travel when needed</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong>ITAR REQUIREMENTS:</strong></p> <ul> <li>To conform to U.S. Government export regulations, applicant must be a (i) U.S. citizen or national, (ii) U.S. lawful, permanent resident (aka green card holder), (iii) Refugee under 8 U.S.C. § 1157, or (iv) Asylee under 8 U.S.C. § 1158, or be eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State. title: Lead Hardware Development Engineer (Starlink)
jd_text: <div class="content-intro"><p>SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of&nbsp;enabling human life on Mars.</p></div><p><strong>LEAD HARDWARE DEVELOPMENT ENGINEER (STARLINK)</strong></p> <p><span data-contrast="none">Starlink believes in providing fast, reliable internet to serve populations with little or no connectivity. We design, build, launch, and operate the world’s largest constellation of satellites, enabling us to operate a global internet network unbounded by traditional ground infrastructure limitations. The root of SpaceX’s success so far lies in our mission to keep all engineering and production in-house, which enables a tight feedback loop, nimble decision-making, and speedy deliverables. With millions of daily users worldwide already online, Starlink is truly a game changer and levels the playing field for those who were previously unconnected.</span><span data-ccp-props="{&quot;335559739&quot;:160}">&nbsp;</span></p> <p><span data-contrast="none">We are developing cutting-edge, highly reliable, and high-volume electronics for communicating with our constellation of satellites and are looking for outstanding engineers to join our team.</span><span data-ccp-props="{&quot;335559739&quot;:160}">&nbsp;</span></p> <p><span data-contrast="none">The Starlink Product Development Team is responsible for the development of customer-facing products which are manufactured in the range of many millions per year, including phased array satellite dishes, high speed WiFi routers, and power supplies.</span><span data-ccp-props="{&quot;335559739&quot;:160}">&nbsp;</span></p> <p><span data-contrast="none">As a Lead Hardware Engineer on the Starlink team, you will lead a team of 3–5 engineers, and own the full ecosystem and roadmap of our consumer electronics from start to finish. You will set the technical direction, grow the engineers on your team into product owners, and work regularly with partner teams across antenna, software, mechanical, thermal, manufacturing, and production test to take this hardware from initial concept through full-scale production.</span><span data-ccp-props="{&quot;335559739&quot;:160}">&nbsp;</span></p> <p><strong>RESPONSIBILITIES:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Lead a team of 3-5 engineers to rapidly design, develop, and test highly reliable electronics for our Gateway systems</li> <li>Drive electrical architecture, specification, component selection, circuit board design, implementation, verification, board bring-up, and debugging</li> <li>Optimize existing designs to improve reliability and reduce production and field defects</li> <li>Implement automated design validation test assets to speed up development cycles</li> <li data-leveltext="" data-font="Symbol" data-listid="1" data-list-defn-props="{&quot;335552541&quot;:1,&quot;335559685&quot;:360,&quot;335559991&quot;:360,&quot;469769226&quot;:&quot;Symbol&quot;,&quot;469769242&quot;:[8226],&quot;469777803&quot;:&quot;left&quot;,&quot;469777804&quot;:&quot;&quot;,&quot;469777815&quot;:&quot;singleLevel&quot;}" data-aria-posinset="6" data-aria-level="1"><span data-contrast="none"><span data-ccp-parastyle="List Bullet">Hire, coach, and develop direct reports so they can own their products and make decisions without waiting on you</span></span><span data-ccp-props="{&quot;335559739&quot;:40}">&nbsp;</span></li> <li>Develop and train direct reports to enable product ownership and empowered decision making</li> <li>Partner with antenna, software, mechanical, networking, thermal, manufacturing and production test teams</li> </ul> <p><strong>BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Bachelor’s title: Lead Manufacturing Engineer (Starlink PCBA)
jd_text: <div class="content-intro"><p>SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of&nbsp;enabling human life on Mars.</p></div><p><strong>LEAD MANUFACTURING ENGINEER (STARLINK PCBA)</strong></p> <p>SpaceX is developing a low-latency, broadband internet system to meet the needs of people around the world. Enabled by a constellation of low Earth orbit satellites, Starlink will provide fast, reliable internet to populations with little or no connectivity, including those in rural communities and places where existing services are too expensive or unreliable. To enable our goal of “Connecting the Unconnected,” SpaceX is ramping up production of our User Terminal Kit manufacturing facility in Bastrop, Texas (Greater Austin), which will bring hundreds of high-skill manufacturing jobs to the area.</p> <p>SpaceX is also leveraging its experience deploying and operating the world’s largest satellite constellation to develop Starmind, a new constellation of satellites capturing solar energy in space to power low-cost, high-performance AI compute for Earth.</p> <p>As the Lead Manufacturing Engineer of Starlink PCBA production at SpaceX, you will have the opportunity to utilize your knowledge, experience, and creativity to develop novel solutions at the cutting edge of technology. You will own the relationship between our development and production teams. You will provide input into the design and development of new and existing hardware and take a lead role in manufacturing on our current and next generation Starlink products and AI compute.</p> <p><strong>RESPONSIBILITIES:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Lead a team of engineers and specialists for the Starlink PCBA manufacturing team</li> <li>Responsible products and processes will include SMT, post-processing manufacturing processes, and testing</li> <li>Responsible for implementing plug-and-play processes to production that are capable of high volume throughput (3M+ per year)</li> <li>Align department initiatives with the goals and responsibilities of the manufacturing engineering team</li> <li>Lead the overall manufacturing development strategy for the areas under ownership for key metrics: quality, delivery, and cost. Actively measure team’s performance against these metrics</li> <li>Manage team’s technical documentation strategy and ensure records are up-to-date</li> <li>Manage and mentor other manufacturing engineers and interns on the team. title: Lead Mechanical Engineer (Starship Avionics)
jd_text: <div class="content-intro"><p>SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of&nbsp;enabling human life on Mars.</p></div><p><strong>LEAD MECHANICAL ENGINEER (STARSHIP AVIONICS)&nbsp;</strong></p> <p>Starship Avionics Mechanical is responsible for producing an avionics system minimizing vehicle cost/mass and providing electrical sensing, actuation, and control for flying the vehicle. Avionics includes RF communication, navigation sensors, electrical actuators, video systems, propulsion sensors, and energy storage. This role leads a team of mechanical engineers, and it is within a larger avionics team of electrical engineers designing electrical system and vehicle operations. This role will partner closely with adjacent Starship engineering and production teams to continuously improve the design and manufacturability of avionics hardware for current and next-generation vehicles. Team mission is to develop highly producible mechanical designs and packaging solutions that protect electronics from the harsh mechanical and thermal environments of launch vehicle operations.&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>RESPONSIBILITIES:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Extreme ownership of avionics engineers to enable the rapid progress of design, integration, test, and launch activities</li> <li>Drive conceptual design, architecture trades, and first order sizing</li> <li>Develop design requirements where definition is lacking</li> <li>Optimize the development speed, mass, and cost on our avionics</li> <li>Perform in depth first principles analysis and FEA to assess and optimize designs</li> <li>Incorporate design for manufacturing principles, drive first article builds, and make improvements necessary to hand off subsequent builds to production</li> <li>Support production issues and drive design, process, and procedure improvements for maximum production efficiency and rate after first article build</li> <li>Design and execute development, acceptance, and qualification testing</li> <li>Drive delivery timeline through conception, design, parts, assembly and integration, and launch</li> <li>Work closely with analysts to develop thermal, vibration, and loading requirements and with manufacturing engineers to optimize designs for rapid manufacturability</li> </ul> <p><strong>BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Bachelor’s degree in an engineering, science, or math discipline</li> <li>3+ years of professional experience designing mechanical components or assemblies</li> </ul> <p><strong>PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:</strong></p> <ul> <li>1+ years of experience leading teams, either formally or as part of a team project</li> <li>Creative problem solving that can bring multiple disciplines together with the ability to assess risk and make design and development decisions without all available data</li> <li>Ability to work in a fast paced, autonomously driven, and demanding atmosphere</li> <li>Self-motivated with strong multi-tasking, organizational, communication and documentation skills</li> <li>Strong sense of accountability and integrity</li> <li>Solid understanding and application of GD&amp;T</li> <li>Proficient and frequent use of hand calculations, finite element analyses (FEA), and computer-aided designs (CAD)</li> </ul> <p><strong>ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS:</strong></p> <ul> <li>This position is based in Starbase, TX and requires being onsite - remote work not considered</li> <li>Must be able to work extended hours and weekends to support critical project and mission milestones</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong>ITAR REQUIREMENTS:</strong></p> <ul> <li>To conform to U.S. Government export or be eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State. title: Lead Mechanical Engineer, MEP
jd_text: <div class="content-intro"><p>SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of&nbsp;enabling human life on Mars.</p></div><p><strong>LEAD MECHANICAL ENGINEER, MEP (TEXAS CONSTRUCTION PROJECTS)</strong></p> <p>As lead mechanical engineer, MEP, on the Texas Construction Projects team, you will provide technical leadership and direction to engineers across multiple disciplines in the design, construction, and activation of critical infrastructure that enables SpaceX to achieve its long-term mission. You will own the successful delivery of large capital projects for internal customer groups across the company, drive technical decisions, mentor team members, and ensure projects meet performance, schedule, and quality objectives. This position is based in McGregor, TX (Waco area). Travel may be required, and based on business needs, opportunities to support other SpaceX facilities may arise in the future.</p> <p><strong>RESPONSIBILITIES:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Provide technical leadership and direction to the project team, consulting engineers, and contractors throughout the full lifecycle of mechanical, electrical, and plumbing (MEP) engineering, procurement, construction, and commissioning for large capital projects</li> <li>Direct the development and issuance of engineering drawings, design documentation, and technical reports for aerospace, industrial, and commercial infrastructure projects</li> <li>Lead the preparation, negotiation, and management of construction contracts with subcontractors across multiple disciplines, from initial award through final close-out</li> <li>Drive the real-time resolution of complex design and construction conflicts in the field, ensuring minimal impact to schedule and cost</li> <li>Lead coordination efforts with electrical utility providers on design and engineering activities to ensure reliable and resilient power delivery to critical site infrastructure</li> <li>Serve as the primary technical interface with engineers, contractors, fabricators, and key project stakeholders, fostering alignment and driving successful project outcomes</li> </ul> <p><strong>BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Bachelor's degree in electrical engineering, mechanical engineering, or other engineering discipline</li> <li>2+ years of professional experience with the design or build of MEP building systems</li> <li>1+ years of leadership experience leading teams, projects, or people</li> </ul> <p><strong>PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Primary experience with electrical and power distribution systems (&lt;600Vac)</li> <li>Knowledge of HVAC operation and design principles including refrigeration, chillers, boilers, and air-handling equipment</li> <li>Experience with plumbing design and operation including domestic water, wastewater, venting, and storm systems</li> <li>Working knowledge of delta/wye transformers, building lighting, building construction specifications, and facility grounding</li> <li>Experience with critical power infrastructure including UPS systems, backup generators, and automatic transfer switches</li> <li>Experience creating and implementing process/design solutions with minimal impact to business operations</li> <li>Able to quickly assess an issue and assist technicians with troubleshooting and repair</li> <li>Ability to work in a high-concentration, high-stress environment, under possible extended work hours and tight deadlines</li> <li>Acute attention to detail, ability to see interactions with other systems to avoid problems</li> <li>AutoCAD/Revit – Beginner to intermediate skill level</li> <li>Familiarity with National Electric Code, ASHRAE, National Fire Protection Association, and International Building Code</li> </ul> <p><strong>ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Role may require extended hours, weekend work and shift schedules, that vary depending on site operational needs; flexibility required</li> <li>This role requires you to be onsite - remote or hybrid work will NOT be considered</li> <li>Perform hands-on work in all environments (heat, cold, rain), in tight quarters or at heights</li> <li>Remain focused while working in hazardous environments while wearing appropriate PPE</li> <li>Must be able to lift up to 25 lbs unassisted</li> <li>Must be able to travel to other SpaceX sites as needed (up to 25%)</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong>ITAR REQUIREMENTS:</strong></p> <ul> <li>To conform to U.S. Government export regulations, applicant must be a (i) U.S. citizen or national, (ii) U.S. lawful, permanent resident (aka green card holder), (iii) Refugee under 8 U.S.C. § 1157, or (iv) Asylee under 8 U.S.C. § 1158, or be eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State. Learn more about the ITAR <a href="https://www.pmddtc.state.gov/?id=ddtc_kb_article_page&amp;sys_id=24d528fddbfc930044f9ff621f961987">here</a>. &nbsp;</li> </ul> <p>SpaceX is an Equal Opportunity Employer; employment with SpaceX is governed on the basis of merit, competence and qualifications and will not be influenced in any manner by race, color, religion, gender, national origin/ethnicity, veteran status, disability status, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, mental or physical disability or any other legally protected status.</p> <p>Applicants wishing to view a copy of SpaceX’s Affirmative Action Plan for veterans and individuals with disabilities, or applicants requiring reasonable accommodation to the application/interview process should reach out to&nbsp;<a href="mailto:EEOCompliance@spacex.com">EEOCompliance@spacex.com</a><em>.&nbsp;</em></p></div>

title: Lead Operations Engineer
jd_text: <div class="content-intro"><p>SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of&nbsp;enabling human life on Mars.</p></div><p><strong>LEAD OPERATIONS ENGINEER</strong></p> <p>The Lead Operations Engineer supports SpaceX's business operations team by providing company level support for the environmental health and safety department systems and tools. They lead the operations engineers that support the various systems and resources that assist the EHS team and organization.&nbsp;&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>RESPONSIBILITIES:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Develop and implement dashboards and tools as needed for the environmental health and safety department.</li> <li>Analyze data related to environmental monitoring, incident reports, and safety performance to identify opportunities for data visualization.</li> <li>Collaborate with teams across all sites to solicit feedback on developed systems.</li> <li>Provide training sessions and educational materials to employees on awareness of proper usage of safety applications and visualization platforms.</li> <li>Collaborate with application software teams and/or contractors to create application improvements and manage software development projects to completion.</li> <li>Produce specific metric reports upon request.</li> <li>Identify operational challenges within the organization, lead problem formulation, determine root cause, and implement creative and effective solutions.</li> <li>Communicate effectively with different levels of the organization, including everything from layout reviews with engineers to presentations with leadership.</li> <li>Lead the operations engineers who run these systems. Set their priorities and review their work.</li> <li>Staff the team with the hiring manager, including requisitions, interviews, and leveling for operations engineers.</li> <li>Clear blockers and ensure redundancy across the team for consistent department and organization support.</li> <li>Manage projects and relationships with software team partners.</li> </ul> <p><strong>BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:</strong>&nbsp;</p> <ul> <li>Bachelor’s Degree.</li> <li>5+ years of experience in data analytics, environmental health and safety project management, and/or environmental health and safety coordination.</li> </ul> <p><strong>PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Attention to detail and commitment to quality.</li> <li><span data-teams="true">Proficiency with MS office, SQL databases, Excel and PowerPoint and Power BI.</span></li> <li>Ability to multi-task, to manage shifting priorities, and to follow through on projects with minimal supervision.</li> <li>Demonstrate innovative and futuristic thinking to drive continuous improvement.</li> </ul> <p><strong>ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Must be willing to travel regularly to U.S. SpaceX sites.</li> <li>Must be able to work extended hours and weekends for incidents, audits, and system cutovers.</li> <li>Must be able to walk manufacturing and industrial areas using required controls.</li> <li>Must be able to obtain and maintain any required site or government access.</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong>ITAR REQUIREMENTS:</strong></p> <ul> <li>To conform to U.S. Government export regulations, applicant must be a (i) U.S. citizen or national, (ii) U.S. lawful, permanent resident (aka green card holder), (iii) Refugee under 8 U.S.C. § 1157, or (iv) Asylee under 8 U.S.C. § 1158, or be eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State. title: Lead Physical Security Hardware Specialist
jd_text: <div class="content-intro"><p>SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of&nbsp;enabling human life on Mars.</p></div><p><strong>LEAD PHYSICAL SECURITY HARDWARE SPECIALIST&nbsp;</strong></p> <p>Help SpaceX protect life and property anywhere company assets are deployed by leading the Security Systems and Technology Organization. This role is responsible for the global physical security technology stack and hardware organization supporting all SpaceX sites and personnel worldwide; encompassing strategy, systems and hardware integration, architecture, implementation, and lifecycle operations of access control systems (ACS), closed-circuit television (CCTV)/video management systems (VMS), intrusion detection systems (IDS), and related platforms. The Security Systems and Technology Senior Manager will build, mentor, and direct a high-performing global team of specialists while driving enterprise-wide projects, organizational change, system reliability, and continuous improvement through cutting-edge technology.</p> <p><strong>RESPONSIBILITIES:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Lead the Security Systems and Technology Organization, providing strategic direction and organizational leadership for the entire hardware and systems function</li> <li>Lead, mentor, train, and develop the global Security Hardware Specialist organization, including performance management, career progression, and knowledge transfer</li> <li>Develop and communicate the overall security systems and technology strategy, roadmap, and change management plans, aligning with SpaceX business objectives</li> <li>Drive end-to-end systems and hardware integration of access control, video management, intrusion detection, analytics, and related platforms with IT infrastructure, network security, facilities, HR systems, and other enterprise tools to deliver unified, scalable, and resilient security capabilities company-wide</li> <li>Serve as Principal Administrator and License Manager for enterprise platforms (Genetec Security Center, Lenel, Avigilon, and equivalents); provision and integrate new servers/systems; coordinate closely with IT, INFOSEC, and Purchasing</li> <li>Demonstrate and apply strong knowledge of Genetec platforms for unified access control, video surveillance, analytics, intrusion management, and related functions; evaluate and implement advanced capabilities</li> <li>Set and enforce enterprise standards for equipment selection, configuration, installation, training, certifications, and best practices; evaluate measures of effectiveness for new equipment types and technologies</li> <li>Ensure on-schedule completion of complex, multi-site projects with minimal supervision; standardize equipment, pricing, processes, and best practices</li> <li>Lead vendor/contractor management for design, installations, large-scale facility security infrastructure, and special projects</li> <li>Collaborate as senior representative on SCIF development, data centers, MDFs, and other high-priority security technology initiatives; maintain TS/SCI eligibility</li> <li>Oversee preventive maintenance programs, system health monitoring, troubleshooting protocols, inventory of hardware/tools/materials, and documentation of job status, changes, and project records</li> <li>Drive process improvements, creative applications of existing and new systems to solve emerging or systemic problems, and continuous reliability enhancements</li> <li>Maintain SOPs, Confluence pages, and JIRA tracking for enterprise projects</li> <li>Own budget planning, resource allocation, headcount, and performance metrics for the global Security Systems and Technology Organization; report program effectiveness and strategic progress to senior leadership</li> </ul> <p><strong>BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:</strong></p> <ul> <li>High school diploma or equivalency certification</li> <li>5+ years of experience managing enterprise-level physical security systems such as CCTV, access control, VMS, intrusion detection systems, fire and alarm systems), or alert systems</li> <li>1+ years of direct leadership responsibility across global sites</li> </ul> <p><strong>PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Bachelor’s&nbsp;degree in a relevant field (engineering, security management, information systems, or related) preferred</li> <li>Strong expertise and certifications in Genetec Security Center, Lenel Access Control, and/or Avigilon systems; prior experience as principal system administrator or license manager for large-scale global deployments</li> <li>Proven track record managing complex multi-site security technology projects, vendor portfolios, enterprise standardization, organizational change, and large-scale technology transformations at global scale</li> <li>Experience with International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR)</li> <li>Experience managing a portfolio of programs and projects, including owning enterprise programs in addition to site leadership responsibilities</li> <li>Experience with JIRA (or similar tools) to track work, issues, and project status</li> <li>10+ years of progressive experience in physical security technology, systems engineering, or hardware in space exploration, aviation, military, or other high-reliability operating environments</li> <li>Experience with SCIF design/support (ICD-705 / NISPOM), TS/SCI environments, and special programs</li> <li>Established skills in strategic and critical thinking, decision-making, communications, and relationship-building</li> <li>Highly organized, detail oriented, and possess a proven ability to thrive under pressure and to execute on a number of projects simultaneously</li> <li>Successful experience working in a fast-paced, dynamic, results-oriented team environment</li> </ul> <p><strong>ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Must be willing to work all shifts, extended hours, and/or weekends as needed</li> <li>Willingness to travel as needed (up to 35% or more) to support global sites and projects</li> <li>Must be able to obtain a TS/SCI clearance</li> <li>An active clearance may provide the opportunity for you to work on sensitive SpaceX missions; if so, you will be subject to pre-employment drug and random drug and alcohol testing</li> <li>Position is subject to random drug and alcohol testing</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong>ITAR REQUIREMENTS:</strong></p> <ul> <li>To conform to U.S. Government export regulations, applicant must be a (i) U.S. citizen or national, (ii) U.S. lawful, permanent resident (aka green card holder), (iii) Refugee under 8 U.S.C. § 1157, or (iv) Asylee under 8 U.S.C. § 1158, or be eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State.
