title: Lead Security Officer
jd_text: <div class="content-intro"><p>SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of&nbsp;enabling human life on Mars.</p></div><p><strong>LEAD SECURITY OFFICER</strong></p> <p>The Lead Security Officer is an elite security professional who performs advanced physical security assessments and threat simulations to test the defenses of SpaceX facilities and assets. Your expertise will help identify vulnerabilities and improve the overall security posture of the organization. This role requires a unique blend of physical security expertise, tactical training, and analytical skills, with the ability to make split-second decisions in high-stress environments.</p> <p><strong>RESPONSIBILITIES:&nbsp;<br></strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Red Team Operations:</strong> <ul> <li>Conduct physical security assessments and penetration testing of SpaceX facilities, including buildings, data centers, and other critical infrastructure.</li> <li>Develop and execute complex threat scenarios to test the effectiveness of security measures, including access control, surveillance, and alarm systems.</li> <li>Collaborate with security teams to identify vulnerabilities and recommend mitigation strategies.</li> </ul> </li> <li><strong>Special Operations:</strong> <ul> <li>Provide rapid response capabilities to support security incidents, including but not limited to, intrusions, breaches, or other high-risk situations.</li> <li>Work closely with security personnel to contain and resolve incidents, ensuring the safety of personnel and assets.</li> <li>Develop and maintain security protocols, procedures, and training programs to ensure readiness and effectiveness.</li> </ul> </li> <li><strong>Threat Assessment and Analysis:</strong> <ul> <li>Conduct research and analysis to identify potential threats to SpaceX facilities and assets, including insider threats, terrorism, and cyber-physical attacks.</li> <li>Develop and maintain threat profiles, including adversary tactics, techniques, and procedures (TTPs).</li> <li>Collaborate with intelligence teams to stay informed about emerging threats and trends.</li> </ul> </li> <li><strong>Decision-Making in High-Stress Environments:</strong> <ul> <li>Make split-second decisions in high-stress environments, prioritizing the safety of personnel and assets.</li> <li>Apply analytical and critical thinking skills to rapidly assess situations and develop effective response strategies.</li> <li>Maintain a calm and focused demeanor in high-pressure situations, ensuring effective communication and coordination with team members.</li> </ul> </li> <li><strong>Training and Exercises:</strong> <ul> <li>Develop and conduct training exercises for security personnel, including scenario-based training, tabletop exercises, and live-fire drills.Design and execute complex security exercises to test response procedures, including SWAT deployments and incident response.</li> <li>Evaluate exercise outcomes and provide recommendations for improvement.</li> </ul> </li> <li><strong>Additional Duties:</strong> <ul> <li>Maintain a high level of physical fitness and proficiency in tactical skills, including firearms, hand-to-hand combat, and tactical driving.</li> <li>Stay up-to-date with industry best practices, emerging threats, and advances in security technology.</li> <li>Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including security, engineering, and facilities management, to ensure a holistic approach to security.</li> </ul> </li> </ul> <p><strong>BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:<br></strong></p> <ul> <li>High school diploma or equivalency certificate.</li> <li>5+ years of experience in the military, law enforcement, overseas security contracting, or advanced corporate security realm.</li> <li>1+ years of experience with executive protection, mobile asset protection, or emergency response team experience.</li> </ul> <p><strong>PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:<br></strong></p> <ul> <li>Completed training in SWAT operations, including tactical response and crisis management, or military special operations.</li> <li>Proficiency in firearms, defensive tactics, and tactical driving.</li> <li>Bachelor's degree in a relevant field, such as security management, criminology, or international relations.</li> <li>Experience in red teaming, penetration testing, or threat assessment.</li> <li>Combat medic, EMT-B, or paramedic related experience.</li> <li>Advanced medical emergency training (TCCC/TECC/Combat Lifesaver).</li> <li>Familiarity with security protocols, including access control, surveillance, and alarm systems.</li> <li>Knowledge of threat intelligence, including insider threats, terrorism, and cyber-physical attacks.</li> <li>Experience with exercise design and execution, including scenario-based training and tabletop exercises.</li> <li>Computer based proficiency with Microsoft Windows and Microsoft Office, including Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and Outlook.</li> <li>Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.</li> <li>Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.</li> <li>Ability to work in a fast-paced, dynamic environment with minimal supervision.</li> </ul> <p><strong>ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Availability to work any schedule needed, to include overtime, nights, weekends and rotating.</li> <li>Position is subject to enhanced pre-employment screening, including a background check, psychological test, bi-annual physical fitness test, and a drug and alcohol test.</li> <li>Position is subject to random drug and alcohol testing.</li> <li>Ability and willingness to occasionally stand in a static position for extended periods.</li> <li>Willingness to travel up to 15% of time in support of SpaceX Security requirements should the need arise.</li> <li>Valid driver’s license.</li> <li>Possess or be eligible for a valid state security officer license.</li> <li>Eligible for a US Government security clearance.</li> <li>Ability to effectively execute duties in extreme outdoor environments – heat, cold, rain.</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong>ITAR REQUIREMENTS:</strong></p> <ul> <li>To conform to U.S. Government export regulations, applicant must be a (i) U.S. citizen or national, (ii) U.S. lawful, permanent resident (aka green card holder), (iii) Refugee under 8 U.S.C. § 1157, or (iv) Asylee under 8 U.S.C. § 1158, or be eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State. Learn more about the ITAR <a href="https://www.pmddtc.state.gov/?id=ddtc_kb_article_page&amp;sys_id=24d528fddbfc930044f9ff621f961987">here</a>. &nbsp;</li> </ul> <p>SpaceX is an Equal Opportunity Employer; employment with SpaceX is governed on the basis of merit, competence and qualifications and will not be influenced in any manner by race, color, religion, gender, national origin/ethnicity, veteran status, disability status, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, mental or physical disability or any other legally protected status.</p> <p>Applicants wishing to view a copy of SpaceX’s Affirmative Action Plan for veterans and individuals with disabilities, or applicants requiring reasonable accommodation to the application/interview process should reach out to&nbsp;<a href="mailto:EEOCompliance@spacex.com">EEOCompliance@spacex.com</a><em>.&nbsp;</em></p></div>

title: Lead Software Engineer, Application Software (Manufacturing)
jd_text: <div class="content-intro"><p>SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of&nbsp;enabling human life on Mars.</p></div><p><strong>LEAD SOFTWARE ENGINEER, APPLICATION SOFTWARE (MANUFACTURING)</strong></p> <p>The application software team is the central nervous system of SpaceX – we create mission critical applications that are used throughout SpaceX to accelerate launch vehicle production and flight as well as systems that allow Starlink to grow into a worldwide fast, reliable Internet service.</p> <p>Our team is currently creating and evolving systems to enable rapid build and reuse of Starship as well as designing the next generation manufacturing software that will be used in high throughput factories for Starlink. Other applications range from platforms that support concurrent streams of data from many always-on assets to manage the world’s largest satellite constellation to public facing systems where customers can join our Starlink network globally. We work closely with engineers throughout the company to create and update our systems with respect to crewed launches, Starship flights, changes to the Starlink network and much more.</p> <p>Aerospace experience is not required to be successful here - rather we look for smart, motivated, collaborative engineers who love solving problems and want to make an impact on a super inspiring mission. You will have full ownership of challenging problems, working with a team of enthusiastic engineers to design and produce solutions that enable SpaceX to move towards our goals at a rapid pace. Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of&nbsp;enabling human life on Mars.</p></div><p><strong>MACHINE MAINTENANCE SUPERVISOR (STARLINK) - MULTIPLE SHIFTS</strong><br><br>At SpaceX, we are applying decades of experience designing, building, and flying rockets and spacecraft to deploy Starlink—the world’s most advanced broadband internet system. Starlink is the largest satellite constellation ever built and already delivers fast, reliable internet to millions of users worldwide. We design, manufacture, test, and operate every element of the system: thousands of satellites, user terminals that connect within minutes of unboxing, and the software that ties it all together. We are only beginning to realize Starlink’s potential global impact and are seeking exceptional talent to help maximize its value for communities and businesses around the world.</p> <p>SpaceX is looking for an experienced Machine Maintenance Supervisor to lead maintenance operations that support Starlink production and operations. In this role, you will build and develop a high-performing maintenance team and establish the processes, standards, and culture needed for excellence. You will manage schedules, workflows, and resources in a fast-paced manufacturing environment while ensuring equipment reliability and uptime that directly enable Starlink’s mission.</p> <p><strong>RESPONSIBILITIES: </strong></p> <ul> <li>Lead the build-out and development of a high-performing team of multi-skilled technicians capable of supporting the full range of process equipment used in Starlink production</li> <li>Establish and continuously refine Preventive Maintenance (PM) work plans and schedules for all assets</li> <li>Drive collaboration with engineers and planners to define corrective maintenance strategies and target completion dates based on failure analysis, ensuring they feed into robust Preventive Maintenance (PM) schedules</li> <li>Spearhead the partnership with engineering to stay current on emerging technologies and proactively evaluate/implement solutions that improve production operations and equipment reliability</li> <li>Build and manage a spares inventory strategy tailored to each equipment type to fully support the overall maintenance approach</li> <li>Direct coordination with the scheduler to ensure the right technicians and contractors are assigned to complete the full Preventive Maintenance (PM) schedule</li> <li>Oversee the execution of all maintenance work, including emergency breakdowns, while actively monitoring progress and removing obstacles</li> <li>Lead hands-on troubleshooting and technical decision-making as needed to drive timely resolution of issues</li> <li>Ensure clear, proactive communication of work progress and status to all stakeholders at every stage</li> <li>Develop and manage key performance metrics (Uptime, OEE, Mean Time to Repair, etc.) to drive data-based decision making across the department</li> <li>Verify and confirm that all maintenance activities have been completed as planned and that assets are restored to required operating specifications</li> <li>Identify residual risks or effects after repairs and take decisive action to prevent recurrence</li> <li>Lead root cause analysis and deliver high-quality reports that feed learning and improvement opportunities back to maintenance engineers and asset owners</li> <li>Assign the correct skills to every job, maintain an accurate skills matrix for the entire technician team, and proactively identify and close training gaps</li> <li>Manage daily activity logging, major breakdown reporting, workforce shift utilization, and absence requests to ensure full operational visibility and control</li> </ul> <p><strong>BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Bachelor’s degree and 2+ years of professional experience in machining, maintenance, or production/manufacturing; OR 5+ years of professional experience in machining, maintenance, or production/manufacturing</li> <li>1+ years of experience directly leading a team or project</li> </ul> <p><strong>PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE: </strong></p> <ul> <li>Degree in an engineering discipline</li> <li>Experience working in a high-volume manufacturing or production environment that required frequent adaptation to changing work assignments and shifting priorities</li> <li>Demonstrated ownership of clear, effective verbal and written communication with engineering and production teams</li> <li>Proven experience applying lean manufacturing principles and efficiency methods to drive operational improvements</li> <li>Experience leading the development of multi-skilled technician teams, including ownership of skills matrices and training plans</li> <li>Experience owning the creation and management of key maintenance metrics (Uptime, OEE, Mean Time to Repair) to drive data-based decisions</li> <li>Experience leading root cause analysis and owning the implementation of corrective and preventive actions that improve equipment reliability</li> </ul> <p><strong>ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS: </strong></p> <ul> <li>Must be willing to work all shifts, extended hours, and weekends as needed</li> <li>Must be able to work one or more of the following shifts:</li> <ul> <li>AWS B Shift: 5:00am-5:30pm Wednesday-Saturday</li> <li>AWS C Shift: 5:00pm-5:30am Sunday-Wednesday</li> <li>Split Shift: 8:00am-8:00pm Sunday-Wednesday</li> <li>Split Shift: 8:00am-8:00pm Wednesday-Saturday</li> </ul> <li>Ability to lift up to 25 lbs. unassisted</li> <li>Ability to lift, stand, climb, bend, grasp, sit, pull, push, stoop, stretch, and carry are generally required to perform the functions of this position</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong>ITAR REQUIREMENTS:</strong></p> <ul> <li>To conform to U.S. Government export regulations, applicant must be a (i) U.S. citizen or national, (ii) U.S. lawful, permanent resident (aka green card holder), (iii) Refugee under 8 U.S.C. § 1157, or (iv) Asylee under 8 U.S.C. § 1158, or be eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State. You will have frequent interaction with engineering teams and leadership and will participate in developing and validating new equipment, processes, and technologies. The success of Starlink depends on the quality, reliability, cost, manufacturability, throughput, security, and user experience of the products that you will manufacture.</p> <p><strong>RESPONSIBILITIES:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Perform planned maintenance and unplanned repairs of production line equipment that includes copper electroplating, chemical etching, ultrapure process water treatment, solder mask printing, automated laser and mechanical drilling, PCB layup and lamination, and/or plasma etching systems</li> <li>Perform planned maintenance and unplanned repairs of production line assets that includes SMT line equipment, epoxy dispensing printers, conveyor systems, thermal chambers, test reliability chambers, and vacuum systems</li> <li>Read and necessary items</li> <li>Provide feedback and work with maintenance and engineering and vendor teams to drive root cause of equipment downtime</li> <li>Conduct training for production personnel</li> <li>Operate material handling equipment including, but not limited to, scissor lifts and forklifts</li> <li>Perform other related duties, as assigned, for the purpose of ensuring an efficient and effective work environment</li> </ul> <p><strong>BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:</strong></p> <ul> <li>High school diploma or equivalency certificate</li> <li>2+ years of maintenance or troubleshooting experience with mechanical, electrical, pneumatic, and/or hydraulic systems</li> </ul> <p><strong>PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Experience maintaining PCB manufacturing equipment from vendors such as Temgtai, Benmayor, Schmoll, Shoda, Sigma Mecer, Wise, Advanced Engineering, Boffotto, Dynachem, Indubond, Machvision, or others</li> <li>Experience maintaining ASM-SMT, Flexlink, Heller, Pemtron, Koh Young, Thermotron, Envirotronic, ESpec, Mycronic, Nordson, and Beckhoff equipment</li> <li>Experience maintaining Engel plastic injection molding machines and Idra high pressure die casting machines</li> <li>5+ years of experience as a maintenance technician or field service engineer</li> <li>Methodical approach to troubleshooting with high level of attention to detail</li> <li>Excellent manual dexterity in order to repair and perform preventative maintenance on manufacturing equipment</li> <li>Proficiently use a computer and MS Outlook and Word</li> <li>Ability to use power tools and hand tools</li> <li>Ability to read and interpret electrical, hydraulic and pneumatic schematics and drawings</li> <li>Ability to write detailed repair reports when necessary (skilled with use of Microsoft Office Suite)</li> <li>Ability to maintain a safe and clean working environment while adhering to company policies, quality policies, and industry standards</li> <li>Familiar with Lean or Six Sigma tools like Five Whys methodology</li> <li>Current or past certification for IPC-A-600, IPC-6012 or equivalent</li> <li>Current or past certification for IPC-J-STD-001 and/or IPC-A-610</li> </ul> <p><strong>ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Must be willing to work overtime and/or weekends as needed</li> <li>Must be willing to train on 1st shift from 6 AM – 4:30 PM for initial 30 days</li> <li>Must be willing to work one or more of the following schedules: <ul> <li>A-Shift: 5 AM - 5 PM (Sunday - Tuesday and every other Wednesday)</li> <li>B-Shift: 5 AM - 5 PM (Thursday - Saturday and every other Wednesday)</li> <li>C-Shift: 5 PM - 5 AM (Sunday - Tuesday and every other Wednesday)</li> <li>D-Shift: 5 PM - 5 AM (Thursday - Saturday and every other Wednesday)</li> </ul> </li> <li>Must be able to lift up to 25 lbs. unassisted</li> <li>Must be able to walk and stand for long periods of time</li> <li>Must be comfortable working in a production environment with extensive use of hazardous chemicals such as acids, alkalis, and solvents</li> <li>Must be able to wear appropriate PPE for lab and electro-chemical manufacturing environment</li> <li>Must be comfortable with climbing up and down ladders, grasping, standing, lifting, bending, pulling, pushing, stooping, stretching, carrying, crawling, and maneuvering in tight spaces</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong>ITAR REQUIREMENTS:</strong></p> <ul> <li>To conform to U.S. Government export regulations, eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State. Learn more about the ITAR <a href="https://www.pmddtc.state.gov/?id=ddtc_kb_article_page&amp;sys_id=24d528fddbfc930044f9ff621f961987">here</a>. &nbsp;</li> </ul> <p>SpaceX is an Equal Opportunity Employer; employment with SpaceX is governed on the basis of merit, competence and qualifications and will not be influenced in any manner by race, color, religion, gender, national origin/ethnicity, veteran status, disability status, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, mental or physical disability or any other legally protected status.</p> <p>Applicants wishing to view a copy of SpaceX’s Affirmative Action Plan for veterans and individuals with disabilities, or applicants requiring reasonable accommodation to the application/interview process should reach out to&nbsp;<a href="mailto:EEOCompliance@spacex.com">EEOCompliance@spacex.com</a><em>.&nbsp;</em></p></div>

title: Machine Maintenance Technician, Solar Cells (Starlink) - Day Shift
jd_text: <div class="content-intro"><p>SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of&nbsp;enabling human life on Mars.</p></div><p><strong>MACHINE MAINTENANCE TECHNICIAN, SOLAR CELLS (STARLINK) - DAY SHIFT</strong></p> <p>At SpaceX, we are building the next generation of space infrastructure to enable large-scale AI data centers in orbit. These orbital AI platforms require massive amounts of reliable, high-efficiency solar power to support intensive computing workloads in space. To make this possible, we are standing up one of the largest solar cell manufacturing facilities in the world. We are seeking a Machine Maintenance Technician to perform scheduled maintenance, repairs, and basic troubleshooting on production equipment to minimize downtime in solar cell manufacturing.</p> <p><strong>RESPONSIBILITIES:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Perform scheduled preventive maintenance, repairs, and basic troubleshooting on solar cell production equipment including laser cutters, texturing lines, PECVD tools, PVD systems, screen printers, and IV testers to minimize downtime</li> <li>Execute disassembly, inspection, cleaning, reassembly, and testing of production machinery supporting texturing, deposition, metallization, and testing processes</li> <li>Collaborate with engineers and production teams to maintain equipment in peak operating condition and develop detailed work instructions</li> <li>Identify leading indicators of equipment instability and perform corrective actions to support high-volume 24/7 manufacturing</li> <li>Read and interpret schematics, P&amp;IDs, and OEM manuals for assembly, repair, and reassembly</li> <li>Ensure all maintenance activities comply with safety protocols for hazardous gases, chemicals, and cleanroom environments</li> <li>Track and resolve electronic work tickets, maintain accurate maintenance records, and support continuous improvement for uptime and yield</li> <li>Operate forklifts, scissor lifts, and other equipment as needed while upholding 5S standards in ISO 7 and ISO 9 production areas</li> </ul> <p><strong>BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:</strong></p> <ul> <li>High school diploma or equivalency certificate</li> <li>2+ years of professional experience performing maintenance on industrial manufacturing equipment</li> </ul> <p><strong>PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Experience maintaining vacuum deposition, wet chemistry, or precision printing equipment in semiconductor or solar manufacturing</li> <li>Knowledge of mechanical systems, rotating machinery, pneumatics, and basic electrical troubleshooting</li> <li>Technical certification or journeyman-level experience in maintenance or industrial technology</li> <li>Strong troubleshooting skills and the ability to read schematics, blueprints, and technical documentation</li> <li>Familiarity with cleanroom protocols and gowning procedures</li> <li>Excellent communication skills and ability to work collaboratively in a fast-paced environment</li> <li>Experience with lock-out/tag-out, job hazard analysis, and chemical safety protocols</li> <li>Proficiency with Microsoft Office tools and executing digital work instructions</li> <li>Demonstrated punctuality, ability to work in a high-stress environment, and flexibility to adjust priorities</li> </ul> <p><strong>ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Ability to travel internationally (10%)</li> <li>Ability to stand up to 6 hours, lift up to 25 pounds unassisted, and maneuver around equipment in a factory setting</li> <li>Ability to work in industrial environments with fumes/odors, noise, hazardous chemicals, and confined spaces</li> <li>Must be available for one of the following AWS shifts (start and end times are approximate): <ul> <li>A Shift – 5:00am-5:00pm, Sunday-Wednesday</li> <li>B Shift – 5:00am-5:00pm, Wednesday-Saturday</li> </ul> </li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong>ITAR REQUIREMENTS:</strong></p> <ul> <li>To title: Machinist
jd_text: <div class="content-intro"><p>SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of&nbsp;enabling human life on Mars.</p></div><p><strong>MACHINIST</strong></p> <p>We are seeking skilled professionals to produce precision parts and components for tooling assemblies and ground support equipment, ensuring every piece meets exact design specifications through the setup and operation of machines. You will also maintain the critical equipment and supplies that support every phase of launching the world's most advanced rockets. If you thrive on hands-on work in a fast-paced environment, this role is for you.</p> <p><strong>RESPONSIBILITIES:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Study sample parts, blueprints, drawings, and engineering information in order to determine methods and sequences of operations needed to fabricate products, and determine product dimensions and tolerances, machine parts to specifications using machine tools such as lathes and milling machines</li> <li>Support metalworking projects from planning and fabrication through assembly, inspection, and testing, using knowledge of machine functions, metal properties, and mathematics</li> <li>Machine precision fixtures, tools, and products from drawings, in accordance with established procedures, with limited supervision</li> <li>Set up machines to precise tolerances and operate various types of machinery following established procedures</li> <li>Measure and inspect parts to detect defects and ensure conformance to specifications, using precision instruments such as micrometers, surface plates, and other inspection equipment</li> <li>Set up and operate metalworking and cutting equipment, such as manual mills, lathes, saws, etc.</li> <li>Clean and maintain machines, tools, and equipment</li> <li>Demonstrate continuous effort to improve operations, decrease turnaround times, streamline work processes, and work cooperatively and jointly</li> <li>Perform other related duties, as assigned, for the purpose of ensuring an efficient and effective work environment</li> </ul> <p><strong>BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:</strong></p> <ul> <li>High school diploma or equivalency certificate</li> <li>2+ years of experience setting up and operating manual mills and lathes</li> </ul> <p><strong>PREFERRED SKILLS &amp; EXPERIENCE:</strong></p> <ul> <li>1+ years of experience operating a computer numerical control (CNC) machine</li> <li>Experience with the operation of drill presses, grinders, and other related equipment</li> <li>Ability to work independently and in a team setting</li> <li>Aptitude in spatial reasoning, attention to detail, and skilled craftsmanship</li> <li>Experience with open setup inspection, including the use of manual inspection tools as well as coordinate measuring machines (CMMs) or other automated inspection equipment</li> <li>Experience and understanding of the processes needed for a production environment, such as Lean manufacturing, Six Sigma, etc.</li> <li>Proficiency in single-point threading techniques on manual lathes to create precise threads on a range of materials, following engineering drawings and specifications</li> <li>Ability to accurately center and indicate workpieces on a manual lathe with a four-jaw chuck</li> <li>Experience with nickel-based alloys</li> </ul> <p><strong>ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Anticipated hours for this position are 6:00 a.m. – 4:30 p.m.</li> <li>Must be available for overtime and weekends as the schedule varies depending on site operational needs; jd_text: <div class="content-intro"><p>SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of&nbsp;enabling human life on Mars.</p></div><p><strong>MACHINIST – LEVEL 4</strong></p> <p>We are seeking skilled professionals to produce precision parts and components for tooling assemblies and ground support equipment, ensuring every piece meets exact design specifications through the setup and operation of machines. You will also maintain the critical equipment and supplies that support every phase of launching the world's most advanced rockets. If you thrive on hands-on work in a fast-paced environment, this role is for you.</p> <p><strong>RESPONSIBILITIES:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Study sample parts, blueprints, drawings, and engineering information in order to determine methods and sequences of operations needed to fabricate products, and determine product dimensions and tolerances, machine parts to specifications using machine tools such as lathes and milling machines</li> <li>Support metalworking projects from planning and fabrication through assembly, inspection, and testing, using knowledge of machine functions, metal properties, and mathematics</li> <li>Machine precision fixtures, tools, and products from drawings, in accordance with established procedures, with limited supervision</li> <li>Set up machines to precise tolerances and operate various types of machinery following established procedures</li> <li>Measure and inspect parts to detect defects and ensure conformance to specifications, using precision instruments such as micrometers, surface plates, and other inspection equipment</li> <li>Set up and operate metalworking and cutting equipment, such as manual mills, lathes, saws, etc.</li> <li>Clean and maintain machines, tools, and equipment</li> <li>Demonstrate continuous effort to improve operations, decrease turnaround times, streamline work processes, and work cooperatively and jointly</li> <li>Perform other related duties, as assigned, for the purpose of ensuring an efficient and effective work environment</li> </ul> <p><strong>BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:</strong></p> <ul> <li>High school diploma or equivalency certificate</li> <li>5+ years of experience setting up and operating manual mills and lathes</li> </ul> <p><strong>PREFERRED SKILLS &amp; EXPERIENCE:</strong></p> <ul> <li>1+ years of experience operating a computer numerical control (CNC) machine</li> <li>Experience with the operation of drill presses, grinders, and other related equipment</li> <li>Ability to work independently and in a team setting</li> <li>Aptitude in spatial reasoning, attention to detail, and skilled craftsmanship</li> <li>Experience with open setup inspection, including the use of manual inspection tools as well as coordinate measuring machines (CMMs) or other automated inspection equipment</li> <li>Experience and understanding of the processes needed for a production environment, such as Lean manufacturing, Six Sigma, etc.</li> <li>Proficiency in single-point threading techniques on manual lathes to create precise threads on a range of materials, following engineering drawings and specifications</li> <li>Ability to accurately center and indicate workpieces on a manual lathe with a four-jaw chuck</li> <li>Experience with nickel-based alloys</li> </ul> <p><strong>ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Anticipated hours for this position are 6:00 a.m. – 4:30 p.m.</li> <li>Must be available for overtime and weekends as the schedule varies depending on site operational needs; jd_text: <div class="content-intro"><p>SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of&nbsp;enabling human life on Mars.</p></div><p><strong>MAINTENANCE ENGINEER, PCB (STARLINK)</strong></p> <p>At SpaceX we’re leveraging our experience in building rockets and spacecraft to deploy Starlink, the world’s most advanced broadband internet system. Starlink is the world’s largest satellite constellation and is providing fast, reliable internet to 10M+ users worldwide. We design, build, test, and operate all parts of the system – thousands of satellites, consumer receivers that allow users to connect within minutes of unboxing, and the software that brings it all together. We’ve only begun to scratch the surface of Starlink’s potential global impact and are looking for best-in-class engineers to help maximize Starlink’s utility for communities and businesses around the world.</p> <p>The primary role of the Maintenance Engineer is to identify and manage asset reliability risks that could adversely affect factory or business operations. As production develops and increases rate, the Maintenance Engineer's primary goal is to achieve maximum asset and system up-time by implementing and executing plans to minimize production losses, unpredictable asset behavior, and unusually high costs for system maintainability. In addition, the Maintenance Engineer acts as the accountable engineering resource in driving the design, build, and installation stages of new and modified assets as well as provides technical support to maintenance management, technicians, and production personnel to prevent and mitigate operational issues of critical equipment.</p> <p><strong>RESPONSIBILITIES:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Work with project engineering to ensure the reliability and sustainability of new and modified installations</li> <li>Guide efforts to ensure consistency and maintainability of critical equipment, operational restrictions, and other parameters that define the operating condition, reliability, and costs of assets</li> <li>Provide technical support to production, maintenance management, and technical personnel</li> <li>Manage production requests for asset improvement, control functions, and data collection</li> <li>Apply value analysis to repair/replace, repair/redesign, and make/buy decisions</li> </ul> <p><strong>BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Bachelor's degree in mechanical, electrical, aerospace, systems, or manufacturing engineering</li> <li>1+ years of title: Maintenance Technician
jd_text: <div class="content-intro"><p>SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of&nbsp;enabling human life on Mars.</p></div><p><strong>MAINTENANCE TECHNICIAN</strong></p> <p>We are looking for a maintenance technician to install and maintain the Starship test stand's electrical, mechanical, and fluid systems in preparation for test operations. These systems include hydraulics, high-pressure nitrogen/helium, and cryogenic systems.</p> <p>In addition to the required experience below, our ideal candidate is someone who shows personal initiative, maintains their composure, and fosters a positive environment. In this role, it is important to be responsible, hardworking, and conscientious about the quality of work performed. The instrumentation fitter will need to take the lead in making suggestions and not get discouraged along the way. Additionally, they will need to be able to produce high-quality work promptly while continually looking forward to needed process improvements, streamlining of work, and cost savings.</p> <p><strong>RESPONSIBILITIES:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Fabricate and install fluid system components from a schematic or engineering drawing, including, but not limited to, ball valves, check valves, pressure regulators, and pressure gauges</li> <li>Troubleshoot operational issues found during the activation of controls, fluids, and mechanical systems</li> <li>Work with a team of technicians and engineers to ensure every system is operating with the highest level of quality to support the&nbsp;100% successful launch of a multimillion-dollar launch vehicle</li> <li>Operate heavy machinery, including forklifts and aerial platforms</li> <li>Perform hands-on operations with both large and small fragile assemblies</li> <li>Perform maintenance tasks as required in a variety of roles for vehicle integration, pad maintenance, site preventative maintenance, general facilities, and any other general maintenance work to maintain an operational launch site (including corrosion control)</li> <li>Create, maintain, and edit written work orders and instructions</li> <li>Perform lockout/tagout (LOTO) procedures and fluid system configuration procedures, ensuring all physical and administrative actions are completed safely and accurately</li> <li>Monitor and interpret critical instrumentation data to assess the health and performance of fluid systems</li> </ul> <p><strong>BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:</strong></p> <ul> <li>High school diploma or equivalency certificate</li> <li>2+ years of experience performing maintenance or installation work on mechanical and low-voltage control systems</li> </ul> <p><strong>PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:</strong></p> <ul> <li>NCCER Instrumentation certification</li> <li>Experience working on a rocket launch pad and directly supporting launch operations</li> <li>Experience in military aviation as a propulsion or airframe technician</li> <li>Experience using heavy equipment (overhead cranes, forklifts, and man lifts)</li> <li>Experience following detailed schematics and fabricating fluid panels from said schematics</li> <li>Knowledge of hydraulic/cryogenic systems and operations</li> <li>Experience These systems include hydraulics, high-pressure nitrogen/helium, and cryogenic systems.</p> <p>In addition to the required experience below, our ideal candidate shows personal initiative, maintains composure, and fosters a positive environment. In this role, it is important to be responsible, hardworking, and conscientious about the quality of work performed. The maintenance technician will need to take the lead in making suggestions and not get discouraged along the way. Additionally, they must produce high-quality work promptly while continually looking for process improvements, streamlining, and cost savings.</p> <p><strong>RESPONSIBILITIES:</strong></p> <ul> title: Manager, Automation & Controls Engineering (Power Generation & Utilities)
jd_text: <div class="content-intro"><p>SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of&nbsp;enabling human life on Mars.</p></div><p><strong>MANAGER, AUTOMATION &amp; CONTROLS ENGINEERING (POWER GENERATION &amp; UTILITIES)</strong></p> <p>We are looking for a Manager of Automation and Controls Engineering to own the design, build-out, commissioning, and continuous improvement of automation, controls, and electrical systems across SpaceX’s critical power generation and utility infrastructure at Starbase. This role is involved in every major facility that supports Starship production, launch, propellant generation, terrestrial data centers, and site operations — with a primary focus on industrial power generation assets, utility-scale and low-voltage electrical power systems, and the associated balance-of-plant.</p> <p>If it has a gas or steam turbine control system, a switchgear lineup, a plant electrical distribution network, a SCADA/DCS point, a control loop, or a supporting utility/process system (water, wastewater, fuel gas, HVAC, cooling) that must run reliably at scale, this team designs it, specifies it, commissions it, and keeps it running. As a Manager, you will lead a team of Automation and Controls Engineers in a high-reliability, fast-paced environment. This is a hands-on technical leadership role — you will review P&amp;IDs, challenge control philosophies, dive into DCS/PLC architecture, electrical protection schemes, and commissioning details, not just manage a roadmap. You will scale both the team and the systems as Starship production and launch cadence increase.</p> <p><strong>RESPONSIBILITIES:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Own the automation and controls engineering scope for all power generation projects and assets (gas turbine simple cycle, combined cycle, and steam turbine systems), including DCS/SCADA architecture, PLC systems, turbine control interfaces, instrumentation, and control networks — from control philosophy through commissioning and ongoing reliability.</li> <li>Own controls and electrical integration for utility-scale and low-voltage electrical power systems, including switchgear, protection and metering, plant electrical distribution, and power system controls in compliance with NFPA 70/70B/70E, NESC, and IEEE standards.</li> <li>Lead mechanical and electrical balance-of-plant (BOP) controls scope across power generation assets — fuel gas systems, HVAC, fire protection, compressed air, cooling water, and auxiliary systems.</li> <li>Direct automation and controls scope for supporting utility and process systems, including raw water intake, demineralization, wastewater treatment, cooling water, and industrial gas systems.</li> <li>Build, mentor, and manage a team of automation and controls engineers and technicians; scale the team in line with power generation capacity growth and Starship production/launch rate targets.</li> <li>Review and approve control philosophy documents, I/O lists, control narratives, single-line diagrams, electrical/pneumatic schematics, cause-and-effect diagrams, and control panel designs produced by the team and by EPC contractors/vendors.</li> <li>Interface directly with internal engineering disciplines, construction teams, OEMs (turbine, HRSG, BOP, and electrical equipment vendors), and contractors to ensure controls and electrical scope is fully integrated and commissioned on schedule.</li> <li>Drive standardization of control system architecture (DCS/PLC/SCADA), cybersecurity posture, documentation, and engineering practices across power generation and utility facilities to enable design reuse and faster deployment.</li> <li>Own field commissioning support for automation, controls, and electrical systems, including loop checks, functional testing, protection testing, start-up, and hand-off; support root-cause investigations and reliability improvements across operating assets.</li> <li>Develop SOWs, negotiate, and manage contractor work as needed to support power generation and utility build-out.</li> </ul> <p><strong>BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Controls Engineering, Automation Engineering, or related engineering field.</li> <li>8+ years of experience in automation and controls engineering, with direct experience on industrial power generation projects (gas turbine, combined cycle, or steam systems preferred) or large-scale critical power infrastructure.</li> <li>3+ years of experience directly managing or leading a team of engineers (and preferably technicians).</li> </ul> <p><strong>PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCES:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Demonstrated hands-on experience with DCS and/or PLC/SCADA platforms used in power generation or heavy industrial applications.</li> <li>Experience working across the full project lifecycle: design, procurement, construction support, commissioning, and operations.</li> <li>Working knowledge of electrical power systems (utility-scale and low-voltage), switchgear, protection, metering, and their interface with automation and controls.</li> <li>Experience designing or reviewing industrial electrical control panels and electrical schematics.&nbsp;</li> <li>Direct experience with gas turbine or combined-cycle power plant controls (turbine control systems, HRSG controls, plant-wide DCS integration, and BOP controls).</li> <li>Experience with utility-scale electrical power systems controls, protection schemes, and SCADA integration.</li> <li>Experience with water treatment plant automation, wastewater systems, industrial gas/fuel gas systems, or process cooling systems supporting power generation.</li> <li>Experience designing and commissioning PLC, HMI, and SCADA applications in high-reliability industrial or power environments.</li> <li>Familiarity with major industrial platforms (e.g., Emerson, ABB, Siemens, Allen-Bradley, SEL) and Ignition SCADA.</li> <li>Experience with IEC 61131 programming, industrial networking (IT/OT), and major industrial protocols such as Modbus, DNP3, etc.</li> <li>Experience managing EPC contractor and OEM interfaces on multi-discipline power or capital projects.</li> <li>PE license in Electrical or Controls Engineering (or willingness to pursue).</li> <li>Experience scaling a controls engineering function within a fast-growing organization.</li> <li>Strong background in control panel design (NFPA 79 / UL 508A) and electrical schematic tools (EPLAN, AutoCAD Electrical, etc.).</li> <li>Familiarity with industrial control system cybersecurity frameworks (e.g., NERC CIP or equivalent).</li> <li>Excellent communication skills with the ability to remain deeply technical while mentoring engineers.</li> </ul> <p><strong>ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Willingness to perform hands-on work in all environments (heat, cold, rain), in tight quarters or at heights.</li> <li>Ability to work extended hours and weekends as needed to support power generation, production, and launch operations.</li> <li>Ability to remain focused in hazardous environments while wearing appropriate PPE.</li> <li>Ability to lift up to 25 lbs unassisted.</li> <li>Provide 24/7 on-call support for emergencies as needed.</li> <li>Must be able to work on-site at Starbase, TX, with potential travel to other SpaceX facilities.</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong>ITAR REQUIREMENTS:</strong></p> <ul> <li>To conform to U.S. Government export regulations, applicant must be a (i) U.S. citizen or national, (ii) U.S. lawful, permanent resident (aka green card holder), (iii) Refugee under 8 U.S.C. § 1157, or (iv) Asylee under 8 U.S.C. § 1158, or be eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State. Learn more about the ITAR <a href="https://www.pmddtc.state.gov/?id=ddtc_kb_article_page&amp;sys_id=24d528fddbfc930044f9ff621f961987">here</a>. &nbsp;</li> </ul> <p>SpaceX is an Equal Opportunity Employer; employment with SpaceX is governed on the basis of merit, competence and qualifications and will not be influenced in any manner by race, color, religion, gender, national origin/ethnicity, veteran status, disability status, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, mental or physical disability or any other legally protected status.</p> <p>Applicants wishing to view a copy of SpaceX’s Affirmative Action Plan for veterans and individuals with disabilities, or applicants requiring reasonable accommodation to the application/interview process should reach out to&nbsp;<a href="mailto:EEOCompliance@spacex.com">EEOCompliance@spacex.com</a><em>.&nbsp;</em></p></div>

title: Manager, Facilities Operations (Starlink)
jd_text: <div class="content-intro"><p>SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of&nbsp;enabling human life on Mars.</p></div><h4><strong>MANAGER, FACILITIES OPERATIONS (STARLINK)&nbsp;</strong></h4> <p>SpaceX is committed to developing revolutionary space technology, with the ultimate goal of enabling people to live on other planets. We are looking for a talented Facilities Operations Manager to oversee the operation and maintenance of critical facility systems for the Starlink Bastrop production building. This position is directly responsible for ensuring our plant utilities and infrastructure operate at peak performance – minimizing downtime, optimizing efficiency, and supporting high-volume manufacturing operations.</p> <h4 id="Manager,FacilitiesOperations(Starlink)-RESPONSIBILITIES">RESPONSIBILITIES</h4> <ul> <li>Lead a team of technicians and specialists in the execution of preventative and corrective maintenance, spare part control, and general troubleshooting of plant utilities including electrical systems, emergency backup power, HVAC (ARU, AHU, FCU, DOAS, fans), chilled water, heating hot water, process water, compressed air, scrubbers, city water, natural gas, and process waste streams</li> <li>Drive organizational excellence through the creation of standardized KPI metrics and ensure accountability at all levels</li> <li>Oversee the development and implementation of advanced maintenance methodologies to improve equipment uptime, efficiency, and cost control</li> <li>Manage work ticketing system to ensure correct staff and timely responses to break/fix requests</li> <li>Manage third-party service providers to ensure services meet SpaceX standards and terms of contract</li> <li>Partner with construction team to develop, plan and execute site improvement projects</li> <li>Own cranes and related material handling systems (initial ownership; potential future transition)</li> <li>Support 24/7 facility operations including off-hours and emergency response protocols</li> </ul> <h4 id="Manager,FacilitiesOperations(Starlink)-BASICQUALIFICATIONS">BASIC QUALIFICATIONS</h4> <ul> <li>5+ years of professional experience with facilities operations or critical systems management in a manufacturing or industrial environment</li> <li>Knowledge and understanding of infrastructure systems – HVAC, hydronics, compressed air, electrical distribution, generators, fire suppression, and other critical facility systems</li> </ul> <h4 id="Manager,FacilitiesOperations(Starlink)-PREFERREDSKILLSANDEXPERIENCE">PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE</h4> <ul> <li>Bachelor’s degree in an engineering discipline</li> <li>Proficiency in Microsoft applications such as Excel, Outlook, Word and PowerPoint</li> <li>Excellent communication skills (oral and written)</li> <li>Strong work ethic and drive for constant improvement</li> <li>Ability to independently and effectively manage projects in an extremely fast paced and changing environment</li> <li>Experience with CMMS and predictive maintenance strategies</li> <li>Track record of implementing cost-saving or utility efficiency improvements</li> </ul> <h4 id="Manager,FacilitiesOperations(Starlink)-ADDITIONALREQUIREMENTS">ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS</h4> <ul> <li>Must be able to work extended hours and/or weekends as needed</li> <li>Provide 24/7 on-call support of all critical activities and emergency situations</li> <li>Valid driver’s license</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong>ITAR REQUIREMENTS:</strong></p> <ul> <li>To conform to U.S. Government export regulations, applicant must be a (i) U.S. citizen or national, (ii) U.S. lawful, permanent resident (aka green card holder), (iii) Refugee under 8 U.S.C. § 1157, or (iv) Asylee under 8 U.S.C. § 1158, or be eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State. Learn more about the ITAR <a href="https://www.pmddtc.state.gov/?id=ddtc_kb_article_page&amp;sys_id=24d528fddbfc930044f9ff621f961987">here</a>. &nbsp;</li> </ul> <p>SpaceX is an Equal Opportunity Employer; employment with SpaceX is governed on the basis of merit, competence and qualifications and will not be influenced in any manner by race, color, religion, gender, national origin/ethnicity, veteran status, disability status, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, mental or physical disability or any other legally protected status.</p> <p>Applicants wishing to view a copy of SpaceX’s Affirmative Action Plan for veterans and individuals with disabilities, or applicants requiring reasonable accommodation to the application/interview process should reach out to&nbsp;<a href="mailto:EEOCompliance@spacex.com">EEOCompliance@spacex.com</a><em>.&nbsp;</em></p></div>

title: Manager, Gateway Electronics Engineering (Starlink)
jd_text: <div class="content-intro"><p>SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of&nbsp;enabling human life on Mars.</p></div><p><strong>MANAGER, GATEWAY ELECTRONICS ENGINEERING (STARLNK)</strong></p> <p>Starlink believes in providing fast, reliable internet to serve populations with little or no connectivity. We design, build, launch, and operate the world's largest constellation of satellites, enabling us to operate a global internet network unbounded by traditional ground infrastructure limitations. Starlink also designs, builds, and delivers high-volume consumer hardware that allows users to connect to these satellites within minutes of unboxing, as well as our advanced gateways that we deploy regionally throughout the world. The root of SpaceX’s success so far lies in our mission to keep all engineering and production in-house, which enables a tight feedback loop, nimble decision-making, and speedy deliverables. With millions of daily users worldwide already online, Starlink is truly a game changer and levels the playing field for those who were previously unconnected.</p> <p>As the Electronics Manager on the Starlink team, you will be responsible for the design, performance, and reliability of next-generation gateways - ultimately ensuring that our ground station antenna hardware can withstand the harshest environmental conditions while maintaining reliable communication with millions of users on a global scale. You will interact regularly with senior leadership to influence the fundamental operation of our constellation and network while collaborating with electrical, silicon, software, mechanical, and manufacturing teams to steer this project from initial concept development to full-scale production.</p> <p><strong>RESPONSIBILITIES:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Manage a team of 5-10 engineers to rapidly design, develop, and validate highly reliable electronics for our gateway systems</li> <li>Drive electrical architecture, specification, component selection, circuit board design, implementation, verification, board bring-up, and debugging</li> <li>Define and manage all key project milestones and deliverables</li> <li>Maintain alignment with key partners such as antenna, software, mechanical, networking, thermal, manufacturing, and production test teams to drive overall business success</li> <li>Compile and maintain lessons learned to influence future designs. Understand and implement long-term technical and business solutions that meet/exceed goals to deliver for our customers and Starlink’s vision</li> <li>Drive product architecture with a focus on innovative solutions to achieve low cost, greater performance, best user experience, and extended reliability. Implement automated design validation tests and production tests as necessary</li> <li>Recruit, develop, and promote a team of exceptional engineers and/or specialists responsible for designing, analyzing, building, and testing existing and new Starlink gateways. Set standards, and hold the team accountable to deliver with high technical rigor and discipline</li> <li>Own and build out associated engineering lab or development workspaces; hire necessary team members to deliver assets required, and efficiently manage associated capital spend</li> <li>Consistently contribute effort, leadership, and creative thinking to solving complex problems in a collaborative fashion and under tight deadlines. Above all, remain dependable, which means being unfazed by ambiguity or major changes in strategic direction</li> <li>Ensure a strong focus is placed on safety and maintain an excellent safety record</li> </ul> <p><strong>BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Bachelor’s degree in electrical engineering, computer engineering, physics, or other engineering/STEM discipline</li> <li>7+ years of professional experience with hardware design/development or electronics test engineering</li> <li>3+ years of management experience</li> </ul> <p><strong>PREFERRED SKILLS &amp; EXPERIENCE:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Previous experience managing large and multidisciplinary technical projects, ideally driving hardware design from concept through production; strong emphasis on full life-cycle development of new hardware products and not small incremental updates to legacy hardware</li> <li>Significant experience rapidly designing and delivering highly-reliable products, especially for harsh or high stakes environments in the field</li> <li>Significant experience designing and implementing mixed-signal circuit boards from concept through production using processors, FPGAs, Ethernet, multi-GHz Serdes, DRAM interfaces (DDR4), I2C, SPI, operational amplifiers, analog to digital and digital to analog converters, and power supply components</li> <li>Significant experience testing, troubleshooting, and debugging electronics&nbsp;</li> <li>Strong problem-solving skills when designing and qualifying hardware for EMC/EMI compliance and thermal management</li> <li>Strong understanding of computers and programming languages (Python, C/C++)</li> <li>Strong understanding of computer networking and interfaces (10/100/400/800G networking/Tbps switches)</li> <li>Strong understanding of optical networking architectures and fundamentals</li> <li>Experience in desktop/server Linux and embedded operating systems</li> <li>Experience leading a diverse team of engineers, while providing technical direction and strong mentorship</li> <li>Ability to communicate complex concepts, problems, and solutions clearly and effectively to all levels within the organization</li> <li>Ability to manage multiple concurrent programs and be able to discuss configuration, execution, and results in a technical manner</li> </ul> <p><strong>ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS:&nbsp;</strong></p> <ul> <li>Must travel to other SpaceX sites (Hawthorne, CA and Redmond, WA) as needed to interface with team members and drive technical projects</li> <li>Ability to work long hours and weekends as necessary</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong>ITAR REQUIREMENTS:</strong></p> <ul> <li>To conform to U.S. Government export regulations, applicant must be a (i) U.S. citizen or national, (ii) U.S. lawful, permanent resident (aka green card holder), (iii) Refugee under 8 U.S.C. § 1157, or (iv) Asylee under 8 U.S.C. § 1158, or be eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State. Learn more about the ITAR <a href="https://www.pmddtc.state.gov/?id=ddtc_kb_article_page&amp;sys_id=24d528fddbfc930044f9ff621f961987">here</a>. &nbsp;</li> </ul> <p>SpaceX is an Equal Opportunity Employer; employment with SpaceX is governed on the basis of merit, competence and qualifications and will not be influenced in any manner by race, color, religion, gender, national origin/ethnicity, veteran status, disability status, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, mental or physical disability or any other legally protected status.</p> <p>Applicants wishing to view a copy of SpaceX’s Affirmative Action Plan for veterans and individuals with disabilities, or applicants requiring reasonable accommodation to the application/interview process should reach out to&nbsp;<a href="mailto:EEOCompliance@spacex.com">EEOCompliance@spacex.com</a><em>.&nbsp;</em></p></div>

title: Manager, Machine Maintenance - Solar Cell Factory (Starlink)
jd_text: <div class="content-intro"><p>SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of&nbsp;enabling human life on Mars.</p></div><p><strong>MANAGER, MACHINE MAINTENANCE – SOLAR CELL FACTORY (STARLINK)</strong></p> <p>At SpaceX we are building the next generation of space infrastructure to enable large-scale AI data centers in orbit. These orbital AI platforms require massive amounts of reliable, high-efficiency solar power to support intensive computing workloads in space. To make this possible, we are standing up one of the largest solar cell manufacturing facilities in the world. We are seeking an experienced Machine Maintenance Manager to lead the ramp-up and sustained reliability of advanced production equipment and automation systems. This high-impact role offers the opportunity to build and shape the maintenance organization from the ground up while directly enabling SpaceX’s ambitious vision for AI data centers in space.</p> <p><strong>RESPONSIBILITIES</strong><strong>:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Lead and develop a high-performing team of maintenance technicians and engineers responsible for 24/7 reliability of advanced solar cell production equipment</li> <li>Develop and execute comprehensive maintenance strategies, including preventative, predictive, and corrective programs to achieve &gt;95% equipment availability on critical lines</li> <li>Oversee rapid troubleshooting, root cause analysis, and permanent corrective actions for complex systems including vacuum deposition, chemical processing, and automation equipment</li> <li>Partner with Production and Facility Operations teams to integrate maintenance windows with factory schedules while minimizing impact on output targets</li> <li>Manage maintenance budgets, spare parts inventory, and strategic vendor relationships to optimize costs without compromising quality or reliability</li> <li>Drive continuous improvement initiatives focused on increasing Overall Equipment Effectiveness (OEE) and supporting rapid factory scaling</li> <li>Ensure strict adherence to safety protocols, cleanroom standards, and regulatory requirements during all maintenance activities</li> <li>Foster a culture of technical excellence, accountability, and innovation to enable SpaceX’s vision for AI data centers in space</li> </ul> <p><strong>BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Bachelor’s degree in engineering or STEM discipline; OR 5+ years of experience leading industrial maintenance teams</li> <li>3+ years of experience working in a manufacturing/operations environment</li> <li>2+ years of experience in a leadership position</li> </ul> <p><strong>PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:</strong></p> <ul> <li>8+ years of prior experience with semiconductor, solar, advanced automation, or other equipment maintenance and reliability programs</li> <li>Proven track record leading cross-functional teams in high-volume, fast-paced manufacturing environments under tight deadlines</li> <li>Hands-on experience maintaining solar cell production equipment, including thin-film deposition tools (PECVD, sputtering systems, etc.)</li> <li>Strong knowledge of electrical, mechanical, and pneumatic systems in highly automated production environments</li> <li>Proficiency in Computerized Maintenance Management Systems (CMMS) and data analytics tools for equipment reliability</li> <li>Strong familiarity with lean manufacturing principles, total productive maintenance, Six Sigma, or similar process improvement methodologies</li> <li>Demonstrated ability to scale maintenance programs in high-growth manufacturing environments, ideally in renewable energy aerospace</li> <li>Deep understanding of cleanroom protocols and safe handling of pyrophoric and toxic gas systems during maintenance</li> <li>Ability to lead and execute effectively in a fast-paced environment while maintaining high standards of quality and safety</li> </ul> <p><strong>ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Ability to travel internationally (20%)</li> <li>Ability to stand up to 6 hours, lift up to 25 pounds unassisted, and maneuver around <li>Establish and continuously improve preventive, predictive, and condition-based maintenance programs for turbines, generators, and balance-of-plant to achieve world-class uptime and minimal unplanned downtime.</li> <li>Ensure full compliance with all federal, state, and local environmental regulations, air permitting, emissions monitoring, and SpaceX internal standards.</li> <li>Manage operating budgets, fuel and generation cost forecasting, efficiency initiatives, and vendor/OEM/service contracts (including long-term service agreements).</li> <li>Foster a culture of ownership, rapid iteration, and first-principles problem solving within the power generation team while maintaining rigorous safety standards in high-hazard industrial environments.</li> </ul> <p><strong>BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Bachelor’s degree in mechanical engineering, electrical engineering, or other engineering discipline.</li> <li>8+ years of progressive experience in power generation engineering, operations, or construction within large industrial or utility facilities.</li> <li>4+ years of direct people leadership experience managing engineers, operators, and technicians in 24/7 operational environments.</li> </ul> <p><strong>PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Demonstrated hands-on experience with gas-fired turbines and associated power generation systems.</li> <li>Deep knowledge of gas turbine operations, OEM control systems, performance, emissions, and reliability best practices, including predictive maintenance, vibration analysis, and condition monitoring.</li> <li>Experience with natural gas infrastructure, fuel quality, and turbine fuel systems.</li> <li>Familiarity with high-reliability operations in mission-critical environments where downtime directly impacts production (aerospace, semiconductor, data center, or similar preferred).</li> <li>Strong project management skills with experience delivering multi-million-dollar generation capital projects on time and budget.</li> <li>Proficiency in reading/creating P&amp;IDs, single-line electrical drawings, heat balances, and equipment specifications.</li> <li>Experience navigating air permitting, CEMS, and environmental compliance for combustion sources.</li> <li>Ability to thrive in a high-intensity, iterative environment with evolving priorities and aggressive timelines.</li> </ul> <p><strong>ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Ability to work at elevated heights, outdoor environments (heat, cold, rain, snow).</li> <li>Ability to work in an environment requiring exposure to fumes, odors, and noise.</li> <li>Must be available to work extended hours and weekends when needed based on site operational needs.</li> <li>Ability to provide on-call support in emergency situations.</li> <li>Demonstrated ability to work independently.</li> <li>Occasional travel may be required based on specific project tasks.</li> <li>Valid driver’s license.</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong>ITAR REQUIREMENTS:</strong></p> <ul> <li>To conform to U.S. Government export regulations, applicant must be a (i) U.S. citizen or national, (ii) U.S. lawful, permanent resident (aka green card holder), (iii) Refugee under 8 U.S.C. § 1157, or (iv) Asylee under 8 U.S.C. § 1158, or be eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State. Learn more about the ITAR <a href="https://www.pmddtc.state.gov/?id=ddtc_kb_article_page&amp;sys_id=24d528fddbfc930044f9ff621f961987">here</a>. &nbsp;</li> </ul> <p>SpaceX is an Equal Opportunity Employer; employment with SpaceX is governed on the basis of merit, competence and qualifications and will not be influenced in any manner by race, color, religion, gender, national origin/ethnicity, veteran status, disability status, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, mental or physical disability or any other legally protected status.</p> <p>Applicants wishing to view a copy of SpaceX’s Affirmative Action Plan for veterans and individuals with disabilities, or applicants requiring reasonable accommodation to the application/interview process should reach out to&nbsp;<a href="mailto:EEOCompliance@spacex.com">EEOCompliance@spacex.com</a><em>.&nbsp;</em></p></div>

title: Manager, Starlink Customer Success (Asia-Pacific & Oceania)
jd_text: <div class="content-intro"><p>SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of&nbsp;enabling human life on Mars.</p></div><p><strong><span data-contrast="none"><span data-ccp-parastyle="heading 1">MANAGER, STARLINK CUSTOMER SUCCESS (ASIA-PACIFIC &amp; OCEANIA)</span></span></strong><span data-ccp-props="{&quot;134233117&quot;:false,&quot;134233118&quot;:false,&quot;134245418&quot;:true,&quot;134245529&quot;:true,&quot;335559738&quot;:480,&quot;335559739&quot;:120}">&nbsp;</span></p> <p><span data-contrast="none">Starlink provides high-speed, low-latency internet to customers around the world. Our enterprise resellers bring Starlink to businesses across a wide range of markets and use cases.</span><span data-ccp-props="{&quot;134233117&quot;:false,&quot;134233118&quot;:false,&quot;335559738&quot;:240,&quot;335559739&quot;:240}">&nbsp;</span></p> <p><span data-contrast="none">As the </span><strong><span data-contrast="none">Manager, Starlink Customer Success (Asia-Pacific &amp; Oceania),</span></strong><span data-contrast="none"> you will lead the team responsible for our enterprise reseller business across Asia-Pacific, including Australia, New Zealand, and the Pacific Islands. The region spans a broad set of countries, time zones, regulatory environments, and customer needs, with resellers often operating across multiple markets. You will manage Customer Success Managers, Leads, and Specialists and be accountable for the performance and growth of the existing book.</span><span data-ccp-props="{&quot;134233117&quot;:false,&quot;134233118&quot;:false,&quot;335559738&quot;:240,&quot;335559739&quot;:240}">&nbsp;</span></p> <p><span data-contrast="none">Your team is responsible for growing revenue with existing customers, expanding their use of Starlink, and maintaining strong commercial relationships. Across Asia-Pacific and Oceania, turning an opportunity into revenue can depend on product availability, capacity, local billing requirements, regulatory readiness, logistics, and activation. You will help the team navigate those constraints while keeping the focus on growth.</span><span data-ccp-props="{&quot;134233117&quot;:false,&quot;134233118&quot;:false,&quot;335559738&quot;:240,&quot;335559739&quot;:240}">&nbsp;</span></p> <p><span data-contrast="none">This is a player-coach role. You will set clear priorities, coach and develop your team, and hold a high bar for performance. You will also stay close to key customers and step into the most important growth opportunities, renewals, payment issues, and escalations. We expect you to know your book, understand where the next opportunities and risks are, and keep a geographically distributed team focused on the right work.</span><span data-ccp-props="{&quot;134233117&quot;:false,&quot;134233118&quot;:false,&quot;335559738&quot;:240,&quot;335559739&quot;:240}">&nbsp;</span></p> <p><strong><span data-contrast="none"><span title: Manager, Starlink Customer Success (Europe, Middle East & Africa)
jd_text: <div class="content-intro"><p>SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of&nbsp;enabling human life on Mars.</p></div><p><strong><span data-contrast="none"><span data-ccp-parastyle="heading 1">MANAGER, STARLINK CUSTOMER SUCCESS (EUROPE, MIDDLE EAST &amp; AFRICA)</span></span></strong><span data-ccp-props="{&quot;134233117&quot;:false,&quot;134233118&quot;:false,&quot;134245418&quot;:true,&quot;134245529&quot;:true,&quot;335559738&quot;:480,&quot;335559739&quot;:120}">&nbsp;</span></p> <p><span data-contrast="none">Starlink provides high-speed, low-latency internet to customers around the world. Our enterprise resellers bring Starlink to businesses across a wide range of markets and use cases.</span><span data-ccp-props="{&quot;134233117&quot;:false,&quot;134233118&quot;:false,&quot;335559738&quot;:240,&quot;335559739&quot;:240}">&nbsp;</span></p> <p><span data-contrast="none">As the </span><strong><span data-contrast="none">Manager, Starlink Customer Success (Europe, Middle East &amp; Africa),</span></strong><span data-contrast="none"> you will lead the team responsible for our enterprise reseller business across EMEA. This is a large and diverse region where customers may operate across multiple countries, currencies, legal entities, regulatory environments, and Starlink products. You will manage Customer Success Managers, Leads, and Specialists and be accountable for the performance and growth of the existing book.</span><span data-ccp-props="{&quot;134233117&quot;:false,&quot;134233118&quot;:false,&quot;335559738&quot;:240,&quot;335559739&quot;:240}">&nbsp;</span></p> <p><span data-contrast="none">Your team is responsible for growing revenue with existing customers, expanding their use of Starlink, and maintaining strong commercial relationships. Doing that across EMEA requires navigating significant differences between markets, including local billing and tax requirements, payment practices, import and logistics constraints, regulatory requirements, and product availability. You will be expected to understand those differences without losing sight of the commercial opportunity across the region.</span><span data-ccp-props="{&quot;134233117&quot;:false,&quot;134233118&quot;:false,&quot;335559738&quot;:240,&quot;335559739&quot;:240}">&nbsp;</span></p> <p><span data-contrast="none">This is a player-coach role. You will set clear priorities, coach and develop your team, and hold a high bar for performance. You will also stay close to key customers and step into the most important growth opportunities, renewals, payment issues, and escalations. We expect you to know your book, understand where growth is accelerating or blocked, and make sure your team follows through.</span><span
