build understanding of cryogenic thermodynamics, distillation, adsorption, and equipment performance through the ASU training and qualification gates</li> <li>Support shift pass-down and leave the board and field ready for the following shift; participate in continuous improvement in reliability, purity, and housekeeping</li> </ul> <p><strong>BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:</strong></p> <ul> <li>High school diploma or equivalency certificate</li> <li>1+ years of experience working in an industrial environment or plant operations dealing with air separation units, cryogenics, industrial gases, chemical, or oil &amp; gas</li> </ul> <p><strong>PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Experience using P&amp;IDs and/or process flow diagrams as part of work (isolation or LOTO boundary definition, valve lineups, troubleshooting, or field rounds against drawings)</li> <li>Hands-on experience in a cryogenic plant, industrial gas facility, chemical plant, utilities plant, launch pad, or propellant farm</li> <li>Exposure to compressors, pumps, heat exchangers, or other industrial rotating / process equipment</li> <li>Experience with a Distributed Control System (Honeywell, Siemens, Rockwell, or equivalent) and/or HMI operation</li> <li>Familiarity with mechanical equipment isolation or basic maintenance on industrial rotating machinery</li> <li>Experience with lockout/tagout, job hazard analysis, hot work permitting, confined space, or Process Safety Management (PSM) practices</li> <li>Familiarity with 120V and 480V industrial electrical equipment (medium-voltage experience is a plus)</li> <li>Track record of catching equipment or process issues early and raising them to the shift lead</li> <li>Experience in shift operations (nights, weekends, or 24/7) in an industrial environment</li> <li>Interest in learning process behavior from first principles (thermodynamics, fluid dynamics, heat/mass transfer)</li> </ul> <p><strong>ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Anticiapted hours for this position are 6:00 AM-7:00 PM</li> <li>Role may require extended hours, weekend work, and shift schedules that vary depending on site operational needs; title: Product Compliance Engineer (Starlink)
jd_text: <div class="content-intro"><p>SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of&nbsp;enabling human life on Mars.</p></div><p><strong>PRODUCT COMPLIANCE ENGINEER (STARLINK)</strong></p> <p>SpaceX is leveraging its experience building rockets and spacecraft to deploy Starlink, the world’s most advanced broadband internet system. Starlink is the world’s largest satellite constellation that provides fast, reliable internet to millions of users worldwide. We design, build, manufacture, and operate all parts of the system including thousands of satellites and millions of customer kits. Our customers currently include teachers in the most remote parts of the Amazon, researchers in Antarctica, digital nomads who travel via RV, emergency responders, commercial airlines, cruise lines, and residential users who live in more rural or developing areas. While users can get online within minutes almost anywhere in the world, we’ve only begun to scratch the surface of Starlink’s potential. We are looking for best-in-class engineers to help maximize Starlink’s utility for individuals, communities, and businesses.</p> <p>Product Compliance Engineers will play a critical role as SpaceX strives to deliver internet to those that need it most. They will drive regulatory efforts, impact internal design decisions, and obtain the product certifications needed to sell and ship millions of consumer-facing devices. These devices - including Starlink dishes, Wi-Fi routers, power supply, accessories, etc. – are designed and manufactured completely in-house by SpaceX. We are looking for a multi-disciplinary Product Compliance Engineer who is highly capable across EMC, Product Safety, Wireless, or Environmental compliance. This role will support broader certification needs for Starlink hardware and serve as a key technical leader for global market access programs. Engineers on the team will be hands-on, regularly interact with multiple technical disciplines, and ultimately ensure that Starlink is a global success.</p> <p><strong>RESPONSIBILITIES:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Drive end-to-end product compliance and global market access for Starlink hardware (EMC, Safety, Radio, and Environmental)</li> <li>Coordinate certification programs across multiple disciplines and geographies</li> <li>Collaborate with design teams to embed compliance requirements early in the development cycle</li> <li>Manage relationships with test labs, Notified Bodies, and certification agencies worldwide</li> <li>Own technical construction files and support global regulatory submissions</li> <li>Identify and resolve complex compliance issues across safety, EMC, RF, and materials</li> </ul> <p><strong>BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Bachelor’s degree in and engineering or STEM discipline&nbsp;</li> <li>1+ years of experience in compliance and certification engineering (internship experience is applicable)</li> </ul> <p><strong>PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:</strong></p> <ul> <li>4+ years of progressive experience in product compliance engineering</li> <li>Broad experience across EMC, Product Safety, RF/Wireless, and Environmental compliance</li> <li>Hands-on experience with FCC, CE, UL, IEC, EN, RED, RoHS, REACH and related standards</li> <li>Demonstrated success certifying consumer electronics or telecommunications equipment for global markets</li> <li>Strong project management and cross-functional leadership skills</li> <li>Ability to quickly ramp up on new regulations and standards</li> <li>Excellent communicator who can translate complex technical/regulatory topics for engineering audiences</li> </ul> jd_text: <div class="content-intro"><p>SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of&nbsp;enabling human life on Mars.</p></div><p><strong>PRODUCTION PROJECT ENGINEER (STARLINK)&nbsp;</strong></p> <p>At SpaceX, we’re leveraging our experience in building rockets and spacecraft to deploy Starlink, the world’s most advanced broadband internet system. Starlink is the world’s largest satellite constellation, providing fast, reliable internet to 4M+ users worldwide. We design, build, test, and operate all parts of the system – thousands of satellites, consumer antennae that allow users to connect within minutes of unboxing, and the software that brings it all together. We’ve only begun to scratch the surface of Starlink’s potential global impact, and we are looking to add an experienced Production Project Engineer to help build our presence in Bastrop, TX.&nbsp;</p> <p>As a member of the construction projects team, you will work with a group of elite engineers across multiple disciplines to design, build, and activate infrastructure for a variety of projects at the Starlink production facility. This is a hands-on role that is responsible for the planning and execution of new facility construction and renovation projects with emphasis on heavy civil and utility components. You will work with construction project managers, facility engineers, designers, vendors, and internal partners/customers to support these goals. You will have the opportunity to drive positive change and own projects from start to finish with the goal of making the SpaceX campus a world-class manufacturing facility. This position is based in Bastrop, TX (Austin Area).</p> <p><strong>RESPONSIBILITIES:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Lead a project team of engineers, consultants, and contractors throughout the engineering, procurement, and construction process</li> <li>Manage the design, development, and issuance of drawings, documentation, and reports for manufacturing line projects</li> <li>Write, negotiate, and manage construction contracts with subcontractors across multiple disciplines from conceptual design through close out and activation</li> <li>Accountable for accurate budgeting and cost cost</li> <li>Define new business processes and systems for high volume production, including manufacturing execution, inventory management, nonconformance resolution, configuration management, material traceability, process control, and maintenance</li> <li>Coordinate and schedule work with internal SpaceX teams and external general/sub-contractors</li> <li>Assist production/engineering leadership team to identify trends, opportunities, and best practices for optimizing product output, quality enhancements, and cost of manufacturability by spending time on the production floor</li> </ul> <p><strong>BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Bachelor's degree in industrial, mechanical, electrical, or other engineering discipline</li> <li>1+ years of experience in production construction site</li> <li>Experience in conceptual design and budgeting</li> <li>Experience with general mechanical, fluids, and heavy hydronics construction</li> <li>Experience in managing the title: Production Supervisor - Assembly & SMT (Starlink)
jd_text: <div class="content-intro"><p>SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of&nbsp;enabling human life on Mars.</p></div><p><strong>PRODUCTION SUPERVISOR - ASSEMBLY &amp; SMT (STARLINK)</strong></p> <p>SpaceX is leveraging our experience building rockets and spacecraft to deploy Starlink, the world’s largest satellite constellation and most advanced broadband internet system. We provide reliable and fast internet to millions of users worldwide, including populations with little or no connectivity, rural communities, aircraft, watercraft, and places where existing services are unreliable, too expensive, or disconnected by natural disasters. We design, build, test, and operate all parts of the system, thousands of satellites and consumer antennae that allow users to connect within minutes of unboxing. The Starlink team is seeking out the best-in-class professionals to maximize Starlink’s potential for communities and businesses around the globe.</p> <p>As a supervisor on the Starlink production team, you will spearhead the production of millions of consumer-facing electronic devices that we ship to customers’ homes around the world. You will manage large teams of technicians and assemblers while working closely with manufacturing and design engineers, ultimately driving the transition from prototyping to full-scale production.</p> <p><strong>RESPONSIBILITIES:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Coordinate and steer the collective efforts of electronics production associates</li> <li>Enforce company standards, policies, and rules</li> <li>Interface with area leadership and prioritize work based on production schedule and organizational goals</li> <li>Schedule risk identification and mitigation</li> <li>Coordinate support organization efforts to minimize production interruptions</li> <li>Ensure product quality and conformance to specifications</li> <li>Process non-conforming hardware to efficiently return them to conforming state and normal product flow</li> <li>Improve area safety and efficiency through regular auditing and continuous improvement</li> <li>Optimize product flow through the factory</li> <li>Perform root cause analysis and implement corresponding corrective action plans</li> <li>Identify and eliminate defects within the area value stream</li> <li>Reduce downtime for product and personnel</li> <li>Support efforts to transition product from engineering development to full rate production</li> <li>Review drawings and technical data packages for manufacturability while providing constructive feedback to engineering/design community</li> </ul> <p><strong>BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Bachelor’s degree or 5+ years of professional experience in a manufacturing, production, or logistics environment in lieu of degree or 2+ years of experience at SpaceX</li> <li>1+ years of experience leading a team or project</li> </ul> <p><strong>PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:</strong>&nbsp;</p> <ul> <li>7+ years of professional experience in a manufacturing, production, or logistics environment</li> <li>2+ years of experience leading a team or project</li> <li>Lean manufacturing training and experience</li> <li>Experience monitoring, tracking, and continually improving total cost equation</li> <li>Experience with applying lean manufacturing principles and efficiency methods</li> <li>Demonstrated ability to read, interpret controlled documentation and processes such as: Cable harnesses, wiring diagrams, layout drawings, mechanical drawings, GD&amp;T, assembly procedures/work instructions, schematics, engineering drawings, and parts lists</li> <li>Familiarity with Design for Manufacturability, Kaizen, Lean Manufacturing, Six Sigma, and consumer electronics production environment&nbsp;</li> <li>Six Sigma certification</li> <li>Able to adapt to constant changing work assignments and fast-paced work environment</li> <li>Proficient with computers, the ability to use MS Office, shop floor management software (ERP) and related programs</li> </ul> <p><strong>ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Must be available for one of the following shifts (start and end times are approximate): <ul> <li>A Shift – 5:00am-5:00pm, Sunday-Wednesday</li> <li>B Shift – 5:00am-5:00pm, Wednesday-Saturday</li> <li>C Shift – 5:00pm-5:00am, Sunday-Wednesday</li> <li>D Shift – 5:00pm-5:00am, Wednesday-Saturday</li> </ul> </li> <li>Ability to work extended hours and weekends as needed</li> <li>Able to travel for business trips up to 10% on title: Propulsion Build Engineer (Starship)
jd_text: <div class="content-intro"><p>SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of&nbsp;enabling human life on Mars.</p></div><p><strong>PROPULSION BUILD ENGINEER (STARSHIP)</strong></p> <p>The Propulsion Build Engineer role is responsible for developing build processes, tooling, and designs for manufacturability that will enable high rate manufacturing of vehicle fluid systems. This role will involve heavy engagement with both the design teams and the build teams across the program. The role demands close interaction with the Starship and Super Heavy hardware, including participating in and driving the physical builds and installation of the propulsion systems.</p> <p>Propulsion Build Engineers will be highly engaged in the fabrication of a wide range of pressurized components and systems, including designing tooling (assembly aide, welding, part fixturing, etc.) and processes (welding, tube bending, pipe fitting, large part movement, and large structure integration) to rapidly build the Starship and Super Heavy vehicles. The role can include designing pressurized test setups, working with cryogenic fluids, and executing testing and data review. Further along in the build, this role will be responsible for items such as integration operations sequencing, and working with technicians on installing flight-critical hardware on the vehicle. Propulsion Build Engineers will be expected to sometimes act as de-facto supervisors and advisors to production technicians, welders, and other skilled labor partners.</p> <p><strong>RESPONSIBILITIES:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Develop manufacturing processes, techniques, and tools to enable efficient and high rate manufacturing</li> <li>Work with the design engineering team to drive simplicity into the vehicle fluids systems at every level</li> <li>Guide a team of technicians, welders, and fabricators in building high quality and functional fluid systems hardware</li> <li>Coordinate and execute development, qualification, and acceptance testing of systems and tooling needed to meet hardware deadlines</li> <li>Create original CAD models and prints for flight and/or tooling components</li> <li>Create and maintain build schedules</li> <li>Participate in design reviews internally and with suppliers and customers</li> <li>Partner with engineering &amp; production teams to generate ideas, designs, and improvements for current and next-generation vehicles</li> </ul> <p><strong>BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Bachelor's or advanced degree in aerospace engineering, manufacturing engineering, materials engineering, mechanical engineering, or other engineering discipline&nbsp;</li> <li>Hands-on project experience with fluid and/or mechanical systems</li> <li>1+ years of manufacturing design experience&nbsp;(internship and academic experience is applicable)</li> </ul> <p><strong>PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:</strong></p> <ul> <li>2+ years of experience with GD&amp;T concepts</li> <li>Experience with fluid mechanics, incompressible and compressible flow, and heat transfer</li> <li>Experience with pressurized components (valves, regulators, tubes, pipes, etc.)</li> <li>Experience with mechanical design, including basic structures and fluids calculations and design considerations</li> <li>Process development, facility and line layouts, error-proofing</li> <li>Experience with Unigraphics NX and Teamcenter CAD and PLM systems</li> <li>Detailed knowledge of Siemens NX or similar CAD and PLM packages</li> <li>Prior experience with developing, maintaining, and improving welding processes</li> <li>Experience with automated and manual welding processes for piping and structural applications</li> </ul> <p><strong>ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Ability to work extended hours and weekends as necessary</li> <li>Flight hardware typically is built in tight quarters and physical dexterity is required</li> <li>Ability to perform job duties that require standing, kneeling, crouching, twisting upper body, working in cramped positions in small openings and climbing hand over hand</li> <li>Typically exposed to work in extreme outdoor environments – heat, cold, rain</li> <li>Work performed in an environment requiring exposure to fumes, odors, and noise</li> <li>Schedule varies depending on site operational needs; flexibility required</li> <li>Flexibility to travel to remote build sites, up to 10%</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong>ITAR REQUIREMENTS:</strong></p> <ul> <li>To conform to U.S. Government export regulations, applicant must be a (i) U.S. citizen or national, (ii) U.S. lawful, permanent resident (aka green card holder), (iii) Refugee under 8 U.S.C. § 1157, or (iv) Asylee under 8 U.S.C. § 1158, or be eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State. Learn more about the ITAR <a href="https://www.pmddtc.state.gov/?id=ddtc_kb_article_page&amp;sys_id=24d528fddbfc930044f9ff621f961987">here</a>. &nbsp;</li> </ul> <p>SpaceX is an Equal Opportunity Employer; employment with SpaceX is governed on the basis of merit, competence and qualifications and will not be influenced in any manner by race, color, religion, gender, national origin/ethnicity, veteran status, disability status, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, mental or physical disability or any other legally protected status.</p> <p>Applicants wishing to view a copy of SpaceX’s Affirmative Action Plan for veterans and individuals with disabilities, or applicants requiring reasonable accommodation to the application/interview process should reach out to&nbsp;<a href="mailto:EEOCompliance@spacex.com">EEOCompliance@spacex.com</a><em>.&nbsp;</em></p></div>

title: Propulsion Engineer (Raptor Test)
jd_text: <div class="content-intro"><p>SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of&nbsp;enabling human life on Mars.</p></div><p><strong>PROPULSION ENGINEER (RAPTOR TEST)</strong></p> <p>The propulsion engineer is responsible for ensuring Raptor engines and components have been tested and qualified to function in flight conditions. Our engineers specialize in the design and execution of unique development tests for Raptor engine testing on an accelerated schedule. This role offers a constant variety of diverse engineering challenges in a fast-paced, hands-on environment. Raptor Test Engineers have the opportunity to work on one of the world’s most complex engines to date, a full flow staged combustion engine! Join the team and our journey to Mars and we solve new challenges presented by unknown frontiers.</p> <p><strong>RESPONSIBILITIES:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Develop and execute tests at the engine and component level to evaluate hardware performance and survivability during the mission.</li> <li>Repeated ownership of test campaigns; including test plan creation, new system activation, test operations, data review, and test stand equipment design/fabrication.</li> <li>Provide daily direction and instruction to technicians to fabricate and integrate test articles and stand equipment.</li> <li>Develop and maintain test procedures, sequences, scripts, configuration files, and software.</li> <li>Operate and troubleshoot data acquisition and control systems, wiring, and instrumentation. DAQ systems are primarily National Instruments based.</li> <li>Operate and troubleshoot fluid and mechanical systems that include low to high-pressure gaseous working fluids and rocket propellants (including high pressure nitrogen and methane systems &amp; cryogenics) as well as structural components and supporting infrastructure.</li> <li>Operate mechanical systems; these include test stand title: Rack Design Engineer (Starmind)
jd_text: <div class="content-intro"><p>SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of&nbsp;enabling human life on Mars.</p></div><h4>RACK DESIGN ENGINEER (STARMIND)</h4> <p>The Starmind Compute team designs training and inference compute clusters from first principles, pushing thermal, electrical, and optical systems to the limit of physics. We operate as a highly cross disciplinary team comprised of mechanical, electrical, optical, and software engineers, all working to maximize the efficiency, reliability, and deployment speed of terrestrial computing to serve rapidly scaling demand.</p> <p>This team owns compute architecture, datacenter network design, rack builds, connectivity, in-house design of our own computers, and the manufacturing line that builds that compute. As a Rack Design Engineer, you will own the rack as a product: structure, power, cooling, service paths, and the physical integration of servers, switches, optics, and liquid cooling from first sketch through production rate.</p> <h4>RESPONSIBILITIES:</h4> <ul> <li>Own mechanical, structural, and integration design of high-density AI compute racks and associated chassis, frames, busbars, manifolds, electrical integration: busbar, PDU, 48V, high-current 3-phase, grounding, and service safety</li> <li>Cable and fiber physical design inside the rack (MPO/OSFP dress, bend radius, service loops) in partnership with optical and network engineers</li> <li>Experience taking a rack from NPI onto an in-house manufacturing line (fixtures, cycle time, poka-yoke, rework loops)</li> <li>Thermal and title: RF & Wireless Compliance Engineer (Starlink)
jd_text: <div class="content-intro"><p>SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of&nbsp;enabling human life on Mars.</p></div><p><strong>RF &amp; WIRELESS COMPLIANCE ENGINEER (STARLINK)</strong></p> <p>SpaceX is leveraging its experience building rockets and spacecraft to deploy Starlink, the world’s most advanced broadband internet system. Starlink is the world’s largest satellite constellation that provides fast, reliable internet to millions of users worldwide. We design, build, manufacture, and operate all parts of the system including thousands of satellites and millions of customer kits. Our customers currently include teachers in the most remote parts of the Amazon, researchers in Antarctica, digital nomads who travel via RV, emergency responders, commercial airlines, cruise lines, and residential users who live in more rural or developing areas. While users can get online within minutes almost anywhere in the world, we’ve only begun to scratch the surface of Starlink’s potential. We are looking for best-in-class engineers to help maximize Starlink’s utility for individuals, communities, and businesses.</p> <p>Product Compliance Engineers will play a critical role as SpaceX strives to deliver internet to those that need it most. They will drive regulatory efforts, impact internal design decisions, and obtain the product certifications needed to sell and ship millions of consumer-facing devices. These devices - including Starlink dishes, Wi-Fi routers, power supply, accessories, etc. – are designed and manufactured completely in-house by SpaceX. We are hiring an RF/Wireless Compliance Engineer focused on regulatory certification of Starlink’s radio products and systems. You will own FCC, ISED, ETSI, and international radio compliance from design through certification and market access. Engineers on the team will be hands-on, regularly interact with multiple technical disciplines, and ultimately ensure that Starlink is a global success.</p> <p><strong>RESPONSIBILITIES:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Lead RF regulatory strategy and certification for Starlink User Terminals and Wi-Fi products across all target markets</li> <li>Own compliance to FCC, ISED, ETSI, RED, and equivalent global wireless regulations- Manage radio testing (emissions, immunity, SAR, etc.) with accredited labs</li> <li>Work directly with RF hardware and firmware teams to implement design changes required for certification</li> <li>Prepare and maintain technical files and certification applications</li> <li>Support global market access for wireless features, including new frequency bands and power levels</li> </ul> <p><strong>BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Bachelor’s degree in electrical engineering, computer engineering, other STEM discipline&nbsp;</li> <li>1+ years of experience in RF/wireless regulatory compliance and certification (internship experience is applicable)</li> </ul> <p><strong>PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:</strong></p> <ul> <li>3+ years of dedicated experience in RF/wireless regulatory compliance and certification for high-volume&nbsp;consumer electronics, industrial equipment, or information technology equipment</li> <li>Strong experience with Wi-Fi or satellite communication systems</li> <li>Deep knowledge of FCC, ISED, ETSI, RED, and key international wireless regulations</li> <li>Experience running RF compliance test campaigns</li> <li>Ability to read and interpret radio standards and translate them into actionable design requirements</li> <li>Experience supporting antenna and RF layout for regulatory success</li> <li>Track title: RF Software Engineer (Starlink)
jd_text: <div class="content-intro"><p>SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of&nbsp;enabling human life on Mars.</p></div><p><strong>RF SOFTWARE ENGINEER (STARLINK)</strong></p> <p>Starlink believes in providing fast, reliable internet to serve populations with little or no connectivity. We design, build, launch, and operate the world's largest constellation of satellites, enabling us to operate a global internet network unbounded by traditional ground infrastructure limitations. Starlink also designs, builds, and delivers high-volume consumer hardware that allows users to connect to these satellites within minutes of unboxing, as well as our advanced gateways that we deploy regionally throughout the world. The root of SpaceX’s success so far lies in our mission to keep all engineering and production in-house, which enables a tight feedback loop, nimble decision-making, and speedy deliverables. With millions of daily users worldwide already online, Starlink is truly a game-changer and levels the playing field for those who were previously unconnected.</p> <p>As an RF software engineer in the Starlink program, you will work with a team of RF engineers, DSP engineers, software engineers, hardware engineers, and end users to design and build RF capabilities for proliferated communications and remote sensing in low earth orbit. You will work in a highly collaborative and fast-paced environment, where we are exploring unsolved problems and applying the SpaceX mindset of iterating rapidly to go from design and demo to operational capability at lightning pace.</p> <p><strong>RESPONSIBILITIES:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Drive program-level decisions on RF system designs</li> <li>Research novel solutions for unique large-scale satellite RF systems</li> <li>Design, build, validate, and automate RF test benches for full characterization of custom RF designs, often involving vector network analyzers (VNA), vector signal generators (VSG), vector signal analyzers (VSA), spectrum analyzers, load pulls, RF power meters, high-speed oscilloscopes, and other common lab equipment</li> <li>Design and build modular, scalable RF test infrastructure and test automation sequences in Python and C++ to support design validation, qualification, and production</li> <li>Work in close collaboration with hardware, FPGA, DSP, and software engineers to design and validate RF systems</li> <li>Create electromagnetic simulation models of hardware to design and evaluate performance</li> </ul> <p><strong>BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Bachelor’s degree in electrical engineering or other engineering discipline</li> <li>1+ years of professional development experience in C/C++ or Python</li> <li>1+ years of professional experience with radio test equipment such as spectrum analyzers, vector signal analyzers, vector signal generators, and network analyzers</li> <li>1+ years of professional RF experience with antennas or communication systems</li> </ul> <p><strong>PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Master's degree in electrical engineering or other engineering discipline</li> <li>Experience with testing both active and passive RF devices such as filters, amplifiers, mixers, and upconverters/downconverters</li> <li>Experience with common RF concepts such as gain, linearity, P1dB, ACLR, EVM, PAE, S-parameters, and input/output matching</li> <li>Experience with software design principles, software architecture, design patterns, and unit/integration testing title: RFIC Engineer, AI Satellites (Starmind)
jd_text: <div class="content-intro"><p>SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of&nbsp;enabling human life on Mars.</p></div><p><strong><span data-contrast="auto">RFIC ENGINEER, AI SATELLITES (STARMIND)</span></strong><span data-ccp-props="{&quot;134233118&quot;:false,&quot;201341983&quot;:0,&quot;335559739&quot;:20,&quot;335559740&quot;:240}">&nbsp;</span></p> <p><span data-contrast="auto">SpaceX is&nbsp;leveraging&nbsp;its experience deploying and&nbsp;operating&nbsp;the world’s largest satellite constellation to develop&nbsp;Starmind, a new constellation of satellites capturing solar energy in space to power low-cost, high-performance AI compute for Earth. Realizing this vision demands&nbsp;highly reliable,&nbsp;high performance&nbsp;electrical hardware ranging from power electronics, high speed digital systems, mixed signal designs, robust avionics, networking, and custom compute electronics. These systems must&nbsp;operate&nbsp;in the extreme environment of space while delivering the connectivity, control, power distribution, and processing needed for orbital AI inference.&nbsp;As we continue to upgrade and expand the constellation,&nbsp;we’re&nbsp;looking for best-in-class engineers to join the team.</span><span data-ccp-props="{&quot;134233118&quot;:false,&quot;201341983&quot;:0,&quot;335559739&quot;:20,&quot;335559740&quot;:240}">&nbsp;</span></p> <p><span data-contrast="auto">We are seeking a motivated, proactive, and intellectually curious engineer who will work alongside world-class cross-disciplinary teams (systems, firmware, architecture, design, validation, product engineering). In this role, you will be developing cutting-edge next-generation RFICs for deployment in space and ground infrastructures around the globe. title: Ropes Access Technician (Starship)
jd_text: <div class="content-intro"><p>SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of&nbsp;enabling human life on Mars.</p></div><p><strong>ROPES TECHNICIAN (STARSHIP)</strong></p> <p>The Ropes Access Technician plays a vital role in supporting SpaceX’s Starship operations team by executing safe, innovative ropes access solutions in complex, high-stakes environments. This hands-on position involves the precise setup, maintenance, and operation of access systems essential to Starship assembly, testing, and repairs, ensuring the team meets mission-critical objectives with accuracy and safety. By performing technical tasks under supervision, collaborating with engineering and operations teams, participating in qualification training programs, and adhering to stringent safety protocols, the Ropes Access Technician contributes to operational efficiency and the broader success of Starship’s mission to advance human space exploration.</p> <p><strong>RESPONSIBILITIES:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Evaluate and develop safe ropes access solutions in new and changing environments</li> <li>Manage communication, equipment integrity, and process guidelines required for safe ropes access operations</li> <li>Climb in a variety of environmental conditions to set up ropes access for teammate</li> <li>Haul team members and equipment using a variety of ropes access configurations</li> <li>Operate within and enforce SPRAT and IRATA guidelines</li> <li>Train team members proper use of Ropes Access solutions</li> <li>Develop rigging for large assemblies</li> <li>Work at heights on temporary or permanent work access solutions</li> <li>Operate personnel platforms (boom lifts, scissor lifts, etc.)</li> <li>Read and interpret engineering drawings and work instructions</li> <li>Perform work according to procedures, specifications, and test instructions</li> <li>Collaborate with engineers to develop work access solutions</li> <li>Ensure all production services are performed on time, safely and in a professional manner</li> <li>Support heavy transport or crane operations when not supporting ropes access duties</li> </ul> <p><strong>BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:</strong></p> <ul> <li>High school diploma or equivalency certificate</li> <li>1+ years of experience on a critical lift team or a logistics/transport team</li> </ul> <p><strong>PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:</strong></p> <ul> <li>IRATA or SPRAT Ropes Access Level 3 Certification</li> <li>Perform mechanical or welding work on gas, electrical and secondary structures systems when not performing ropes access duties</li> <li>Experience in the aerospace industry, aviation, military, oil &amp; gas, or other high-reliability operating environment</li> <li>Knowledge of pressure, temperature and flow measurement devices, mechanical and electrical systems</li> <li>Skill in operating and manipulating machinery and various hand and power tools requiring manual dexterity</li> <li>Ability to use precision measuring instruments</li> <li>Ability to rapidly change roles/responsibilities while working in a high-paced, challenging work environment</li> <li>Proficient with computers and the ability to use MS Office</li> <li>Ability to work effectively in a team environment</li> </ul> <p><strong>ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Ability to lift at least 25 lbs unassisted</li> <li>Willing to travel up to 25%</li> <li>Ability to climb ladders and work in confined spaces</li> <li>Willing to work all shifts, overtime, and weekends as needed</li> <li>Stand: Up to 6 hours per day</li> <li>Sit: Up to 6 hours per day</li> <li>Push/Pull: Up to 75lbs. (unassisted) 30 minutes to 1 hour per day</li> <li>Overhead reach: Up to 6 hours per day</li> <li>Walk: Up to 6 hours per day</li> <li>Lift/Carry: Up to 50lbs. (unassisted) 1-2 hours per day</li> <li>Climb (ladder/stairs): Up to 6 hours per day</li> <li>Kneel/Crouch: Up to 3 hours per day</li> <li>Upper body twist: Up to 10 hours per day</li> <li>Ability to work in temperatures over 80 degrees: 6 hours or greater per day</li> <li>Candidate must be capable of safely working at heights (up to 500ft), in confined spaces, using an air purifying respirator, and performing the physical requirements of the job listed in the job description</li> <li>Candidate may be required to complete a pre-employment questionnaire and/or physical to confirm these capabilities, which may include a medical history review</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong>ITAR REQUIREMENTS:</strong></p> <ul> <li>To conform to U.S. Government export regulations, applicant must be a (i) U.S. citizen or national, (ii) U.S. lawful, permanent resident (aka green card holder), (iii) Refugee under 8 U.S.C. § 1157, or (iv) Asylee under 8 U.S.C. § 1158, or be eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State. Learn more about the ITAR <a href="https://www.pmddtc.state.gov/?id=ddtc_kb_article_page&amp;sys_id=24d528fddbfc930044f9ff621f961987">here</a>. &nbsp;</li> </ul> <p>SpaceX is an Equal Opportunity Employer; employment with SpaceX is governed on the basis of merit, competence and qualifications and will not be influenced in any manner by race, color, religion, gender, national origin/ethnicity, veteran status, disability status, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, mental or physical disability or any other legally protected status.</p> <p>Applicants wishing to view a copy of SpaceX’s Affirmative Action Plan for veterans and individuals with disabilities, or applicants requiring reasonable accommodation to the application/interview process should reach out to&nbsp;<a href="mailto:EEOCompliance@spacex.com">EEOCompliance@spacex.com</a><em>.&nbsp;</em></p></div>

title: Sales Operations Manager (Starlink Channel Sales)
jd_text: <div class="content-intro"><p>SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of&nbsp;enabling human life on Mars.</p></div><p><strong>SALES OPERATIONS MANAGER (STARLINK CHANNEL SALES)</strong></p> <p>Starlink is the world’s largest satellite constellation delivering high-speed, low-latency broadband to customers around the globe. As the Sales Operations Manager, you will own the systems, processes, and data that make our reseller channel scalable and high performing. You will operate reseller portal onboarding, co-sell registration, Know Your Customer (KYC) requirements, and pipeline reporting from the channel—then turn that information into clean systems, dashboards, and workflows that make Channel Sales, Enterprise Sales, and every member of our channel more productive. You will work closely with Channel Sales, Sales Operations, Sales Enablement, Product, Legal, Finance, Compliance, and GTM engineering to remove friction between direct and indirect motions and unlock efficient indirect revenue.</p> <p><strong>RESPONIBILITIES:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Own reseller portal onboarding operations, tiering workflows, portal readiness, and clean reseller data across CRM and reseller systems—so new and existing channel members can work productively without friction</li> <li>Design and operate co-sell registration as part of the tiering approval process, ensuring required information is captured completely and consistently before approval</li> <li>Build and run the quarterly channel data collection process to capture KYC and pipeline reporting from resellers; define how data is submitted, validated, stored, and used in systems and reports with Legal, Finance, Compliance, Sales Operations, and GTM engineering</li> <li>Partner with Channel Sales on reseller performance by owning the data, reporting, scorecards, and operational insights that help Channel Sales manage the channel—without owning reseller performance management or running business reviews</li> <li>Define and enforce service levels for portal onboarding, co-sell registration, quarterly KYC/pipeline submissions, and handoffs across Channel Managers, Sales Operations, Legal, Finance, and Compliance</li> <li>Collaborate with the GTM Engineer and Data Engineer to improve data quality, automate capture of KYC and pipeline inputs, and embed reseller-safe tooling that increases productivity for Channel Sales, Enterprise Sales, and channel members</li> <li>Establish success metrics for channel operations (portal onboarding cycle time, co-sell registration completeness, quarterly KYC/pipeline submission rate and quality, data usability in reports) and continuously optimize based on field and Channel Sales feedback</li> <li>Act as a trusted advisor to channel and enterprise leadership on operational bottlenecks, data readiness, and investments that scale indirect revenue and improve productivity across the channel</li> </ul> <p><strong>BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Bachelor’s degree</li> <li>5+ years of experience in channel operations, reseller operations, sales operations, revenue operations, or a related go-to-market function</li> <li>1+ years of experience owning reseller or channel operational processes such as portal onboarding, registration workflows, PRM/portal operations, or channel data/reporting</li> </ul> <p><strong>PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Experience supporting Enterprise or complex B2B channel/reseller motions (ideally technology, SaaS, telecom, satellite/connectivity, or hardware)</li> <li>Experience designing or operating registration/tiering workflows and collecting KYC or equivalent compliance information from resellers</li> <li>Experience building systems or processes to collect recurring channel pipeline reporting and turn it into usable CRM data, dashboards, and operational insights for sales leadership</li> <li>Strong CRM discipline (HubSpot or Salesforce) and experience operating reseller portals or PRM platforms</li> <li>Data-driven mindset with ability to define and track channel ops KPIs (portal onboarding cycle time, registration completeness, quarterly submission rates, data quality, productivity impact)</li> <li>Excellent communication skills with the ability to document processes, train Channel Managers and resellers on portal/registration/data requirements, and drive cross-functional alignment without formal authority</li> <li>Experience working in high-growth, fast-paced environments with frequent product, pricing, and process changes</li> <li>Familiarity with co-sell motions, channel conflict resolution, and compliance workflows is a plus</li> </ul> <p><strong>ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Available to work extended hours and/or weekends as needed to support major product launches, reseller programs, certification events, or critical sales initiatives</li> <li>Willingness to travel as needed to support channel manager training, reseller enablement, and key events</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong>ITAR REQUIREMENTS:</strong></p> <ul> <li>To conform to U.S. Government export regulations, applicant must be a (i) U.S. citizen or national, (ii) U.S. lawful, permanent resident (aka green card holder), (iii) Refugee under 8 U.S.C. § 1157, or (iv) Asylee under 8 U.S.C. § 1158, or be eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State. Learn more about the ITAR <a href="https://www.pmddtc.state.gov/?id=ddtc_kb_article_page&amp;sys_id=24d528fddbfc930044f9ff621f961987">here</a>. &nbsp;</li> </ul> <p>SpaceX is an Equal Opportunity Employer; employment with SpaceX is governed on the basis of merit, competence and qualifications and will not be influenced in any manner by race, color, religion, gender, national origin/ethnicity, veteran status, disability status, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, mental or physical disability or any other legally protected status.</p> <p>Applicants wishing to view a copy of SpaceX’s Affirmative Action Plan for veterans and individuals with disabilities, or applicants requiring reasonable accommodation to the application/interview process should reach out to&nbsp;<a href="mailto:EEOCompliance@spacex.com">EEOCompliance@spacex.com</a><em>.&nbsp;</em></p></div>

title: Screen Printing Equipment Engineer, Solar Cells (Starlink)
jd_text: <div class="content-intro"><p>SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of&nbsp;enabling human life on Mars.</p></div><p><strong><span data-contrast="auto">SCREEN PRINTING EQUIPMENT ENGINEER, SOLAR CELLS (STARLINK)</span></strong></p> <p><span data-contrast="auto">Starlink&nbsp;believes in providing fast, reliable internet to those that need it most. We design, build, and launch the world's largest and most advanced satellite constellation that&nbsp;is capable of delivering&nbsp;high-speed internet to even the most remote locations.</span><span data-ccp-props="{&quot;201341983&quot;:0,&quot;335559739&quot;:200,&quot;335559740&quot;:276}">&nbsp;</span></p> <p><span data-contrast="auto">As a Screen Printing Equipment Engineer, you will own the screen printing and related metallization equipment used to manufacture silicon heterojunction solar cells at massive scale. You will work closely with our existing Metallization/Screen Printing Process Engineering team to ensure world-class equipment performance, reliability, and uptime. While the process team focuses on paste properties, contact formation, and cell efficiency, you will be the hardware owner responsible for tool availability, stability, and scaling to support our ambitious goals.</span><span data-ccp-props="{&quot;201341983&quot;:0,&quot;335559739&quot;:200,&quot;335559740&quot;:276}">&nbsp;</span></p> <p><span data-contrast="auto">Your work will form the backbone of the&nbsp;Starlink&nbsp;network (photons of sunlight in is directly proportional to photons of data out to customers!) and help provide internet to tens of millions of customers all around the world. You will spearhead state of the art production equipment for an internal solar cell production line, providing high efficiency and high-quality solar cells for both our latest generation&nbsp;Starlink&nbsp;satellites and for Starship missions to the Moon and Mars.</span><span data-ccp-props="{&quot;201341983&quot;:0,&quot;335559739&quot;:200,&quot;335559740&quot;:276}">&nbsp;</span></p> <p><strong><span data-contrast="auto">RESPONSIBILITIES:</span></strong><span data-ccp-props="{&quot;201341983&quot;:0,&quot;335559739&quot;:200,&quot;335559740&quot;:276}">&nbsp;</span></p> <ul> <li data-leveltext="" data-font="Symbol" data-listid="16" data-list-defn-props="{&quot;335552541&quot;:1,&quot;335559685&quot;:720,&quot;335559991&quot;:360,&quot;469769226&quot;:&quot;Symbol&quot;,&quot;469769242&quot;:[8226],&quot;469777803&quot;:&quot;left&quot;,&quot;469777804&quot;:&quot;&quot;,&quot;469777815&quot;:&quot;multilevel&quot;}" data-aria-posinset="1" data-aria-level="1"><span data-contrast="auto">Work with facilities and process engineering teams to install, qualify, maintain, and continuously improve high-throughput screen printing equipment for heterojunction silicon solar cell&nbsp;manufacturing</span> </li> <li data-leveltext="" data-font="Symbol" data-listid="16" data-list-defn-props="{&quot;335552541&quot;:1,&quot;335559685&quot;:720,&quot;335559991&quot;:360,&quot;469769226&quot;:&quot;Symbol&quot;,&quot;469769242&quot;:[8226],&quot;469777803&quot;:&quot;left&quot;,&quot;469777804&quot;:&quot;&quot;,&quot;469777815&quot;:&quot;multilevel&quot;}" data-aria-posinset="1" data-aria-level="1">Drive equipment reliability and uptime to support very large volume production with minimal downtime. title: Security Engineer
jd_text: <div class="content-intro"><p>SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of&nbsp;enabling human life on Mars.</p></div><p><strong>SECURITY ENGINEER</strong></p> <p>SpaceX is looking for a Security Engineer to join Information Security to help protect and drive the SpaceX mission.&nbsp;</p> <p>Information drives our business. We must protect the confidentiality, integrity, and availability of systems and processes across the enterprise, and defend against loss of control or confidence in our systems. This role writes and operates the software and infrastructure behind SpaceX security standards.</p> <p><strong>RESPONSIBILITIES:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Design, build, and maintain technology that protects SpaceX systems, networks, and data.</li> <li>Stand up authentication and identity services, multi-factor authentication, and network access control identity.</li> <li>Automate identity lifecycle for Information Security and partner organizations.</li> <li>Run backend infrastructure that network security services depend on.</li> <li>Operate web application firewalls and other application-level security controls.</li> <li>Enforce cloud security policy, centralized configuration, and monitoring.</li> <li>Document what you run, keep it working, and advise other teams on it.</li> <li>Find threats and gaps with security and IT, then ship software and deployment changes that reduce risk.</li> <li>Deliver solutions that are scalable, repeatable, maintainable, and secure.</li> <li>Coordinate with information security, physical security, IT, HR, legal, software, and other partners.</li> </ul> <p><strong>BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Bachelor's degree in computer science or another STEM discipline; OR 2+ years of professional experience in security software development in lieu of a degree.</li> <li>Experience with Python, Go, C#, C/C++, or Rust.</li> <li>Experience designing and implementing security solutions for operating systems, distributed systems, or other enterprise / large-scale infrastructure.</li> </ul> <p><strong>PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Writing, shipping, and operating secure software.</li> <li>Linux, Windows, and macOS system internals.</li> <li>Public key infrastructure (PKI) and related technologies.</li> <li>SAML, OIDC, and OAuth.</li> <li>TPMs and HSMs.</li> <li>TCP/IP and UDP at the level needed to build and debug services.</li> <li>Navigating large, interactive systems.</li> <li>Web APIs, HTTP-RPC, and REST.</li> <li>Hardening Windows, Linux, and macOS to enterprise security controls.</li> <li>macOS and Windows code-signing and enterprise application deployment.</li> <li>Root-cause debugging under time pressure.</li> </ul> <p><strong>ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Must be willing to work extended hours and/or weekends as needed.</li> <li>This role requires you to be onsite. Hybrid or remote work will not be considered.</li> <li>Ability to pass Air Force background check for Cape Canaveral.</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong>ITAR REQUIREMENTS:</strong></p> <ul> <li>To conform to U.S. Government export regulations, applicant must be a (i) U.S. citizen or national, (ii) U.S. lawful, permanent resident (aka green card holder), (iii) Refugee under 8 U.S.C. § 1157, or (iv) Asylee under 8 U.S.C. § 1158, or be eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State. Learn more about the ITAR <a href="https://www.pmddtc.state.gov/?id=ddtc_kb_article_page&amp;sys_id=24d528fddbfc930044f9ff621f961987">here</a>. &nbsp;</li> </ul> <p>SpaceX is an Equal Opportunity Employer; employment with SpaceX is governed on the basis of merit, competence and qualifications and will not be influenced in any manner by race, color, religion, gender, national origin/ethnicity, veteran status, disability status, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, mental or physical disability or any other legally protected status.</p> <p>Applicants wishing to view a copy of SpaceX’s Affirmative Action Plan for veterans and individuals with disabilities, or applicants requiring reasonable accommodation to the application/interview process should reach out to&nbsp;<a href="mailto:EEOCompliance@spacex.com">EEOCompliance@spacex.com</a><em>.&nbsp;</em></p></div>

OR 2+ years of professional experience in security software development in lieu of a degree.</li> <li>Experience with Python, Go, C#, C/C++, or Rust.</li> <li>Experience designing and implementing security solutions for operating systems, distributed systems, or other enterprise / large-scale infrastructure.</li> </ul> <p><strong>PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Writing, shipping, and operating secure software.</li> <li>Linux, Windows, and macOS system internals.</li> <li>Public key infrastructure (PKI) and related technologies.</li> <li>SAML, OIDC, and OAuth.</li> <li>TPMs and HSMs.</li> <li>TCP/IP and UDP at the level needed to build and debug services.</li> <li>Navigating large, interactive systems.</li> <li>Web APIs, HTTP-RPC, and REST.</li> <li>Hardening Windows, Linux, and macOS to enterprise security controls.</li> <li>macOS and Windows code-signing and enterprise application deployment.</li> <li>Root-cause debugging under time pressure.</li> </ul> <p><strong>ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Must be willing to work extended hours and/or weekends as needed.</li> <li>This role requires you to be onsite. title: Silicon Packaging Technician, Silicon Assembly (Starlink)
jd_text: <div class="content-intro"><p>SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of&nbsp;enabling human life on Mars.</p></div><p><strong>SILICON PACKAGING TECHNICIAN, SILICON ASSEMBLY (STARLINK)</strong></p> <p>One of the most ambitious missions that SpaceX has undertaken to date, the Starlink satellite constellation, is our solution to providing reliable internet to the entire world. In true SpaceX fashion, Starlink is taking the next step in vertical integration by bringing integrated circuit packaging and assembly in-house for development and manufacturing. You will work closely with IC packaging engineers, test engineers, equipment manufacturers and leadership.</p> <p>The success of Starlink depends on the quality, reliability, cost, manufacturability, throughput, and security of the products that you deliver. If you seek a fast-paced, dynamic environment; if you thrive on solving difficult problems where resolutions have high impact; and if you love the challenge of building something from scratch, then this role will be an ideal next career step.</p> <p><strong>RESPONSIBILITIES:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Operate and maintain deposition systems, including physical vapor deposition (PVD) to deposit precise thin films of metals &amp; dielectrics as well as stripping and etching equipment</li> <li>Operate photolithography tools, such as photoresist coaters, aligners, steppers, scanners, and developers, to apply uniform resist layers, align products, expose patterns, and develop images with precision accuracy</li> <li>Monitor process performance using in-situ sensors and metrology equipment like 3D profilometers, ellipsometers, reflectometers, and X-ray fluorescence (XRF) to ensure film uniformity, step coverage, and contamination control</li> <li>Operate dicing saws, laser dicers, and plasma etching tools to perform mechanical, laser, or plasma-based singulation on wafers and large-format panels, following &amp; monitoring recipes</li> <li>Load and unload materials into molding systems, following recipes to achieve target mold fill, void minimization, and flash control during production runs</li> <li>Operate die attach equipment, including epoxy dispensers, pick-and-place bonders, and reflow stations, to place and secure dies with micron-level accuracy and controlled bond line thickness</li> <li>Operate electrochemical plating tools, including copper electroplaters and seed layer systems, and stripping/etch equipment to process products according to recipes for uniform deposition and precise material removal rates.</li> <li>Comply with cleanroom gowning protocols (ISO), Chemical Safety Standards, &amp; Strict Electrostatic Discharge (ESD) guidelines</li> </ul> <p><strong>BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:</strong></p> <ul> <li>High school diploma or equivalency certificate</li> <li>3+ years of professional experience in a hands-on manufacturing environment; OR associate's degree in an engineering, math or science discipline</li> </ul> <p><strong>PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Bachelor's degree in materials science, electrical engineering, or a related field</li> <li>6+ years of practical experience in high volume semiconductor manufacturing operations</li> <li>Proficiency and experience in photolithography (e.g. align, bake, coat, expose, develop), electrochemical plating, die Attach, thermal compression bonding, compression molding/overmold, wafer dicing, scribe &amp; break, stripping/etching, plasma, reactive ion etching (RIE), thin films deposition (CVD/PVD/ALD), dry film lamination &amp; imaging</li> <li>Proficiency in data analysis and process control software for statistical process control (SPC)</li> <li>Physical stamina to manage equipment in a cleanroom suit and handle sensitive substrates</li> <li>Experience with metrology tools such as confocal scanning acoustic microscopy(C-SAM), 3D profilometers, stereoscopes, optical tensiometers (goniometer), X-Ray fluorescence (XRF)</li> <li>Excellent manual dexterity with the ability to work with both hands under a microscope</li> </ul> <p><strong>ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Must be able to work all shifts &amp; be willing to work overtime and/or weekends as needed</li> <li>Must be able to dawn &amp; wear (at all times) cleanroom attire (e.g. bouffant caps, gowns, masks, nitrile gloves, ESD footwear, bunny suits, hoods) for full shifts</li> <li>Standing for long periods, bending, grasping, sitting, pulling, pushing, stooping &amp; stretching</li> <li>Must be able to lift up to 35lbs. unassisted</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong>ITAR REQUIREMENTS:</strong></p> <ul> <li>To conform to U.S. Government export regulations, applicant must be a (i) U.S. citizen or national, (ii) U.S. lawful, permanent resident (aka green card holder), (iii) Refugee under 8 U.S.C. § 1157, or (iv) Asylee under 8 U.S.C. § 1158, or be eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State. title: Site Reliability Engineer, Data Center Infrastructure
jd_text: <div class="content-intro"><p>SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of&nbsp;enabling human life on Mars.</p></div><p><strong>SITE RELIABILITY ENGINEER, DATA CENTER INFRASTRUCTURE</strong></p> <p>The application software team is the central nervous system of SpaceX. Manufacturing is how SpaceX turns designs into hardware. The compute, storage, and networking that run our factories must be as reliable as the products we build. This team owns infrastructure supporting Starship, Starlink, Starshield, and Terafab. This position will have a direct impact on factory uptime, throughput, and production scale across programs.</p> <p>The ideal candidate has strong software engineering fundamentals and a passion for infrastructure: reliability, stability, proactive maintenance, and scalability. You understand the system before you change it, solve hard problems, communicate clearly with stakeholders and teammates, and take ownership of work that manufacturing depends on.</p> <p>Aerospace experience is not required. treatment systems, including Zero Liquid Discharge (ZLD) facilities.</p> <p><strong>RESPONSIBILITIES:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Work directly with key internal stakeholders (wastewater engineering, title: Sourcing Manager, Contract Manufacturing (Starlink)
jd_text: <div class="content-intro"><p>SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of&nbsp;enabling human life on Mars.</p></div><p><strong>SOURCING MANAGER, CONTRACT MANUFACTURING (STARLINK)</strong></p> <p>SpaceX is leveraging our experience building rockets and spacecraft to deploy Starlink, the world’s largest satellite constellation and most advanced broadband internet system. We provide reliable and fast internet to millions of users worldwide, including populations with little or no connectivity, rural communities, aircraft, watercraft, and places where existing services are unreliable, too expensive, or disconnected by natural disasters. We design, build, test, and operate all parts of the system, thousands of satellites and consumer antennae that allow users to connect within minutes of unboxing. The Starlink team is seeking out the best-in-class professionals to maximize Starlink’s potential for communities and businesses around the globe.</p> <p>As a Sourcing Manager, you will be part of an agile, yet robust, supply chain team that will enable a competitive advantage for the company. The functions within the department include procurement, planning and fulfillment, supplier development and quality, and logistics and inventory. SpaceX supply chain plays a key role in enabling SpaceX to meet these ambitious growth targets and contribute to making us a multi-planetary species.</p> <p><strong>RESPONSIBILITIES:&nbsp;</strong></p> <ul> <li>Conduct comprehensive supplier analysis to formulate a strategic sourcing plan that identifies new/suitable suppliers, optimizes cost structures, and proactively ensures continuity of supply per demand</li> <li>Create sourcing strategies to reduce risk, enable continuous cost reduction, and align with company strategy on payment terms, cash targets, on-time delivery, and cost savings</li> <li>Build and own overall project budgets, compile funding requests, generate capitalization plan based on project timeline focusing on TCO of project, and negotiate with contract manufacturer on optimizing capex investment and utilization</li> <li>Manage the supply base by implementing a precise forecast model and clear-to-build model, title: Sourcing Manager, Data Center Construction (Starlink)
jd_text: <div class="content-intro"><p>SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. The focus is to enable the build-out of high-density, high-reliability data centers that support xAI training and inference workloads. You will work closely with construction, facilities, engineering, and operations stakeholders to deliver sites on schedule, on budget, and at the quality bar required for mission-critical compute. background to deal with contracts and negotiations</li> <li>Direct construction project management experience and/or construction cost estimating experience on large industrial, commercial, or data center projects</li> <li>Familiarity or experience in purchasing or similar procurement related to construction and capital equipment</li> <li>Experience in industrial engineering, construction management, facilities management, or hyperscale / enterprise data center delivery</li> <li>Strong budget tracking and cost analytical skills on large capital programs</li> <li>Extensive project management and organizational skills</li> <li>Experience managing large-scale industrial, commercial, or data center construction projects (preferably $50M+ packages)</li> <li>Strong contract negotiation and document management skills (AIA, or similar; equipment T&amp;Cs)</li> <li>Remarkable problem-solving skills with a bias for speed</li> <li>Quick learner and ability to prioritize Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of&nbsp;enabling human life on Mars.</p></div><div><strong data-olk-copy-source="MessageBody">SOURCING MANAGER, PCB (STARLINK)</strong></div> <div>&nbsp;</div> <div>At SpaceX we’re leveraging our experience in building rockets and spacecraft to deploy Starlink, the world’s most advanced broadband internet system. Starlink is the world’s largest satellite constellation and is providing fast, reliable internet to millions of users worldwide. We design, build, test, and operate all parts of the system – thousands of satellites, consumer receivers that allow users to connect within minutes of unboxing, and the software that brings it all together. We’ve only begun to scratch the surface of Starlink’s potential global impact and are looking for best-in-class individuals to join our supply chain team and help maximize Starlink’s utility for communities and businesses around the globe.</div> <div>&nbsp;</div> <div>This is a high-profile, cross functional position that plays an integral role in enabling development and production flow of satellites. Working in close coordination with engineering and manufacturing departments, sourcing specialists execute effective creative and smart supply chain strategies to achieve production goals. The functions within the supply chain management include material requirements planning, delivery management, dock-to-stock coordination, and inventory management. With integration taking place in-house, sourcing specialists are able to see their assemblies come to life every day!</div> <div>&nbsp;</div> <div><strong>RESPONSIBILITIES:&nbsp;&nbsp;</strong></div> <ul> <li>Work directly with key suppliers to develop and implement sourcing and cost management strategies that support existing platforms and new product development&nbsp;</li> <li>Pull and aggregate the overall demand picture for hardware used to support the Starlink satellite constellation to enable an accurate demand signal that will enable rate</li> <li>Act as the supplier interface for all RFIs, RFPs and RFQs</li> <li>Partner with internal stakeholders to run the RFX process and evaluation, then use results to implement a sourcing decision&nbsp;</li> <li>Manage cost aggressively to ensure adherence to project-specific budgets and forecasts</li> <li>Develop should-cost models for competitive cost analysis&nbsp;</li> <li>Ensure that suppliers are prepared to support all prototype builds with appropriate equipment and material to ensure successful product development, ramp up and mass production&nbsp;</li> <li>Drive internal and external process improvements to enhance efficiency and implement cost-saving programs with suppliers&nbsp;</li> <li>Present value propositions to SpaceX executives, including those related to contract award, cost reviews, cost reduction strategies and critical supply issues&nbsp;</li> <li>Develop, manage, and maintain strong supplier partnerships&nbsp;</li> <li>Implement analytical data management tools to manage supplier performance&nbsp;</li> </ul> <div><strong>BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:&nbsp;</strong></div> <ul> <li>Bachelor’s degree and 5+ years of experience working in one or more of the following; or 9+ years of experience working in one or more of the following in lieu of a degree:</li> <ul> <li>Engineering</li> <li>Purchasing</li> <li>Contract negotiation</li> <li>Material or production planning</li> <li>Operations or supply chain management</li> <li>Material cost control</li> <li>Master production scheduling</li> <li>Technical procurement or planning experience with PCB, PCBA, or electrical components</li> </ul> </ul> <div><strong>PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:</strong></div> <ul> <li>Experience with printed circuit board and/or substrate fabrication</li> <li>Experience with PCBAs, contract manufacturing, electronic component packaging, and/or managing a technical supply chain</li> <li>Experience in managing high-spend portfolios (i.e. $10M+)</li> <li>Experience with MRP or enterprise resource planning (ERP) systems, and with managing bill of materials, work orders, and purchase orders</li> <li>Experience with forecasting, demand planning, and lead time analysis</li> <li>Strong skills in data analysis using Excel, SQL and PowerBI</li> <li>Effective written and verbal communications skills, with strong ability to communicate to all levels of internal personnel</li> <li>Ability to learn quickly and prioritize appropriately to meet customer and company needs</li> <li>Detail-oriented, self-motivated and able to respond quickly to a fast-moving and ever-changing environment</li> <li>Ability to conduct all activities with integrity and urgency</li> </ul> <div><strong>ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS:</strong></div> <ul> <li>May need to work irregular hours with global suppliers in different time zones</li> <li>Able to travel for short and extended trips as needed</li> <li>Willingness to work extended hours and/or weekends when needed</li> <li>This position is based in Bastrop, TX and requires being onsite - remote work not considered</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong>ITAR REQUIREMENTS:</strong></p> <ul> <li>To conform to U.S. Government export regulations, applicant must be a (i) U.S. citizen or national, (ii) U.S. lawful, permanent resident (aka green card holder), (iii) Refugee under 8 U.S.C. § 1157, or (iv) Asylee under 8 U.S.C. § 1158, or be eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State. title: Sourcing Specialist (Starship)
jd_text: <div class="content-intro"><p>SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of&nbsp;enabling human life on Mars.</p></div><p><strong>SOURCING SPECIALIST (STARSHIP)</strong></p> <p>SpaceX is on a fast track to become the market leader in various product categories like US based human spaceflight, rapid vehicle reusability, internet services through the Starlink constellation and others exciting projects. The SpaceX Supply Chain Department is a critical player in our operations. To capitalize on SpaceX’s technological and market changing successes, our team will be part of managing an agile yet robust supply chain that will enable a competitive advantage for the company. The functions within the department include procurement, planning and fulfillment, supplier development and quality, logistics and inventory. SpaceX supply chain will play a key role in enabling SpaceX to meet these ambitious growth targets and greatly contribute in making us a multi-planetary species.</p> <p><strong>RESPONSIBILITIES:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Conduct comprehensive supplier analysis to formulate a strategic sourcing plan that identifies new/suitable suppliers, optimize cost structures and proactively ensures continuity of supply based on macro market or industry trends. Manage the supply base by implementing a precise supplier stratification model and executing on a documented supplier management playbook</li> <li>Ensure health of supply base by evaluating and selecting suppliers based on capability, quality, reliability, and price competitiveness. Ensure supplier meets all critical measures of performance consistently by consistently executing on an operating plan with clear goals and control plans</li> <li>Analyze supplier operations to assess technical capability, equipment, and capacity for rapid deployment of new product development and long term production to implement a successful E2E product life cycle management strategy and process</li> <li>Direct and execute initiatives that support aggressive improvements in supplier quality, total cost effectiveness, enhanced service levels, improved coordination, delivery, pricing, lead-times, payment, risk compliance and other areas as identified</li> <li>Develop supplier score card to measure supplier performance against agreed upon key performance indicators; tracks compliance and supports formal management reporting to director and other members of senior management. Benchmark, track, and analyze annual performance metrics and sourcing trends against budget on a monthly basis to demonstrate continuous improvement and progress against strategic objectives</li> <li>Develop strong relationships with internal stakeholders, understanding their needs and consulting with them to build quality procurement strategies aligned to business requirements. Be the voice of reason and push engineering to make sound design decisions that are conducive to a high performing supply plan. Drive make vs. buy decisions for new products, implement the strategy across the product lifecycle from development, qualification, first article runs through stable production</li> <li>Execute sourcing strategies including development and execution of RFI’s and RFP’s, document bid events through correspondence to suppliers; develop selection criteria for suppliers in collaboration with cross-functional teams; conduct supplier negotiations/contracting and ongoing contract management</li> <li>Coordinate with engineering and quality organizations to determine cause of rejected material and to drive appropriate changes to ensure elimination/reduction of those quality issues</li> <li>Administer moderate to large contracts and independently negotiate with supplier’s contract terminology, pricing, technical requirements, scope and terms involving responsibility, liability, indemnification, intellectual property and export compliance</li> <li>Execute purchasing transactions within scope area by issuing purchase orders for SpaceX programs and ensure delivery. Manage all relevant master data in MRP to ensure accurate and complete information at all times</li> <li>Consult/advise buyer/planners on strategies and tactics to ensure their success and development. Provide high-level oversight and support to ensure operational success in tactical procurement execution</li> </ul> <p><strong>BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Bachelor’s degree</li> </ul> <p><strong>PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:</strong></p> <ul> <li>2+ years of professional experience in technical sourcing, procurement, or planning</li> <li>Experience reading drawings and blueprints</li> <li>Technical knowledge in a commodity (e.g. composites raw material, composite component manufacturing, machining, avionics, soft goods etc.)</li> <li>Experience in sourcing from a global supply base using various contractual models</li> <li>Proven success working on cross-functional new product introduction projects, completing cost models, and negotiating</li> <li>Familiarity with ERP systems and purchasing/planning functions</li> <li>Exceptional written, verbal and presentation communication skills</li> <li>Ability to identify and resolve technical, operational and organizational problems</li> <li>Detail-oriented, self-motivated and able to respond quickly to a fast-moving and ever-changing environment</li> <li>Able to conduct all activities with the highest of integrity</li> <li>Understanding of block-chain powered supply chain platforms to boost efficiency, traceability, and payment processing speeds</li> </ul> <p><strong>ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Must be able to travel - up to 50% work week travel may be required, including international travel</li> <li>Must be able to work extended hours and/or weekends as needed to meet major milestones</li> <li>This position is based in Starbase, TX and requires being onsite - remote work not considered</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong>ITAR REQUIREMENTS:</strong></p> <ul> <li>To conform to U.S. Government export regulations, applicant must be a (i) U.S. citizen or national, (ii) U.S. lawful, permanent resident (aka green card holder), (iii) Refugee under 8 U.S.C. § 1157, or (iv) Asylee under 8 U.S.C. § 1158, or be eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State. Learn more about the ITAR <a href="https://www.pmddtc.state.gov/?id=ddtc_kb_article_page&amp;sys_id=24d528fddbfc930044f9ff621f961987">here</a>. &nbsp;</li> </ul> <p>SpaceX is an Equal Opportunity Employer; employment with SpaceX is governed on the basis of merit, competence and qualifications and will not be influenced in any manner by race, color, religion, gender, national origin/ethnicity, veteran status, disability status, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, mental or physical disability or any other legally protected status.</p> <p>Applicants wishing to view a copy of SpaceX’s Affirmative Action Plan for veterans and individuals with disabilities, or applicants requiring reasonable accommodation to the application/interview process should reach out to&nbsp;<a href="mailto:EEOCompliance@spacex.com">EEOCompliance@spacex.com</a><em>.&nbsp;</em></p></div>
