As a Sr. Process Controls Engineer, you will design, build, and optimize controls and automation systems for the delivery of critical gases and chemicals in solar cell fabrication. This role requires a detail-oriented engineer passionate about safe handling of hazardous materials in a high-volume manufacturing environment, ensuring reliable control code and safe instrumentation and design of processes like vacuum deposition and etching while minimizing risks and maximizing efficiency in our cutting-edge solar cell factory.</span></p> <p><strong>RESPONSIBILITIES:</strong>&nbsp;</p> <ul> <li>Design, implement, and maintain automation systems including PLC programming and SCADA development for gas farm operations (e.g., vaporizers, storage, and transfer systems) and wastewater treatment processes (e.g., solids separation, clarification, and chemical dosing) to ensure safe, efficient, and compliant performance</li> <li>Develop and program PLC control logic, PID loops, and interlocks for centralized control of distributed subsystems, optimizing for real-time monitoring of parameters such as pressure, temperature, flow, pH, and effluent quality</li> <li>Select, calibrate, and integrate field instrumentation (e.g., transmitters, sensors, analyzers) in hazardous environments, ensuring compatibility with safety standards like SIL, ATEX, and EPA/NPDES regulations</li> <li>Lead commissioning, FAT/SAT testing, and troubleshooting of control systems, performing root-cause analysis to minimize downtime and support 24/7 operations with rapid alarm response</li> <li>Design electrical systems compliant to NEC, NFPA, &amp; UL508A regulations</li> </ul> <p><strong>BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:</strong>&nbsp;</p> <ul> <li>Bachelor's degree in engineering, physics, or chemical discipline&nbsp;</li> <li>5+ years of experience with fluids/systems manufacturing, controls and automation, and/or programming&nbsp;</li> </ul> <p><strong>PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:</strong>&nbsp;</p> <ul> <li>Excited by a quick and iterative&nbsp;design&nbsp;and manufacturing role</li> <li>Proven ability to solve complex problems with simple solutions in both&nbsp;design&nbsp;and implementation stages</li> <li>Excellent communication skills both written and verbal, with the ability to make plans and directional recommendations collaboratively and cross-functionally</li> <li>Ability to engineer creative, new approaches to problems while adhering to ANSI/RIA15.06/OSHA safety requirements to keep a factory safe&nbsp;</li> <li>Hazardous process expertise in an aerospace, oil and gas, or chemical industry where high pressure or hazardous systems for fluids or gasses were in use</li> </ul> <p>Experience with at least one of the specific disciplines listed below. The ideal candidate is interested in learning at least the fundamentals of the other areas they are not yet strong in.&nbsp;</p> <p><em>Electrical/Industrial Controls:&nbsp;</em></p> <ul> <li>Electrical sizing of motors, valves, pneumatics, cables, circuit protection, VFDs, motor starters, various other motion systems&nbsp;</li> <li>Design&nbsp;of fail-safe electrical circuits using jd_text: <div class="content-intro"><p>SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. RESPONSIBLE ENGINEER - TURBOMACHINERY (STARSHIP)</strong></p> <p>This role as a responsible engineer (RE) focuses on the development of turbomachinery for Starship's fluid systems, with the goal of creating high-performance and highly manufacturable interplanetary vehicles. The position involves designing, analyzing, and building advanced turbopumps that manage pressurization for Starship throughout all phases of travel to the Moon and Mars, including in-space propellant transfer. This is a unique opportunity to expand the frontiers of turbomachinery knowledge and manage cryogenic fluids in space.</p> <p>Key responsibilities include sizing turbomachinery components, performing detailed mechanical design, conducting structural and fluid analysis, and overseeing the manufacturing and assembly of parts and systems. The RE will be the primary owner of turbomachinery hardware, tasked with developing the concept of operations for each unit, from acceptance testing through in-flight performance.</p> <p><strong>&nbsp;</strong><strong>RESPONSIBILITIES: </strong></p> <ul> <li>&nbsp;Collaborate with a multidisciplinary team of turbomachinery and manufacturing engineers, driving the rapid development and execution of designs for Starship's propulsion system turbomachinery</li> <li>Design,&nbsp;build&nbsp;and&nbsp;test&nbsp;turbopumps for Starship, the most advanced orbital vehicle propulsion Starlink is the world's largest satellite constellation and provides fast, reliable internet to millions of users worldwide. We design, build, manufacture, and operate all parts of the system — including thousands of satellites and millions of customer kits. We are looking for best-in-class engineers to help maximize Starlink's utility for individuals, communities, and businesses.<span data-ccp-props="{&quot;201341983&quot;:0,&quot;335559739&quot;:160,&quot;335559740&quot;:276}">&nbsp;</span></p> <p><span data-contrast="auto">Starlink radio products must certify in the United States and internationally before they ship. This role is the RF compliance owner for those products, split&nbsp;about 50/50 between:</span><span certification for Starlink wireless hardware on a 50/50&nbsp;WiFi&nbsp;and cellular mix across US and international markets&nbsp;</li> <li>WiFi&nbsp;(2.4 / 5 / 6 GHz): develop and own compliance strategy, test setups, and methods for typical&nbsp;WiFi&nbsp;products, including DFS where required and 6 GHz / AFC paths as those products come online&nbsp;</li> <li>Cellular (5G, LTE, GPRS, 3GPP): develop and own compliance strategy for cellular hardware, including base stations and related devices, covering US licensed-service rules and international 3GPP / ETSI requirements&nbsp;</li> <li>Apply core FCC and ETSI radio standards in day-to-day work — including FCC Part 15 for&nbsp;WiFi&nbsp;(2.4 / 5 / 6 GHz, DFS) and FCC licensed-service rules for cellular; ETSI EN 300 328 (2.4 GHz), EN 301 893 (5 GHz), EN 303 687 (6 GHz WAS/RLAN), and EN 301 908 / 3GPP for cellular devices and base stations&nbsp;</li> <li>Read RF designs (architecture, radio chains, antennas, filters, power tables, firmware limits) and turn standards into actionable design and test requirements&nbsp;</li> <li>Plan and run RF compliance test campaigns with accredited labs — conducted and radiated, spurious, power, DFS, exposure (MPE/SAR) as applicable, and cellular / base-station conformance&nbsp;</li> <li>Work directly with RF hardware, firmware, and software teams to implement the design or power-table changes required for certification&nbsp;</li> <li>Validate and generate transmit power tables with RF design, software, and test labs&nbsp;</li> <li>Audit labs and vendors so methods and design teams&nbsp;</li> </ul> <p><strong>BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Bachelor's degree in electrical engineering, computer engineering, or another STEM discipline&nbsp;</li> <li>5+ years of experience in RF / wireless regulatory compliance and certification&nbsp;</li> <li>Working knowledge of basic FCC and ETSI radio standards for&nbsp;WiFi&nbsp;and/or cellular&nbsp;</li> <li>Demonstrated ability to follow an RF product from design → test → compliance (not test-only or paperwork-only)&nbsp;</li> </ul> <p><strong>PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:</strong></p> <ul> infrastructure, or both)&nbsp;</li> <li>Ability to translate standards into requirements RF and firmware teams can implement&nbsp;</li> </ul> <p><strong>ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Ability to work extended hours or weekends as needed for mission-critical certification deadlines&nbsp;</li> <li>Willingness to work on-site with RF design, test, and lab teams&nbsp;</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong>ITAR REQUIREMENTS:</strong></p> <ul> <li>To conform to U.S. Government export regulations, applicant must be a (i) U.S. citizen or national, (ii) U.S. jd_text: <div class="content-intro"><p>SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. RF SOFTWARE ENGINEER (STARLINK)</strong></p> <p>Starlink believes in providing fast, reliable internet to serve populations with little or no connectivity. We design, build, launch, and operate the world's largest constellation of satellites, enabling us to operate a global internet network unbounded by traditional ground infrastructure limitations. Starlink also designs, builds, and delivers high-volume consumer hardware that allows users to connect to these satellites within minutes of unboxing, as well as our advanced gateways that we deploy regionally throughout the world. The root of SpaceX’s success so far lies in our mission to keep all engineering and production in-house, which enables a tight feedback loop, nimble decision-making, and speedy deliverables. With millions of daily users worldwide already online, Starlink is truly a game-changer and levels the playing field for those who were previously unconnected.</p> <p>As an RF software engineer in the Starlink program, you will work with a team of RF engineers, DSP engineers, software engineers, hardware engineers and end users to design and build RF capabilities for proliferated communications and remote sensing in low earth orbit. You will work in a highly collaborative and fast-paced environment, where we are exploring unsolved problems and applying the SpaceX mindset of iterating rapidly to go from design and demo to operational capability at lightning pace.</p> <p><strong>RESPONSIBILITIES:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Drive program-level decisions on RF system designs</li> <li>Research novel solutions for unique title: Sr. Screen Printing Equipment Engineer, Solar Cells (Starlink)
jd_text: <div class="content-intro"><p>SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of&nbsp;enabling human life on Mars.</p></div><p><strong><span data-contrast="auto">SR. SCREEN PRINTING EQUIPMENT ENGINEER, SOLAR CELLS (STARLINK)</span></strong></p> <p><span data-contrast="auto">Starlink&nbsp;believes in providing fast, reliable internet to those that need it most. We design, build, and launch the world's largest and most advanced satellite constellation that&nbsp;is capable of delivering&nbsp;high-speed internet to even the most remote locations.</span><span data-ccp-props="{&quot;201341983&quot;:0,&quot;335559739&quot;:200,&quot;335559740&quot;:276}">&nbsp;</span></p> <p><span data-contrast="auto">As a Sr. Screen Printing Equipment Engineer, you will own the screen printing and related metallization equipment used to manufacture silicon heterojunction solar cells at massive scale. You will work closely with our existing Metallization/Screen Printing Process Engineering team to ensure world-class equipment performance, reliability, and uptime. While the process team focuses on paste properties, contact formation, and cell efficiency, you will be the hardware owner responsible for tool availability, stability, and scaling to support our ambitious goals.</span><span data-ccp-props="{&quot;201341983&quot;:0,&quot;335559739&quot;:200,&quot;335559740&quot;:276}">&nbsp;</span></p> <p><span data-contrast="auto">Your work will form the backbone of the&nbsp;Starlink&nbsp;network (photons of sunlight in is directly proportional to photons of data out to customers!) and help provide internet to tens of millions of customers all around the world. You will spearhead state of the art production equipment for an internal solar cell production line, providing high efficiency and high-quality solar cells for both our latest generation&nbsp;Starlink&nbsp;satellites and for Starship missions to the Moon and Mars.</span><span data-ccp-props="{&quot;201341983&quot;:0,&quot;335559739&quot;:200,&quot;335559740&quot;:276}">&nbsp;</span></p> <p><strong><span data-contrast="auto">RESPONSIBILITIES:</span></strong><span data-ccp-props="{&quot;201341983&quot;:0,&quot;335559739&quot;:200,&quot;335559740&quot;:276}">&nbsp;</span></p> <ul> <li data-leveltext="" data-font="Symbol" data-listid="16" data-list-defn-props="{&quot;335552541&quot;:1,&quot;335559685&quot;:720,&quot;335559991&quot;:360,&quot;469769226&quot;:&quot;Symbol&quot;,&quot;469769242&quot;:[8226],&quot;469777803&quot;:&quot;left&quot;,&quot;469777804&quot;:&quot;&quot;,&quot;469777815&quot;:&quot;multilevel&quot;}" data-aria-posinset="1" data-aria-level="1"><span data-contrast="auto">Work with facilities and process engineering teams to install, qualify, maintain, and continuously improve high-throughput screen printing equipment for heterojunction silicon solar cell&nbsp;manufacturing</span></li> <li data-leveltext="" data-font="Symbol" data-listid="16" data-list-defn-props="{&quot;335552541&quot;:1,&quot;335559685&quot;:720,&quot;335559991&quot;:360,&quot;469769226&quot;:&quot;Symbol&quot;,&quot;469769242&quot;:[8226],&quot;469777803&quot;:&quot;left&quot;,&quot;469777804&quot;:&quot;&quot;,&quot;469777815&quot;:&quot;multilevel&quot;}" data-aria-posinset="1" data-aria-level="1">Drive equipment reliability and uptime to support very large volume production with minimal downtime. title: Sr. Security Engineer (Infrastructure)
jd_text: <div class="content-intro"><p>SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of&nbsp;enabling human life on Mars.</p></div><p><strong>SR. SECURITY ENGINEER (INFRASTRUCTURE)</strong></p> <p>SpaceX is looking for a Sr. Security Engineer (Infrastructure) to join Information Security to help protect and drive the SpaceX mission.&nbsp;Information drives our business. We must protect the confidentiality, integrity, and availability of systems and processes across the enterprise, and defend against loss of control or confidence in our systems.&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>RESPONSIBILITIES:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Design on-premises Kubernetes platforms that security services run on, and the compute, storage, and networking they depend on.</li> <li>Lead cluster lifecycle work, including upgrades, capacity, failure domains, and safe change.</li> <li>Build the automation other engineers use to provision, configure, and operate the platform.</li> <li>Set standards for how security services are deployed, hardened, and run on Kubernetes.</li> <li>Harden clusters and workloads, including RBAC, policy, secrets, and secure configuration.</li> <li>Respond to the hardest production incidents and drive them to a durable fix.</li> <li>Define the signals, alerts, and operational practices that keep the platform supportable.</li> <li>Document what you run, keep it working, and advise other teams on it.</li> <li>Find systemic gaps with security and IT, then ship platform and deployment changes that reduce risk.</li> <li>Deliver solutions that are scalable, repeatable, maintainable, and secure.</li> <li>Coordinate with information security, IT, software, and other partners.</li> </ul> <p><strong>BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Bachelor's degree in computer science or another STEM discipline; OR 2+ years of professional experience operating production infrastructure and high school diploma or equivalency certificate in lieu of a degree.</li> <li>5+ years of experience operating on-premises Kubernetes in a production environment.</li> <li>5+ years of experience with Linux system administration and with Python, Go, or another language used to automate infrastructure.</li> </ul> <p><strong>PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Production Kubernetes at scale, including control plane, networking, storage, RBAC, and upgrades.</li> <li>Designing on-premises compute, storage, and network architectures for container platforms.</li> <li>Cluster and node hardening, admission control, and secure workload configuration.</li> <li>Infrastructure as code and configuration management.</li> <li>Python or Go for platform tooling and automation.</li> <li>Linux internals and troubleshooting.</li> <li>Observability, alerting, and operational readiness for production platforms.</li> <li>CI/CD or GitOps-style delivery onto Kubernetes.</li> <li>Capacity planning, failure domains, and recovery for on-premises platforms.</li> <li>TCP/IP at the level needed to build and debug cluster networking.</li> <li>Root-cause debugging under time pressure.</li> </ul> <p><strong>ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Must be willing to work extended hours and/or weekends as needed.</li> <li>This role requires you to be onsite. Hybrid or remote work will not be considered.</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong>ITAR REQUIREMENTS:</strong></p> <ul> <li>To conform to U.S. Government export regulations, applicant must be a (i) U.S. citizen or national, (ii) U.S. lawful, permanent resident (aka green card holder), (iii) Refugee under 8 U.S.C. § 1157, or (iv) Asylee under 8 U.S.C. § 1158, or be eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State. title: Sr. Security Software Engineer (Starlink)
jd_text: <div class="content-intro"><p>SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of&nbsp;enabling human life on Mars.</p></div><p><strong>SR. SECURITY SOFTWARE ENGINEER (STARLINK)</strong></p> <p>At SpaceX we’re leveraging our experience in building rockets and spacecraft to deploy Starlink, the world’s most advanced broadband internet system. Starlink is the world’s largest satellite constellation and is providing fast, reliable internet to millions of users worldwide. We design, build, test, and operate all parts of the system – thousands of satellites, consumer receivers that allow users to connect within minutes of unboxing, and the software that brings it all together. We’ve only begun to scratch the surface of Starlink’s potential global impact and are looking for best-in-class engineers to help maximize Starlink’s utility for communities and businesses around the globe.</p> <p>As a Security Software Engineer you will influence the security of software across our product lines. We are looking for people with a track record of shipping reliable software and who have a broad understanding of the security design of today’s Internet, including the cryptographic primitives involved. You see the big picture, prioritize accordingly, and are comfortable with working at different levels of abstraction. Ideally, you have notable skills in one or more of the following:</p> <ul> <li>Software engineering</li> <li>Applied cryptography</li> <li>Network security</li> <li>Operating system security</li> <li>Secure/Authenticated boot</li> <li>Incident response and adversary detection</li> <li>Vulnerability research</li> </ul> <p>Being flexible, communicating clearly, and establishing and maintaining productive working relationships with other engineering teams are paramount to success. If you are passionate about building quality products, love the challenges of outsmarting adversaries, and want to make an impact on an inter-planetary scale, then you will fit right in.</p> <p><strong>RESPONSIBILITIES:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Design and build security infrastructure for Starlink, including cryptographic services and other security-critical services</li> <li>Develop security features for Starlink systems, including our router, dish, gateways, and satellites</li> <li>Design security into factory processes and provide network services in support of this</li> <li>Maintain existing production systems and improve security posture via both direct implementation and recommendations to other teams</li> <li>Build prototypes and help identify, design, and test security improvements</li> <li>Further our mission of providing secure and reliable Internet to underserved communities</li> </ul> <p><strong>BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Bachelor's degree in computer science or another STEM discipline and 5+ years of professional experience in security software development; OR 7+ years of professional experience in security software development in lieu of a degree</li> <li>Experience with one or more software development languages (i.e. Python, C++, Golang)</li> <li>Experience designing and implementing security solutions for operating systems, distributed systems, or other enterprise/large-scale infrastructure</li> </ul> <p><strong>PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Experience contributing security improvements to complex systems</li> <li>Experience working with special purpose security hardware such as Trusted Platform Modules (TPMs) and Hardware Security Modules (HSMs)</li> <li>Fundamental understanding of network protocols; including the TCP/IP stack as well as UDP based protocols</li> <li>Experienced in navigating large, complex, interactive systems</li> <li>Flexibility, communicating clearly, and establishing and maintaining productive working relationships with other engineering teams</li> <li>Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal</li> <li>Ability to work both independently and in a team</li> <li>Demonstrated ability to deal with ambiguity and to learn new technologies quickly</li> <li>Advanced degree in a technical or engineering discipline</li> </ul> <p><strong>ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Must be willing to work extended hours and weekends as needed</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong>ITAR REQUIREMENTS:</strong></p> <ul> <li>To conform to U.S. Government export regulations, applicant must be a (i) U.S. citizen or national, (ii) U.S. lawful, permanent resident (aka green card holder), (iii) Refugee under 8 U.S.C. § 1157, or (iv) Asylee under 8 U.S.C. § 1158, or be eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State. You will be responsible for the complete life cycle of the software you create, from development to testing to operation during a mission.</p> <p>Aerospace experience is not required to be successful here - rather we look for smart, motivated, collaborative engineers who love solving problems and want to make an impact on a super inspiring mission.</p> <p><strong>RESPONSIBILITIES: </strong></p> <ul> <li>Develop highly reliable autonomous software systems and simulations to validate them</li> <li>Develop prototypes to prove out key design concepts and quantify technical constraints</li> <li>Own all aspects of software development, including design, testing, and mission integration</li> <li>Provide strong technical leadership, focus on continuous improvement</li> </ul> <p><strong>BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, math, or science discipline and 4+ years of professional experience in software development; Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of&nbsp;enabling human life on Mars.</p></div><p><strong>SR. SOURCING SPECIALIST, CONSTRUCTION&nbsp;</strong></p> <p>We are a progressive procurement organization pushing the boundaries of traditional procurement reputation and methodologies. We are looking for individuals who can think outside the box to achieve company objectives regarding value and partnerships with our suppliers. Our organization moves quickly, and you must too. SpaceX has the unique ability and desire to influence and shape suppliers to be better with us as we challenge our supply chain on cost, quality, and delivery. This individual will support construction projects that expand or optimize infrastructure for the Starship Program.</p> <p><strong>RESPONSIBILITIES:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Work directly with key internal stakeholders to develop and implement a comprehensive contract management process that ensures a successful project execution cycle</li> <li>Create sourcing strategies for assigned categories to reduce risk and meet targets for the purchasing department, including, but not limited to, payment terms, cash targets, and cost savings</li> <li>Develop and maintain key internal stakeholder relationships to create strategic sourcing models that optimize the value of products and services that support business unit requirements to maintain continuous cost reduction programs for controllable expenditures</li> <li>Communicate, manage, and drive compliance to category strategies</li> <li>Identify and execute cost reduction projects, including planning, coordinating with stakeholders, estimating completion, and project updates</li> <li>Perform advanced quantitative and business process analyses to identify financial impacts of decisions, cost improvement, and performance for assigned categories</li> <li>Collaborate with stakeholders to define SLAs and KPIs for suppliers and measure the appropriate criteria, such as: delivery of business results, cost reduction, quality and timeliness of delivery</li> <li>Conduct research, perform benchmarking, and gather market analysis for assigned categories</li> <li>Create contract documents in collaboration with the legal department</li> <li>Manage contracts to ensure the performance of the supplier to contract obligations</li> <li>Understand interrelationships between contracts and terms while applying creativity and sound business reasoning to interpret application of contract to business needs</li> <li>Maximize value and cost savings benefits while lowering risk through strategic negotiations</li> <li>Identify and drive year over year cost optimization through reducing usage and eliminating waste within our operations</li> <li>Establish preferred suppliers for assigned categories</li> <li>Optimize procurement processes from PO to pay to ensure we are as efficient as possible in our allocation of time and resources to achieve the best possible outcomes for the business in the shortest amount of time</li> <li>Create and implement management programs to develop, continuously improve, manage the performance of, and monitor KPIs of the supply base</li> <li>Place purchase orders and resolve blocked invoices related to assigned categories</li> <li>Develop and lead efforts to reduce number of transactions and for assigned categories</li> </ul> <p><strong>BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Advanced degree; or bachelor’s degree and 2+ years of experience working in one or more of the following; or 6+ years of experience working in one or more of the following:</li> <ul> <li>Engineering</li> <li>Supply Chain</li> <li>Purchasing</li> <li>Contract negotiation</li> <li>Material or production planning</li> <li>Operations management</li> <li>Material cost control</li> <li>Master production scheduling</li> </ul> </ul> <p><strong>PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:&nbsp;</strong></p> <ul> <li>Construction project management experience and/or construction cost estimate experience</li> <li>Familiarity or experience in purchasing or similar procurement related experience</li> <li>Experience in industrial engineering, construction management, and/or facilities management</li> <li>Strong budget tracking and cost analytical skills</li> <li>Strong project management and organizational skills</li> <li>Experience managing large scale industrial and commercial construction projects</li> <li>Strong contract negotiation and document management skills</li> <li>Remarkable problem-solving skills with a bias for speed</li> <li>Quick learner and ability to prioritize appropriately to meet customer and company needs</li> <li>Excellent customer service skills</li> <li>Effective written, verbal, and presentation communication skills</li> <li>Exceptional analytical and organizational skills</li> <li>Strong technical knowledge and skills in current technologies and applications (e.g. MS Office Suite, SQL, PowerBI, etc.)</li> <li>Ability to conduct all activities with the highest degree of integrity</li> <li>Detail-oriented, self-motivated and able to respond quickly to a fast-moving and ever-changing environment</li> </ul> <p><strong>ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS:&nbsp;</strong></p> <ul> <li>Must be able to travel - up to 20% work week travel may be required</li> <li>Must be able to work extended hours and/or weekends as title: Sr. Sourcing Specialist, OPEX (Starlink)
jd_text: <div class="content-intro"><p>SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. SOURCING SPECIALIST, OPEX (STARLINK)</span></strong></p> </div> <div> <p>One of the most ambitious missions that SpaceX has undertaken to date, the Starlink constellation is our solution to providing reliable internet to the entire world. To capitalize on our technical and market success, our team will execute large-scale projects that will define the bottom-line for the Starlink program. The functions within the department include procurement, planning and fulfillment, supplier development and quality, logistics, inventory management, negotiation of supplier contracts and pricing, and developing the commodity strategy.</p> </div> <div> <p>This is a high-profile, cross functional position that plays an integral role in enabling development and production flow for Starlink production. You will work in close coordination with engineering and manufacturing departments, executing effective, creative and smart supply chain strategies to achieve production goals. With integration taking place in-house, sourcing specialists are able to see their assemblies come to life every day!</p> </div> <div> <p><strong>RESPONSIBILITIES:</strong></p> </div> <ul type="disc"> <li>Place purchase orders and resolve blocked invoices related to assigned category</li> <li>Forecast demand, evaluate capacity, and manage supply signals to adjust incoming material</li> <li>Track high risk components and supplier delivery performance</li> <li>Communicate clearly and rapidly to influence decisions of vendors and senior leadership</li> <li>Interpret engineering drawings and BOMs</li> <li>Create sourcing strategies for all mechanical custom and COTS hardware</li> <li>Develop a preferred supplier network and leverage it to minimize cost and lead time for the fabrication and delivery of parts</li> <li>Supported commodities include, but are not limited to, machined parts, electromechanical equipment, large machining, finish processes, and mechanical assemblies</li> <li>Solve complex, open-ended problems with an emphasis on speed and efficiency</li> <li>Manage outsource fabrication projects including planning, coordinating with stakeholders, estimating completion, and managing vendor performance</li> <li>Perform onsite reviews of vendor capabilities</li> <li>Responsible for authoring of contract documents with the legal department</li> <li>Management of contracts ensuring performance of the supplier to contract obligations</li> <li>Understand interrelationships between contracts and terms while applying creativity and sound business reasoning to interpret application of contract to business needs</li> <li>Utilize negotiations to maximize value and cost savings benefit while lowering risk</li> </ul> <div> <p><strong>BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:</strong></p> </div> <ul type="disc"> <li>Bachelor’s degree and 3+ years of experience working in purchasing, procurement, material planning, production planning, supply chain management, or engineering; OR 5+ years of experience in lieu of a degree</li> </ul> <div> <p><strong>PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:</strong></p> </div> <ul type="disc"> <li>Experience with MRP or enterprise resource planning (ERP) systems, as well as, managing bill of materials, work orders, and purchase orders</li> <li>Experience with forecasting, demand planning, and lead time analysis</li> <li>Detail-oriented, self-motivated and able to respond quickly to a fast-moving and ever-changing environments</li> <li>Capability to prioritize multiple on-going projects</li> <li>Strong track record for achieving results; must be able to reference wins and quantify impact</li> <li>Strong skills in data analysis using Excel, SQL, and PowerBI</li> <li>Solid understanding of common manufacturing processes and machines including mills, lathes, waterjet, laser cutters, sheet metal fabrication, etc.</li> <li>Familiar with common material finishes and coatings, including paint, powder coat, anodize, heat treatment, etc.</li> <li>American Production and Inventory Control Society (APICS) certification, Six Sigma certification, or similar certifications</li> <li>Effective written and verbal communications skills, with strong ability to communicate to all levels of internal personnel</li> <li>Demonstrated ability to work in ambiguous situations and across organizational boundaries</li> <li>History of self-learning &amp; application of newly learned tools &amp; techniques</li> <li>Ability to learn quickly and prioritize appropriately to meet customer and company needs</li> </ul> <div> <p><strong>ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS:</strong></p> </div> <ul type="disc"> <li>Willingness to work extended hours and weekends when needed to meet critical deadlines</li> <li>Ability to travel and communicate outside of work hours</li> <li>Ability to travel: up to 20-50% of work week</li> <li>Must be able to work onsite, remote work not considered</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong>ITAR REQUIREMENTS:</strong></p> <ul> <li>To conform to U.S. Government export regulations, applicant must be a (i) U.S. citizen or national, (ii) U.S. lawful, permanent resident (aka green card holder), (iii) Refugee under 8 U.S.C. § 1157, or (iv) Asylee under 8 U.S.C. § 1158, or be eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State. Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of&nbsp;enabling human life on Mars.</p></div><p><strong>SR. STRUCTURAL ENGINEER (STARSHIP LAUNCH PAD)</strong></p> <p>As a member of the launch pad development team, you will work with a group of elite engineers across multiple disciplines to design, build, and activate a second orbital launch pad and ancillary infrastructure that will further enable orbital launch capability for the most powerful rocket in the world, Starship. This position is based in Starbase, Texas (Brownsville/South Padre Island Area).</p> <p><strong>RESPONSIBILITIES:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Lead the project team, consulting engineers and contractors throughout the entirety of the civil and structural engineering, procurement, construction, and commissioning process</li> <li>Develop and issue drawings, design documentation, and reports for title: Sr. Supplier Development Engineer (Starlink)
jd_text: <div class="content-intro"><p>SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of&nbsp;enabling human life on Mars.</p></div><p><strong>SR. SUPPLIER DEVELOPMENT ENGINEER (STARLINK)</strong></p> <p>SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Starlink is building the hardware to make a global communications network real: user terminals, gateways, satellites, and datacenter products, at a rate and a cost aerospace has not shipped before.</p> <p>This is one role because the work is one job. You own a technology, a supplier, and a manufacturing process from selection through high-volume production, and you are accountable for how that hardware performs after it ships. The scope runs across silicon, advanced packaging, printed circuit boards, mechanical parts, and assembly. Some weeks you are choosing the process and the factory. Some weeks you are the reliability engineer or the quality engineer standing up a new design, a new line, or a new process. You do not hand the outcome to someone else.</p> <p>You will do this with a manufacturing team that has already taken flight hardware and consumer hardware from first article to rate. The problems are on the floor, at the supplier, and in the field.</p> <p><strong>RESPONSIBILITIES:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Own hardware from selection to scale for Starlink consumer, gateway, satellite, or datacenter products. Technology choice, supplier choice, process choice, equipment, yield, cost, schedule, and field performance sit with you.</li> <li>Select suppliers who can build at the quality and rate the program needs, and develop them until the process is capable. Change the supplier when the technical path is not there.</li> <li>Choose the manufacturing process and the equipment. Define the process window, the control plan, and the evidence of capability before rate, not after the line is already late.</li> <li>Bring up new designs, new factories, and new processes. Be on the floor, debug the tool, and close the yield and rate gap yourself.</li> <li>Do the reliability and quality work the hardware needs: failure analysis, test and screen strategy, process FMEA, corrective action, and a field-to-factory loop that changes the product.</li> <li>Carry the technical decision with design, test, supply chain, and the supplier. Make the call and live with the field result.</li> <li>Scale what is proven. Stop what will not scale.&nbsp;</li> <li>Own escapes into customer deployments, gateway sites, orbit, and datacenter operation.</li> </ul> <p><strong>BASIC QUALIFICATIONS: </strong></p> <ul> <li>Bachelor’s degree in an engineering discipline.</li> <li>8+ years of hands-on experience in supplier development, manufacturing or process engineering, equipment engineering, quality engineering, or reliability engineering for hardware.</li> <li>Experience with driving a supplier, design, or process from initial conception to production.</li> <li>Experience owning the outcomes related to final yield, quality, and performance.</li> <li>Experience in at least one of the following: <ul> <li>Semiconductor or packaging&nbsp;</li> <li>PCB fabrication or assembly</li> <li>Mechanical fabrication</li> <li>Electromechanical assembly</li> </ul> </li> </ul> <p><strong>PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE: </strong></p> <ul> <li>10+ years, including ownership of a commodity or process from selection through a high-volume ramp.</li> <li>Consumer electronics, networking, satellite, or datacenter hardware, with production measured in thousands to millions of units.</li> <li>New factory or new process bring-up: equipment selection and installation, process development, capability, and rate.</li> <li>Technology and supplier selection on a new design, including process trade studies, make-or-buy, and second source.</li> <li>Reliability: life test, HALT/HASS or equivalent, physics of failure, and corrective action tied to field returns.</li> <li>Using FMEA, control plans, SPC, DOE, MSA, and structured root cause as engineering tools.</li> <li>International supplier travel, and sound judgment when you are the person representing SpaceX in the factory.</li> </ul> <p><strong>ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Travel up to 50%, including international travel, often on short notice.</li> <li>Extended hours during builds, ramps, and line-down events.</li> <li>Regular time on factory floors at SpaceX and at suppliers.</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong>ITAR REQUIREMENTS:</strong></p> <ul> <li>To conform to U.S. Government export regulations, applicant must be a (i) U.S. citizen or national, (ii) U.S. lawful, permanent resident (aka green card holder), (iii) Refugee under 8 U.S.C. § 1157, or (iv) Asylee under 8 U.S.C. § title: Sr. Supplier Development Engineer, Data Center (Starlink)
jd_text: <div class="content-intro"><p>SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of&nbsp;enabling human life on Mars.</p></div><p><strong>SR. SUPPLIER DEVELOPMENT ENGINEER, DATA CENTER (STARLINK)</strong></p> <p>SpaceX is on mission to create AI systems that can accurately understand the universe and aid humanity in its pursuit of knowledge. &nbsp;We are looking for talented, creative, and driven data center engineers to develop, drive, and maintain suppliers, from initial concept development to full scale production.</p> <p>This is a high-profile, cross functional position that plays an integral role in enabling development and production of data centers. You will work in close coordination with internal engineering and manufacturing departments as well as directly with suppliers to execute effective, creative and smart supply chain strategies to activate some of the world’s most technically advanced facilities and data centers.</p> <p><strong>RESPONSIBILITIES:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Analyze data center hardware and processes from a first principles, physics-based approach with focus on data center hardware domain.</li> <li>Ability to own complex rack-level solutions, system-level design decisions across mechanical, electrical, power, thermal, networking, and software integration domains.</li> <li>Lead the integration of Reliability, Availability, and Serviceability (RAS) principles into data center strategy and architecture, ensuring resilient, high-performing infrastructure that consistently delivers maximum uptime and operational continuity.</li> <li>Experience in rack-level solution design and integration, jd_text: <div class="content-intro"><p>SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. This rapid expansion requires a highly resilient and scalable supply chain with world-class precision measurement capabilities for high-tolerance mechanical components.&nbsp;The role entails early engagement in supplier selection, equipment selection, and process engineering to set programs up for success in high-volume manufacturing by ensuring material and process corners are fully completed. The role also includes ownership to deliver on time, monitor field performance, react to issues, and feed lessons learned back to engineering teams for iterative improvement.&nbsp;</p> <p>We are seeking a Metrology Engineer with strong technical and leadership skills to drive supplier development, metrology strategy, and AI-enabled measurement systems for mechanical parts in high-volume production.&nbsp;The Supplier Development Engineer, Mechanical Metrology will be responsible for executing end-to-end supplier strategies focused on precision mechanical components and their associated metrology processes. This position will have significant technical and leadership influence across Starlink engineering, quality, and supply chain teams.&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>RESPONSIBILITIES:&nbsp;</strong></p> <ul> properly set up high-volume manufacturing programs by ensuring material and process corners are fully characterized and completed&nbsp;</li> <li>Provide technical guidance on mechanical metrology methods, Geometric Dimensioning and Tolerancing (GD&amp;T) implementation, datum scheme development and best practices, PC-DMIS programming, surface texture and surface technology standards, and measurement system analysis (MSA) while driving adoption of AI-powered metrology solutions&nbsp;</li> <li>Design, develop, and qualify precision measurement fixtures, including fixture concept design, datum scheme optimization, repeatability studies, and qualification to ensure measurement system stability and accuracy&nbsp;</li> <li>Assess supplier manufacturing and metrology capabilities, including capacity, process windows, gage repeatability and reproducibility (GR&amp;R) performance, uncertainty budgets, datum scheme robustness, and scalability for high-volume production of tight-tolerance mechanical parts&nbsp;</li> <li>Indirectly manage internal metrology lab activities and technicians by setting technical direction, prioritizing work, and ensuring consistent execution of measurement standards and best practices&nbsp;</li> <li>Implement artificial intelligence (AI) and machine learning solutions for metrology, including automated vision inspection, predictive analytics on measurement trends, anomaly detection, and intelligent data interpretation systems&nbsp;</li> <li>Lead Production Part Approval Process (PPAP), First Article Inspections (FAI), gage dimensional validation, surface finish and texture analysis, coordinate measuring machine (CMM) and optical measurement correlation, and environmental stability testing&nbsp;</li> <li>Drive supplier performance improvement through Lean methodologies, supplier scorecards, process audits, and systematic problem solving to deliver measurable gains in quality, cost, and delivery&nbsp;</li> issues&nbsp;</li> <li>Own on-time delivery of qualification and production ramp activities while continuously monitoring field performance, reacting quickly to issues, and feeding lessons learned from field data back to design and process engineering teams for iterative improvement&nbsp;</li> <li>Ensure internal customers are highly satisfied by delivering not only precise measurement data but clear engineering inferences, trend analysis, and actionable recommendations derived from metrology results&nbsp;</li> </ul> <p><strong>BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:&nbsp;</strong></p> <ul> <li>Bachelor’s degree in mechanical engineering, metrology, industrial engineering, or a other engineering discipline&nbsp;</li> <li><span data-teams="true">6+ years of experience in mechanical metrology, precision manufacturing, or supplier development (internship and extracurricular experience is applicable)&nbsp;</span></li> </ul> <p><strong>PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCES:&nbsp;</strong></p> <ul> <li><span title: Sr. Terrestrial Services Sales Manager (Starlink Aviation)
jd_text: <div class="content-intro"><p>SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. TERRESTRIAL SERVICES SALES MANAGER (STARLINK AVIATION)</strong></p> <p>The Starlink Aviation team is hiring a local, results-driven Senior Sales Manager to drive adoption of Starlink’s high-speed terrestrial connectivity across airport and ground operations worldwide. Starlink presents a major opportunity to transform how airlines and airports operate on the ground by delivering reliable, multi-gigabit connectivity to lounges, gates, hangars, maintenance bays, fleet vehicles, and other critical facilities. This hunter-focused role requires strong personal drive to engage new and existing airline and business aviation customers, uncover new terrestrial opportunities, build key relationships, maximize internal and external outcomes, and consistently sign high-value deals that deliver immediate impact.</p> <p>We are partnering with airlines, aircraft operators, airports, and aviation service providers to deliver connectivity that matches or exceeds terrestrial standards for ground operations and passenger-facing facilities. We’re seeking tenacious, commercially sharp sales professionals who excel at hunting and closing deals to help reshape the realities of airport infrastructure. This is a rare opportunity to create meaningful change and apply your world-class sales skills on the world’s leading aviation connectivity team.</p> <p><strong>RESPONSIBILITIES:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Responsible for all aspects of successfully closing terrestrial enterprise deals with existing airline, commercial aviation, and business aviation customers</li> <li>Serve as a key player on the global aviation commercial team, driving expansion of Starlink ground services by identifying opportunities, leading pricing and commercial strategy, and owning business discussions and negotiations.</li> <li>Report directly to the Global Head of Starlink Aviation</li> <li>Collaborate with cross-functional teams (engineering, regulatory, product, sales operations, and business teams)</li> <li>Develop and deliver commercial proposals, sales materials, and business terms while staying current on Starlink technology capabilities, regulatory requirements, and internal priorities</li> <li>Conduct deep discovery with existing customers to uncover terrestrial use cases across lounges, gates, hangars, maintenance bays, fleet vehicles, and other ground operations, then share feedback with the engineering and product teams to influence features and roadmap.</li> <li>Own end-to-end execution of contracts and agreements with customers</li> <li>Build, manage, and accurately forecast a robust sales pipeline to inform territory strategy and planning</li> <li>Synthesize complex customer and market information into clear, actionable recommendations for the leadership team</li> <li>Contribute to the creation of sales enablement materials including playbooks, battle cards, case studies, presentations, and marketing collateral</li> </ul> <p><strong>BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Bachelor’s degree in an engineering or business discipline and 5+ years of professional experience in business development, partnerships, corporate strategy or sales; title: Sr. Thermal Engineer - Fluids Analysis, AI Satellites (Starmind)
jd_text: <div class="content-intro"><p>SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of&nbsp;enabling human life on Mars.</p></div><p><strong>SR. THERMAL ENGINEER (FLUIDS ANALYSIS), AI SATELLITES (STARMIND)</strong></p> <p>SpaceX is leveraging its experience deploying and operating the world’s largest satellite constellation to develop Starmind, a new constellation of satellites capturing solar energy in space to power low-cost, high-performance AI compute for Earth. Scaling AI in space is a thermal problem as much as a power and processing problem. With a dense compute payload dissipating hundreds of kilowatts, the thermal system must efficiently transfer heat to large radiators that reject it to space, under solar load, eclipse, and multi-mode AI duty cycles.</p> <p>You will join the StarmindThermal team, which owns the satellite cooling stack end-to-end. Rejecting hundreds of kilowatts of accelerator waste heat to space is limited by high-flux loads transferring heat to massive deployable radiators. No capable cooling architecture has been flown at this scale. As a Senior Thermal Engineer focused on fluids analysis, you own conjugate heat transfer and thermal-fluid analysis of cold plates, heat exchangers, and radiator channels and manifolds, and the system 0-D/1-D thermal-fluid network that sets flow split, ΔP budget, loop ΔT, and pump operating point. You co-evolve geometry and flow path with mechanical and fluid-systems owners under tight feedback from manufacturing and test. You sit where the local physics is hardest and the design decisions stick: predictions that close margins, ground in test, and drive rate-production hardware.</p> <p><strong>RESPONSIBILITIES:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Own conjugate heat-transfer (CHT) and thermal-fluid analysis of high-performance cold plates, heat exchangers, and radiator channels for STARMIND satellites</li> <li>Own the system 0-D/1-D thermal-fluid network that sizes and balances the cooling loop: flow split, ΔP budget, loop ΔT, pump operating point</li> <li>Drive cooling-loop architecture trades with hardware and vehicle-level thermal teammates</li> <li>Co-evolve geometry, materials and processes with hardware owners to find mass producible, efficient thermal solutions</li> <li>Predict component and system performance under wide range of flow and thermal conditions</li> <li>Own pre-test prediction, test design, and model-test correlation for fluid component and integrated thermal tests</li> <li>Automate analysis workflows for re-running trades as designs and boundary conditions change</li> </ul> <p><strong>BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Bachelor’s degree in mechanical, aerospace, or a related engineering discipline</li> <li>5+ years of professional experience in fluids, CFD, or thermal analysis</li> </ul> <p><strong>PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Master’s degree in mechanical, aerospace, or a related engineering discipline</li> <li>Steady/transient conjugate heat-transfer CFD of liquid-cooled or high-heat-flux hardware (STAR-CCM+, ANSYS Fluent/CFX, or equivalent)</li> <li>Hand-calc checks and engineering judgment on mesh, turbulence modeling, and model fidelity</li> <li>Hands on hardware testing inclusive of instrumentation selection and model correlation</li> <li>Relevant manufacturing techniques, and judiciously pushing their constraints</li> <li>Watertight CFD geometry (Siemens NX or equivalent)</li> <li>Package/board-level tools as secondary (Icepak, Flotherm)</li> <li>0-D/1-D thermal-fluid network modeling to size and balance cooling loops (flow split, ΔP budget, loop ΔT, pump operating point)</li> <li>Scripting analysis workflows and post-processing (Python preferred)</li> </ul> <p><strong>ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Ability to work extended hours or weekends as needed for mission critical deadlines</li> <li>Some travel may occasionally be required</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong>ITAR REQUIREMENTS:</strong></p> <ul> <li>To Scaling AI in space is a thermal problem as much as a power and processing problem. With a dense compute payload dissipating hundreds of kilowatts, the thermal system must efficiently transfer heat to large radiators that reject it to space, under solar load, eclipse, and multi-mode AI duty cycles.</p> <p>You will join the Starmind Thermal team, which owns the satellite cooling stack end-to-end. Dense AI compute at hundreds of kilowatts, rejected only by radiation under solar load, eclipse, and multi-mode duty cycles, has never been flown at constellation scale, and the vehicle-level thermal model is how that problem gets defined for everyone else. As a Senior Thermal Engineer focused on spacecraft analysis, you own that model and the mission environments the thermal and broader vehicle team design against: orbital and ground boundary conditions, system thermal budgets, heat-rejection architecture trades, and vehicle-level prediction through ground and TVAC correlation (with flight telemetry as the program matures). You sit where incomplete concepts become clear thermal design criteria, partnering with fluids analysts and hardware owners so margins close in analysis, test, and flight.</p> <p><strong>RESPONSIBILITIES:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Own the vehicle-level thermal model for Starmind satellites</li> <li>Define environments across entire vehicle lifecycle, including ground test, launch, operations, and disposal</li> <li>Drive heat-rejection architecture trades: radiator area, mass, optical properties, heater/survival power</li> <li>Own the system thermal budget: dissipation allocation, heater loads, min/max temps vs.&nbsp;limits</li> <li>Own integrated TVAC/thermal balance tests from inputs, to pre-test prediction, instrumentation selection, live test support, through post-test correlation.</li> <li>Define component-level thermal inputs for qualification, reliability, and acceptance testing.</li> <li>Evaluate on-orbit performance to improve model accuracy, drive key hardware upgrades, and increase operational efficiency</li> <li>Automate analysis workflows for re-running trades as designs and environments change</li> </ul> <p><strong>BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Bachelor’s degree in mechanical, aerospace, or a related engineering discipline</li> <li>5+ years of professional experience in thermal analysis</li> </ul> <p><strong>PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Master’s degree in mechanical, aerospace, or a related engineering discipline</li> <li>Spacecraft or high-power vehicle-level thermal-fluid modeling in Thermal Desktop, SINDA/FLUINT (or equivalent)</li> <li>Steady-state and transient analysis under varied environments, workloads and thermal control modes</li> <li>Hands on hardware TVAC/thermal testing inclusive of instrumentation selection and model correlation</li> <li>Selection of materials and finishes for thermal performance in orbital environments</li> <li>Scripting analysis workflows and post-processing (Python preferred)</li> </ul> <p><strong>ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Ability to work extended hours or weekends as needed for mission critical deadlines</li> <li>Some travel may occasionally be required</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong>ITAR REQUIREMENTS:</strong></p> <ul> <li>To conform to U.S. Government TRAJECTORY ANALYSIS ENGINEER (STARSHIP)</strong></p> <p>As a Trajectory Analysis Engineer, you will be responsible for finding creative analysis solutions to enable the world’s most advanced rockets, including our next-generation Starship vehicle, a fully reusable spacecraft capable of carrying humans to Mars and beyond. You will work with a talented team of accomplished engineers to iterate on mission objectives for upcoming and future flights to ensure flight safety objectives are met. You should thrive in fast-paced, dynamic environments where you adapt quickly and love to solve hard problems.</p> <p><strong>RESPONSIBILITIES:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Analyze launch vehicle jd_text: <div class="content-intro"><p>SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of&nbsp;enabling human life on Mars.</p></div><p><strong>SR. WATER TREATMENT ENGINEER, SOLAR CELL FACTORY (STARLINK)</strong></p> <p>At SpaceX we are building the next generation of space infrastructure to enable large-scale AI data centers in orbit. These orbital AI platforms require massive amounts of reliable, high-efficiency solar power to support intensive computing workloads in space. To make this possible, we are standing up one of the largest solar cell manufacturing facilities in the world. We are seeking a best-in-class Water Treatment Engineer to drive design, commissioning, build, and operations of ultrapure water and wastewater systems. This high-impact role will help shape process strategies from the ground up while enabling SpaceX’s ambitious vision for AI data centers in space. &nbsp;</p> <p>As a Sr. Water Treatment Engineer on the Starlink manufacturing program, you will take ownership for activating, qualifying, optimizing, and ensuring the consistency of operations for an ultrapure process water plant supporting our solar cell manufacturing lines. This position is responsible for the development, implementation, and operationalization of equipment, facilities, tooling, and manufacturing process technologies necessary for high-volume production. Your work will form the backbone for millions of next-generation of satellites used all over the world. For homes, schools, businesses, vehicles, planes, or boats, this team plays an instrumental role in ensuring high-speed connectivity is available to all who need it.</p> <p><strong>RESPONSIBILITIES:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Demonstrate extreme ownership in the construction, activation, and operation of a new commercial ultrapure process water treatment facility</li> <li>Design, implement, and productionize mechanical and fluid systems that meet SpaceX and regulatory requirements</li> <li>Interpret lab analysis, data streams, and operator feedback to effectively maintain safe and effective plant operations</li> <li>Develop, implement, maintain, and improve operational procedures, methods, and process equipment</li> <li>Form strong partnerships with internal and external counterparts, including but not limited to manufacturing operations and engineering, environment health and safety (EHS), facilities construction and maintenance teams, representatives of regulatory bodies, OEM equipment manufactures, and supplier representatives</li> <li>Identify and champion continuous improvement projects</li> <li>Develop project plans, budgets, and cost/benefit analysis for implementation of new processes or machines</li> <li>Monitor and communicate area status and risks</li> </ul> <p><strong>BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Bachelor's degree in an engineering, math, or science discipline</li> <li>5+ years of experience in a manufacturing environment or with fluids/mechanical/electromechanical design and analysis (internship or project team experience is applicable)</li> </ul> <p><strong>PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:</strong></p> <ul> <li>7+ years hands-on project experience in wastewater treatment</li> <li>Experience with process parameters and engineering units for temperature, pressure, flow, and power</li> <li>Ability to read and understand process PFDs, P&amp;IDs, 2D and 3D CAD drawings, construction drawings, and BOMs</li> <li>Experience with mechanical equipment and systems requiring the isolation of the malfunction, disassembly of industrial machinery, and repair/replacement of bearings, gears, structural components</li> <li>Experience with lock out tag out, job hazard analysis, and hot work permitting</li> <li>Experience applying lean manufacturing principles</li> <li>Experience taking products from title: Sr. Wi-Fi Software Engineer (Starlink)
jd_text: <div class="content-intro"><p>SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of&nbsp;enabling human life on Mars.</p></div><p><strong>SR. WI-FI SOFTWARE ENGINEER (STARLINK)</strong></p> <p>At SpaceX we’re leveraging our experience in building rockets and spacecraft to deploy Starlink, the world’s most advanced broadband internet system. Starlink is the world’s largest satellite constellation and is providing fast, reliable internet to millions of users worldwide. We design, build, manufacture, and operate all parts of the system including thousands of satellites and millions of customer kits. Our customers currently include teachers in the most remote parts of the Amazon, researchers in Antarctica, digital nomads who travel via RV, emergency responders, commercial airlines, cruise lines, and residential users who live in more rural or developing areas. While users can get online within minutes almost anywhere in the world, we’ve only begun to scratch the surface of Starlink’s potential.&nbsp;We are looking for best-in-class engineers to help maximize Starlink’s utility for individuals, communities, and businesses.</p> <p>As a Sr. Wi-Fi Software Engineer, you will be a critical piece of the overall customer experience. We are looking for experts in the Wi-Fi space to help Starlink deliver an amazing end-to-end customer experience. You see the big picture, prioritize accordingly, and are comfortable with working at different levels of abstraction.</p> <p><strong>RESPONSIBILITIES:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Driving the Wi-Fi software and product roadmap</li> <li>Debug and optimize kernel-level system performance</li> <li>Collaborate with our RF and EE engineers to improving our testing procedures for both software and hardware</li> <li>Mentor software engineers and building a great work culture</li> <li>Improve our Wi-Fi mesh performance</li> <li>Invent new tools that enable more frequent and reliable software deployment, test execution, and data analysis as part of a continuous integration and release system</li> </ul> <p><strong>BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Bachelor’s degree in computer science, engineering, math, or STEM discipline and 5+ years of professional experience in software development; or 7+ years of professional experience in software development in lieu of degree</li> <li>3+ years development experience in C or C++</li> <li>Experience with the IEEE 802.11 wireless standard and with networking protocols (UDP, TCP/IP, etc.)</li> <li>Experience working on embedded software for networking equipment</li> </ul> <p><strong>PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Strong fundamental knowledge of networks, embedded systems, math, and physics</li> <li>Solid communication and leadership skills</li> <li>Experience testing Wi-Fi for performance or stability</li> <li>Deep understanding of testing, continuous integration, build, deployment &amp; continuous monitoring</li> <li>Knowledge of DHCP, IPv4, IPv6, Linux bridge, network stack internals</li> <li>Experience with networking kernel modules and drivers</li> <li>Experience driving cross-team projects</li> <li>Experience with security issues associated with distributed systems and internet services</li> <li>Experience with Golang and Python</li> <li>Experience with hostAP</li> <li>Ability to work effectively in a dynamic environment with changing needs and requirements</li> </ul> <p><strong>ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Must be willing to work extended hours and weekends as needed</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong>ITAR REQUIREMENTS:</strong></p> <ul> <li>To conform to U.S. Government export regulations, applicant must be a (i) U.S. citizen or national, (ii) U.S. lawful, permanent resident (aka green card holder), (iii) Refugee under 8 U.S.C. § 1157, or (iv) Asylee under 8 U.S.C. § 1158, or be eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State. Learn more about the ITAR <a href="https://www.pmddtc.state.gov/?id=ddtc_kb_article_page&amp;sys_id=24d528fddbfc930044f9ff621f961987">here</a>. &nbsp;</li> </ul> <p>SpaceX is an Equal Opportunity Employer; employment with SpaceX is governed on the basis of merit, competence and qualifications and will not be influenced in any manner by race, color, religion, gender, national origin/ethnicity, veteran status, disability status, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, mental or physical disability or any other legally protected status.</p> <p>Applicants wishing to view a copy of SpaceX’s Affirmative Action Plan for veterans and individuals with disabilities, or applicants requiring reasonable accommodation to the application/interview process should reach out to&nbsp;<a href="mailto:EEOCompliance@spacex.com">EEOCompliance@spacex.com</a><em>.&nbsp;</em></p></div>

title: Starlink Account Manager (State & Local Government)
jd_text: <div class="content-intro"><p>SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of&nbsp;enabling human life on Mars.</p></div><p><strong>STARLINK ACCOUNT MANAGER (STATE &amp; LOCAL GOVERNMENT)</strong></p> <p>Starlink, our revolutionary satellite constellation, is delivering low-latency broadband internet around the world. The Account Management team serves as the point of contact for customers from contract signature, through successful activation, ensuring all contract terms are fulfilled while and identifying new opportunities to generate business with enterprise customers. Prior to contract signature, the team will have a key role in ensuring that the commitments we make are ones we can successfully execute to.&nbsp;<br><br>In the past year, the Starlink team has signed contracts with customers who will deploy high speed internet at a pace and for use cases previously not possible. The team has designed the product to be self-service, and we need to similarly evolve our team and systems to enable large enterprises to manage Starlink themselves, minimizing humans-in-the-loop.&nbsp;Our ideal candidate is a self-starter that has a passion for making customers deliriously happy, supporting excellent teams, and managing complex cross-functional projects.</p> <p><strong>RESPONSIBILITIES:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Act as the primary point of contact for a robust portfolio of assigned government customers and own the interface from contract signature onwards (onboarding, ongoing account management, and long-term retention/growth of the relationship and revenue) with emphasis on:</li> <ul> <li>Delivering impeccable customer service, including efficient acknowledgement and resolution of issues</li> <li>Building relationships to identify requirements and manage expectations</li> <li>Collecting, communicating, and championing customer feedback internally to influence and steer programmatic and technical development required to maintain and grow enterprise business</li> <li>Retaining and growing the value of accounts</li> </ul> <li>As an extreme owner of assigned accounts, identify and successfully communicate readiness levels, requirements, schedules, and risks to realize forecasted revenue on or ahead of schedule</li> <li>Serve as the team’s internal expert in the State &amp; Local / Local &amp; Regional government vertical in specific regions, shaping strategic direction and routinely leading high-impact commercial decision-making within the vertical and region in partnership with other teams</li> <li>Autonomously identify, design, and lead implementation of new processes and system improvements that will broadly accelerate growth for customers or enable the internal team to scale rapidly</li> </ul> <p><strong>BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Bachelor's degree; OR high school diploma/equivalency certificate and 5+ years of professional business development, operations, engineering, or account management experience</li> <li>3+ years of experience in account management, customer success, or business operations</li> <li>1+ years of experience working with government customers</li> </ul> <p><strong>PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:</strong></p> <ul> <li>3+ years of experience working with customers to support a technical product/service</li> <li>3+ years working with State &amp; Local / Local &amp; Regional government customers</li> <li>Significant knowledge or experience in one or more of the following industries: public sector, telecommunications, manufacturing, satellite communications and/or supply chain</li> <li>Experience managing multiple complex projects and delivering under tight deadlines and resource constraints</li> <li>Experience building long-term and successful customer relationships demonstrating empathy, active listening, and resiliency skills</li> <li>Significant technical knowledge of Starlink or telecommunications in at least one key area: satellites, ground network, user terminals, or related technology</li> <li>Ability to synthesize multiple unique requirements and suggest smart solutions, products, or features</li> <li>Track record of demonstrating sound business judgement, evaluating alternatives, and making recommendations that were adopted and ultimately successful</li> <li>Ability to negotiate successfully, especially after a contract is signed</li> <li>Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including ability to craft and present professional presentations at all levels</li> <li>Ability to manage execution of significant or complex contracts including initial intake, renegotiation of terms, and schedules</li> </ul> <p><strong>ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Must be available to work extended hours and/or weekends as needed to support critical milestones or operations shifts</li> <li>Must be willing to travel to other SpaceX offices and customer locations as needed</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong>ITAR title: Starlink Customer Success Manager (Land Mobile)
jd_text: <div class="content-intro"><p>SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of&nbsp;enabling human life on Mars.</p></div><p><strong>STARLINK CUSTOMER SUCCESS MANAGER (LAND MOBILE)</strong></p> <p>Starlink is delivering high-speed, low-latency internet around the world. Customer Success is the post-sale owner of the customer relationship where they are the single name on a book of enterprise accounts from contract signature through onboarding, activation, payment, and long-term growth. This role owns Starlink Land Mobile accounts across agriculture, rail, trucking, OEM, heavy machinery, and other in-motion or remote vehicle networks. You take assigned accounts from contract signature through hardware, activation, payment, and expansion. Sales books the deal. You own everything after.&nbsp;This is an individual contributor role, and the ideal candidate is a self-starter who is comfortable operating without a defined playbook, holds a high bar of communication, and treats revenue, activation, and account health as their personal responsibility.&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>RESPONSIBILITIES:&nbsp;</strong></p> <ul> <li>Own assigned Land Mobile accounts from contract signature through onboarding, activation, day-to-day management, and long-term growth as the primary customer contact&nbsp;</li> <li>Hit and exceed revenue targets on time by tracking readiness, shipments, activations, certifications, and payments, and by raising risks early when dates or dollars may slip&nbsp;</li> <li>Keep internal systems current so account status, risk, and opportunity are visible in one place&nbsp;</li> <li>Monitor account health—including contract compliance, KPI performance, invoicing, logistics, in-motion or field performance, and the customer relationship—to prevent delayed cash or churn&nbsp;</li> <li>Set clear expectations with customers, resellers, and internal partners on what SpaceX can and cannot commit to on timing, hardware, and delivery&nbsp;</li> <li>Build account plans that define current state, a healthy account, and the next dollar of revenue&nbsp;</li> <li>Identify expansion across additional vehicles, machines, routes, sites, kits, and new ways customers can use Starlink in the field&nbsp;</li> <li>Facilitate leadership business reviews that connect Starlink performance to customer results&nbsp;</li> <li>Forecast retention and revenue for the book so leadership can plan against a real number&nbsp;</li> <li>Bring customer feedback into SpaceX and work with engineering, support, finance, and operations to reduce errors across accounts&nbsp;</li> <li>Coordinate high-touch onboarding, including hardware transitions, reseller partners, and certification or deployment requirements&nbsp;</li> <li>Document processes that support expansion and scaling of the Land Mobile book&nbsp;</li> </ul> <p><strong>BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:&nbsp;</strong></p> <ul> <li>Bachelor’s degree in engineering, business, or a related field, OR high school diploma / equivalency certificate and 6+ years of professional experience in account management, customer success, business development, operations, or a technical customer-facing role&nbsp;</li> <li>5+ years owning a defined book of business with accountability for customer health and revenue (retention, realization, expansion, or collections), not just project delivery&nbsp;</li> <li>5+ years supporting customers on a technical product or service&nbsp;</li> </ul> <p><strong>PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:&nbsp;</strong></p> <ul> <li>Experience supporting customers with in-motion, fleet, field, or similarly operationally complex deployments&nbsp;</li> <li>Experience with agriculture, rail, trucking, OEM, heavy machinery, or other land-mobile / vehicle connectivity programs&nbsp;</li> <li>A track record of growing revenue inside existing accounts, such as expansion, additional vehicles or sites, or new ways the customer uses the product&nbsp;</li> <li>Experience running several complex workstreams at the same time and delivering them on tight timelines&nbsp;</li> <li>Strong written and verbal communication, with the ability to work clearly with executives, operators, and finance&nbsp;</li> <li>Experience with telecommunications, satellite, networking, or similar infrastructure sold to enterprise or government customers&nbsp;</li> </ul> <p><strong>ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS:&nbsp;</strong></p> <ul> <li>Willing to work early mornings, evenings, and weekends as needed for customer milestones and global time zones&nbsp;</li> <li>Willing to travel to customer sites, depots, yards, and field locations as needed&nbsp;</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong>ITAR REQUIREMENTS:</strong></p> <ul> <li>To conform to U.S. Government export regulations, applicant must be a (i) U.S. citizen or national, (ii) U.S. lawful, permanent resident (aka green card holder), (iii) Refugee under 8 U.S.C. § 1157, or (iv) Asylee under 8 U.S.C. § 1158, or be eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State. Learn more about the ITAR <a href="https://www.pmddtc.state.gov/?id=ddtc_kb_article_page&amp;sys_id=24d528fddbfc930044f9ff621f961987">here</a>. &nbsp;</li> </ul> <p>SpaceX is an Equal Opportunity Employer; employment with SpaceX is governed on the basis of merit, competence and qualifications and will not be influenced in any manner by race, color, religion, gender, national origin/ethnicity, veteran status, disability status, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, mental or physical disability or any other legally protected status.</p> <p>Applicants wishing to view a copy of SpaceX’s Affirmative Action Plan for veterans and individuals with disabilities, or applicants requiring reasonable accommodation to the application/interview process should reach out to&nbsp;<a href="mailto:EEOCompliance@spacex.com">EEOCompliance@spacex.com</a><em>.&nbsp;</em></p></div>
